items.title: A Bona Fide Killer
items.overview: A seemingly ordinary working mother secretly lives as a legendary sniper who delivers justice where the law fails. After returning from a three-year hiatus, she must balance protecting her family with eliminating dangerous criminals, all while a determined journalist and a relentless detective close in on her hidden identity.
items.tagline: The perfect housewife. The perfect double life.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A legendary vigilante must balance her job with her role as a mother – can she hide from her journalist husband and a detective hunting her?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Bo-na, Tae-sung, and their four-year-old daughter Yul are a typical happy and harmonious family. After a three-year parental leave, Bo-na returns to work and successfully completes her duties from day one, defying concerns. Meanwhile, Tae-sung, covering a drug case, learns a serial killer who disappeared four years ago has returned.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Tae-sung and the police are surprised by Kingfisher's return and resolve to finally apprehend Kingfisher for good this time. Tae-sung seeks information from Detective Dong-jin, who previously pursued Kingfisher. Meanwhile, a new employee appears at Bo-na's company, seemingly harboring an unknown secret.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hyun-nam tells Bo-na why she came to Durumi Electronics to find her. A Sales Team workshop takes place, and Bo-na spends time away from Tae-sung and Yul for the first time since her marriage. While enjoying an unexpectedly pleasant time, an unforeseen incident occurs at the accommodation.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: As Bo-na keeps working, Yul starts whining, and Bo-na struggles with balancing childcare and work. Meanwhile, people are enraged by child sex offender Pyo Gyu-cheol's release after serving his sentence. Tae-sung meets Dong-jin who is tracking Pyo Gyu-cheol. Dong-jin believes Pyo Gyu-cheol could be Kingfisher's new target.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Bo-na, knowing today is Tae-sung's family's memorial day, takes a half-day off and leaves early. She does her best, but her mother-in-law's berating continues. Misunderstandings build as Tae-sung helps her after work, leading to an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Tae-sung begins investigating the suspicious death of a construction worker.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Bo-na and her team travel to a Gangwon Province casino to prepare for a Client Meeting. When their plans hit a snag, Bo-na must step in for the Meeting herself. Tae-sung, investigating a construction worker's death, heads to the casino where Bo-na is, while probing the construction company's Chairman. Meanwhile, suspicious individuals appear around Bo-na's Meeting target.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Eight years ago, in World Cup-feverish Seoul, Bo-na's team holds a Meeting hidden. In the same building, chasing a pickpocket, Tae-sung attacked, collapsing. Bo-na finds him, calls 119. Four months later, Tae-sung awakens, meets Bo-na, falls for her. Bo-na, exhausted by her 16-year mission, plans to quit.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After discharge, Tae-sung retreats to a secluded mountain lodge, where he coincidentally reunites with Bo-na. Heavy snow isolates them, and only the two stay at the lodge for a while. Sharing food and enduring the cold, they open their hearts and start to love. Meanwhile, released vicious criminals, fearing Kingfisher, try to return to prison.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Sergei, Bo-na's childhood friend and a mercenary from Russia, reappears, and the truth of The Gosiwon Case in Haegong-dong from four years ago begins to surface. Bo-na investigates Sergei's return to Korea. Meanwhile, Dong-jin learns that Jang Eun-hak, the culprit who murdered his parents, has been paroled.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Monitoring paroled Jang Eun-hak, Dong-jin thwarts his renewed attempt at murder. A chase ensues, and Jang Eun-hak is eventually stopped by Kingfisher. This event prompts Tae-sung to resume writing articles about Kingfisher. Bo-na, despite her worries about these changes, decides to continue her own work.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Dong-jin recalls that Tae-sung's assailant and Kingfisher were in the same building in the past. He immediately proceeds with an interview with the assailant, during which he obtains a clue that Kingfisher might be a woman. Meanwhile, Bo-na catches her mother-in-law's Voice Phishing culprit and receives recognition from her mother-in-law. Although the family becomes harmonious, Tae-sung's anxiety steadily intensifies.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Bo-na's painful orphanage childhood surfaces, hinting at a past forged by violence and silence. Tae-sung faces a growing dilemma as doubts about someone close to him become harder to ignore. The task force closes in with a bold new lead, but an unseen hand seems to always stay one step ahead. What Tae-sung uncovers may destroy everything he loves.

items.title: The Mentalist
items.overview: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Patrick Jane is a celebrity psychic whose wife and child are viciously murdered by an elusive serial killer called Red John. Devastated, Patrick admits his paranormal act is fake, renounces his earlier life and uses his astonishing skills of observation and analysis - talents that made him appear psychically gifted - to bring killers to justice. At crime scenes across California, Patrick now helps an elite team of detectives break their toughest cases. But no matter how many criminals he catches, Patrick never forgets his central goal: Find Red John. And bring him down.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: CBI consultant Patrick Jane, Senior Agent Teresa Lisbon and her team investigate the double murder in Palm Springs of a pro golfer's wife and her doctor, which has the hallmarks of a serial killer with a personal connection to Jane.

episodes.name: Red Hair and Silver Tape
episodes.overview: While Lisbon and her team investigate the murder of a young waitress in the Napa Valley, Jane goes behind Lisbon's back to orchestrate his own undercover operation using Van Pelt as bait.

episodes.name: Red Tide
episodes.overview: When a high school girl's body washes up on the beach, Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap in order to get her surfing friends to turn on each other and reveal what really happened.

episodes.name: Ladies in Red
episodes.overview: When the team learns that a wealthy investment banker found murdered inside his locked safe room was living a dual life and skimming millions from clients, Patrick Jane sets up a mental conundrum to see which of the suspects will show their true colors.

episodes.name: Redwood
episodes.overview: When a girl is found covered in blood and holding the murder weapon that killed her best friend, she becomes an obvious suspect, though she can't remember anything. But Jane, believing she's innocent, engineers a risky maneuver in which she must relive the terrifying events in order to spark her memory.

episodes.name: Red Handed
episodes.overview: While investigating the case of a murdered casino owner, Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to ultimately entrap the killer, and win big at the card tables.

episodes.name: Seeing Red
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane goes head-to-head with a "psychic" he suspects of murder. Intent on proving the so-called psychic is a fraud -- as well as a killer -- Jane arranges a séance to expose the murderer.

episodes.name: The Thin Red Line
episodes.overview: While the police suspect a drug dealer on trial is behind the murders of the State's witness in his case, as well as his girlfriend, Patrick Jane sees a different motive for the crime -- as well as a different suspect.

episodes.name: Flame Red
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane suspects the only surviving member of a National Guard unit of murdering his friends - and goes undercover to prove it.

episodes.name: Red Brick and Ivy
episodes.overview: When a leading scientific researcher is killed by poisoning, Patrick Jane takes a personal interest in the case when he learns the prime suspect is the victim's wife - and Jane's former psychiatrist.

episodes.name: Red John's Friends
episodes.overview: Enticed by the promise from a convicted murder that he'll reveal information about Red John upon his release, Patrick Jane becomes singularly focused and quits the CBI in order to prove the prisoner is innocent.

episodes.name: Red Rum
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap to find out who is responsible for the murder of a high school boy who antagonized the local self-proclaimed witch by killing her cat.

episodes.name: Paint It Red
episodes.overview: While it appears obvious that a business tycoon's son-in-law was in on the robbery of a $50 million painting since his body is found where the painting once hung, Patrick Jane suspects others, including a Russian oil baron, an art forger and an art curator.

episodes.name: Crimson Casanova
episodes.overview: With Patrick Jane's help, Cho goes undercover as a sweet-talking ladies man with all the right moves in order to catch a pick-up artist and killer with his own set of pseudo-mentalist techniques.

episodes.name: Scarlett Fever
episodes.overview: As Jane and the team investigate the poisoning death of the "queen bee" in a country club, they discover that the community is full of secrets, including love affairs and drug abuse

episodes.name: Bloodshot
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane must rely on his other senses during the murder investigation of a financial advisor when he loses his sight as a result of an explosion.

episodes.name: Carnelian Inc.
episodes.overview: A story of greed and betrayal pits Patrick Jane against a group of financiers when the CBI investigates a series of murders at a corporate retreat in the wilds of the Sierra Nevada foothills.

episodes.name: Russet Potatoes
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team track down a mastermind who hypnotizes people into doing their bidding.

episodes.name: A Dozen Red Roses
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and the team go to Hollywood when they investigate the murder of a movie producer.

episodes.name: Red Sauce
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the murder of a mobster who was in the witness protection program.

episodes.name: Miss Red
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to play suspects off each other in order to solve the case of a wealthy software company CEO found murdered on his yacht.

episodes.name: Blood Brothers
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane must find a clever way to convince the troubled kids in a wilderness program to confide in him about what really happened surrounding the death of one of their peers.

episodes.name: Red John's Footsteps
episodes.overview: Lisbon fears that the serial killer Red John is drawing Patrick Jane into a trap when the CBI team investigates the murder of a young girl and the abduction of her twin sister.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: California Bureau of Investigation consultant Patrick Jane has a blatant lack of protocol but is self-assured and driven. The former "psychic" uses his talent for seeing the clues everyone else misses to solve the most baffling crimes. But there's more than crime: Lisbon and Cho reveal hints about their troubled pasts. Violence fells one CBI boss, and the new boss seems more interested in authority than teamwork. And as the Van Pelt-Rigsby relationship heats up, it threatens to cool down their careers.

episodes.name: Redemption
episodes.overview: Jane and Lisbon learn that the Red John case has been reassigned to a different CBI team led by the straight-shooting officer Sam Bosco.

episodes.name: The Scarlet Letter
episodes.overview: Lisbon and the team work the case of a State Senator's murdered intern, while Jane simultaneously tries to find out what new information Bosco has uncovered on the Red John case.

episodes.name: Red Badge
episodes.overview: Jane, Cho, Rigsby and Van Pelt decide to conduct their own investigation when Lisbon is accused of murdering a child molester she arrested who was recently paroled.

episodes.name: Red Menace
episodes.overview: Jane and the CBI investigate the murder of Gordon Hodge, a powerful attorney, who is responsible for allowing a vicious murderer, Van McBride, to walk away a free man.

episodes.name: Red Scare
episodes.overview: Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the death of a prominent architect found murdered in a crumbling old mansion, and there appears to be a number of suspects.

episodes.name: Black Gold and Red Blood
episodes.overview: Even after Bosco arrests Jane and puts him in prison for spying on him, Jane is able to help the CBI team from his cell to solve the murder of a young man.

episodes.name: Red Bulls
episodes.overview: Minelli orders Patrick Jane and Lisbon and company to play nice and work together with Bosco and his team to locate a kidnapped woman being held for ransom.

episodes.name: His Red Right Hand
episodes.overview: The CBI team is faced with a violent and shocking crime in their own office, but must work the case in spite of their alarm of who may be behind it. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Van Pelt are definitely an "item".

episodes.name: A Price Above Rubies
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and the team are called to investigate the robbery and murder of a wealthy jeweler while attending a black tie fundraiser for the CBI.

episodes.name: Throwing Fire
episodes.overview: While Jane and the team examine the crime scene where a baseball scout is found murdered, Jane is clocked in the head by a ball and flashes back to his childhood with his overbearing father.

episodes.name: Rose-Colored Glasses
episodes.overview: Jane and company investigate the murder of a man and his wife, on her way to his fifteen year high school reunion where, clearly, the attendees haven't changed all that much.

episodes.name: Bleeding Heart
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and the team investigate the murder of a mayor's aide, and Rigsby and Van Pelt make a big announcement.

episodes.name: Redline
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate when the body of a high-end luxury car sales woman is found in the trunk of a Bentley in the dealership's showroom.

episodes.name: Blood In, Blood Out
episodes.overview: When a member of Cho's former gang, the Avon Park Playboys, is found murdered, Patrick Jane insists on helping Cho with his off-the-books investigation.

episodes.name: Red Herring
episodes.overview: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an arrogant chef during a cooking competition in Napa Valley.

episodes.name: Code Red
episodes.overview: When Dr. Alicia Seberg, a government research scientist, is exposed to a deadly toxin while at work and has only hours to live, she calls Patrick Jane and the CBI to find her murderer.

episodes.name: The Red Box
episodes.overview: Patrick and the CBI team investigate the murder of a tutor, and find a mysterious little red box near the body, starting a chain of events that turns the murder into the search for a priceless ring stolen from the British Museum. Meanwhile, Lisbon is worried when a new boss, Madeleine Hightower, takes command of the CBI, as well as mysteriously learning about Rigsby and Van Pelt's relationship.

episodes.name: Aingavite Baa
episodes.overview: When a "Jane Doe" with amnesia and covered in blood steps in front of Cho and Van Pelt's car, Patrick Jane must use all of his skills to discover who she is, her last location and why she lost her memory

episodes.name: Blood Money
episodes.overview: When Patrick Jane's sneaky conduct causes the case of a confessed hitman to be tossed out of court, his annoyed CBI team must start the investigation over from scratch.

episodes.name: Red All Over
episodes.overview: When a media mogul is murdered, Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate cult leader Bret Stiles, who may have had an axe to grind following the publication of a critical story about his group.
Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the death of a mathematical genius by a gun-wielding clown.

episodes.name: Red Letter
episodes.overview: Romantic sparks begin to fly when Patrick Jane and supposed psychic Kristina Frye cross paths again during the CBI investigation into the murder of a charismatic head of a non-profit organization that fights human trafficking.

episodes.name: Red Sky in the Morning
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and Kristina's first date is interrupted by a report of Red John striking again, which is discovered to be a copycat. But when Kristina reaches out to the real Red John, both she and Jane find themselves in grave danger.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Red John strikes into the heart of the CBI. Ever since the serial killer murdered Patrick Jane's family, the California Bureau of Investigation consultant and former faux-psychic has become obsessed with finding the man who destroyed his life. But after a homocide suspect is set ablaze in his jail cell and a CBI agent is later framed as Red John, Patrick realizes his adversary is closer than he imagined.

episodes.name: Red Sky at Night
episodes.overview: When the CBI investigates the kidnapping of a prominent lawyer and state house lobbyist, the CBI Director wants Jane on the case, but he is uncertain of his future with the unit after his encounter with Red John.

episodes.name: Cackle-Bladder Blood
episodes.overview: When Jane's brother-in-law returns to town and gets mixed up in a murder investigation, Jane must come to his aid despite personal reservations.

episodes.name: The Blood on His Hands
episodes.overview: When Patrick Jane faces off once again with cult leader Bret Stiles, Stiles offers Jane information regarding Red John and the missing Kristina Frye.

episodes.name: Red Carpet Treatment
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the murder of a convict who served nine years for rape and murder, but was recently released on DNA evidence.

episodes.name: The Red Ponies
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team hit the horse track when a jockey is found murdered and suspects abound.

episodes.name: Pink Chanel Suit
episodes.overview: The case of a murder and missing person on an intensely secure wealthy family's compound perplexes Jane and the CBI team.

episodes.name: Red Hot
episodes.overview: Jane and the CBI team narrowly escape a fiery end when a building explodes while they're investigating a death threat. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and billionaire Walter Mashburn when they meet again while on the case.

episodes.name: Ball of Fire
episodes.overview: When Jane is kidnapped, Lisbon and the team realize there are many suspects who might want to harm him.

episodes.name: Red Moon
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane accepts the help of a local astrologer, Ellis Mars, to solve the puzzling case of a triple homicide that involves two policemen and the fiancé of an EMT worker.

episodes.name: Jolly Red Elf
episodes.overview: The CBI pursues two lines of investigation when a Santa is murdered: Patrick Jane goes undercover in an AA group; and Rigsby and Van Pelt question members of an authentic Santa society. Meanwhile, following the demise of a person in custody at the CBI, J.J. LaRoche is brought in to question the team when it appears to be an inside job.

episodes.name: Bloodsport
episodes.overview: Patrick and the team investigate the murder of a woman with ties to one of the fighters. Meanwhile, LaRoche focuses his investigation on Rigsby, who in turn is forced to ask Cho for a huge favor in order to keep his job.

episodes.name: Bloodhounds
episodes.overview: When Patrick Jane and the CBI must work with a criminal profiler, Dr. Montague, to solve a double murder, it becomes a competition for Jane to prove that his methods are superior.

episodes.name: Red Alert
episodes.overview: When Patrick Jane and others are taken hostage by an armed man accused of murder, Jane must think quickly to defuse the situation.

episodes.name: Blood for Blood
episodes.overview: Van Pelt's actions are called into question when a witness is murdered while she is assigned to his protection.

episodes.name: Red Gold
episodes.overview: When a modern-day prospector is found dead near a mining site and Lisbon is injured during the initial stages of the investigation, Agent Hightower joins Patrick Jane in the field for the first time.

episodes.name: Red Queen
episodes.overview: Evidence in the murder of an antiques dealer found dead in a museum indicates that the suspect may be a member of the CBI team.

episodes.name: Bloodstream
episodes.overview: After a doctor is found dead at a golf course, the CBI team searches for a killer amongst a hospital's staff and patients. Meanwhile, when LaRoche is placed in charge of the CBI, his first act of business is to name Cho the new team leader.

episodes.name: The Red Mile
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team must track down the killer of a man who believed he experienced an alien abduction - even after the victim's body is stolen from the coroner's van. Meanwhile, Van Pelt takes a break from the case to shop for wedding dresses.

episodes.name: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane sets out to prove a beautiful yet manipulative matchmaker shot and killed her husband after his body is found floating in the marina.

episodes.name: Redacted
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane must deal with two failed robbery attempts: one resulting in the murder of a repair shop owner and the other involving a former suspect personally hired by Jane to break into LaRoche's home.

episodes.name: Like a Redheaded Stepchild
episodes.overview: When a prison guard is stabbed to death outside of a jewelry store, Patrick Jane suspects one of the guard's inmates is the killer. Meanwhile, Rigsby questions his own father about the murder.

episodes.name: Rhapsody in Red
episodes.overview: After a young violinist is shot to death, Patrick Jane questions the members of the Northern California Symphony Orchestra about the murder. Meanwhile, Cho crosses paths with a precocious young pickpocket.

episodes.name: Strawberries and Cream (1)
episodes.overview: A robber with a bomb attached to him is blown up in front of a convenience store, and CBI soon discovers that there may be connections between this case and Red John and agent Hightower.

episodes.name: Strawberries and Cream (2)
episodes.overview: Patrick trades Hightower's secret location to Laroche for the four remaining names on his list. The team then sets up a trap to uncover Red John's real informant, leading to a possible face-to-face showdown between Patrick and Red John.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Patrick Jane was arrested for the public murder of the man he believes is the notorious serial killer Red John, who murdered his wife and daughter. Unless, of course, the man Patrick shot is someone else. With an upstart new boss, puzzling new cases, and Red John never far from his mind, the unconventional Patrick will need all his razor-sharp skills of observation, manipulative theatrics and smooth charm to sidestep the system that stands in the way of the truth.

episodes.name: Scarlet Ribbons
episodes.overview: In prison for killing his nemesis, Patrick Jane must prove that the man he shot really was Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon urges Van Pelt to seek counseling in the aftermath of the death of her fiancé.

episodes.name: Little Red Book
episodes.overview: With Lisbon suspended and the rest of the team reassigned, Jane is reinstated as a CBI consultant and forced to work with a new team. During the investigation, Jane conspires to bring his former team back together.

episodes.name: Pretty Red Balloon
episodes.overview: When the son of a former client from Jane's days as a psychic is kidnapped, Jane and the CBI team are asked to help find him. Meanwhile, Jane butts heads with his former client's new "spiritual advisor."

episodes.name: Ring Around the Rosie
episodes.overview: Jane notices a suspicious-looking man carrying a gun at a political rally and sets out to prove he's a psychopath on the brink of committing murder. Meanwhile, Lisbon investigates the death of a photographer at the same rally.

episodes.name: Blood and Sand
episodes.overview: The CBI team investigates the murder of a woman whose corpse washed up on an island off the coast of California. Rigsby worries that his relationship with a public defender will create awkwardness between him and Van Pelt.

episodes.name: Where in the World Is Carmine O'Brien?
episodes.overview: When the CBI team travels to a resort town to find out who murdered a police chief, Lisbon crosses paths with her brother Tommy, now a bounty hunter, who's tracking a bail jumper.

episodes.name: Blinking Red Light
episodes.overview: The search for a serial killer hits close to home for Jane when he encounters a blogger who has devoted his life to finding the killer.

episodes.name: Pink Tops
episodes.overview: In order to find the killer of an undercover narcotics cop, Jane and the CBI team retrace her investigation.

episodes.name: The Redshirt
episodes.overview: Jane and the CBI investigate when a retired NFL star quarterback is presumed dead after his car blows up. Meanwhile, while preparing for a court case, Rigsby and Harrigan take their relationship to the next level.

episodes.name: Fugue in Red
episodes.overview: During the search for a firefighter's killer, Jane is attacked and nearly drowned, resulting in a temporary loss of his memory and a return to his pre-CBI con man persona.

episodes.name: Always Bet on Red
episodes.overview: Jane and the CBI team narrow down the long list of suspects after a high-end divorce attorney, with many enemies, is killed on his speed boat. Meanwhile, Jane is questioned by Agent Darcy about whether Red John was responsible for Panzer's murder.

episodes.name: My Bloody Valentine
episodes.overview: With very little evidence, Jane and the CBI investigate the death of a mob boss’ son. Meanwhile, while taking an eyewitness in for questioning, Van Pelt is haunted by the memories of O’Laughlin’s shooting.

episodes.name: Red Is the New Black
episodes.overview: Jane and the CBI narrow down the list of suspects after a disgraced clothing designer on the verge of a comeback becomes a fashion victim. Meanwhile, FBI Agent Darcy continues her investigation into finding Red John.

episodes.name: At First Blush
episodes.overview: While a jury deliberates the guilt or innocence of a defendant on trial for murder, Jane tries to prove she has been wrongfully accused before time runs out. Meanwhile, Summer may have gone too far when she helps Cho make a case against a suspect.

episodes.name: War of the Roses
episodes.overview: When a charity worker is killed, Jane has Erica Flynn, a murderer he helped imprison, furloughed in exchange for information she claims to have about the case. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Sarah try to adjust to impending parenthood.

episodes.name: His Thoughts Were Red Thoughts
episodes.overview: Jane is reunited with his former nemesis, cult leader Bret Stiles, when the head of an anti-cult activist organization is murdered.

episodes.name: Cheap Burgundy
episodes.overview: Jane suspects that Agent Susan Darcy has ulterior motives when she asks for his help with a homicide investigation. Meanwhile, the CBI team handles the murder of a young woman who was killed after meeting someone in an online chat room.

episodes.name: Ruddy Cheeks
episodes.overview: Jane and the CBI try to narrow down the list of suspects when a terminally ill man, is found murdered. Meanwhile, Cho is forced to face his demons.

episodes.name: Pink Champagne on Ice
episodes.overview: While investigating the murder of a casino employee, Jane runs into a stage magician he used to tour with during his time as a mentalist and discovers he is hiding a shocking secret.

episodes.name: Something's Rotten in Redmund
episodes.overview: Jane and the CBI try to determine who would have reason to kill a popular English teacher, and Rigsby nervously awaits a special delivery.

episodes.name: Ruby Slippers
episodes.overview: Jane and the CBI try to find the killer of a man found outside a cabaret featuring female impersonators. During the investigation they discover a list of suspects, all of whom bullied the victim. Meanwhile, Cho and Summer hide their relationship from Lisbon.

episodes.name: So Long, and Thanks for All the Red Snapper
episodes.overview: While investigating the murder of a surfer, Lisbon reconnects with her former fiancé, Kenny Johnson, who she hasn't seen in over a decade. Also, Cho questions his decision to be in a relationship with Summer.

episodes.name: Red Rover, Red Rover
episodes.overview: On the ninth anniversary of his wife and daughter's death, Jane receives a message from Red John, causing Jane to lose focus on his current case and put the investigation and his career at the CBI in jeopardy

episodes.name: The Crimson Hat
episodes.overview: After another failed attempt to defeat Red John, Patrick Jane hits rock bottom, finds a lover and shoots one of his own.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview:
The assault, narcotics and fraud charges against Patrick Jane have been dropped and it's back to business as usual. Or business as unusual for Jane, who uses mind games, tricks and his super sharp skills of observation to solve the state's most puzzling homocides.

Jane's obsession with finding Red John consumes him every waking moment, drawing him outside the law and closer than ever to the serial killer's true identity. But when Homeland Security and the FBI team up with the CBI on the case, Jane's unorthodox methods antagonize even his most loyal allies. Can Jane's skill and charm continue to see him through? How far is too far?

episodes.name: The Crimson Ticket
episodes.overview: While Jane tries to decipher Lorelei’s connection to Red John, the CBI team is forced to partner with the FBI to solve the murder of a hotel employee.

episodes.name: Devil's Cherry
episodes.overview: While the team investigates the murder of a diamond cutter, Jane meets a girl who claims to be his late daughter, Charlotte.

episodes.name: Not One Red Cent
episodes.overview: A bank employee is murdered during a heist and Jane and the team must work to track down the killer. Meanwhile, Lisbon is pulled deeper into the CBI/FBI rivalry.

episodes.name: Blood Feud
episodes.overview: When Rigsby’s father is found injured at a crime scene, the team must find out if it is the result of a long-standing small-town gang war.

episodes.name: Red Dawn
episodes.overview: See how Jane met Lisbon and the rest of the CBI team for the first time.

episodes.name: Cherry Picked
episodes.overview: The team investigates the kidnapping of a couple that may be the victim of mistaken identity, while Jane continues his investigation into Lorelei's whereabouts.

episodes.name: If It Bleeds, It Leads
episodes.overview: The team investigates the murder of a reporter who may have become too close to her story, while Jane insists on pursuing his own leads to find Lorelei.

episodes.name: Red Sails in the Sunset
episodes.overview: With the help of Brett Stiles, Jane orchestrates an elaborate plan to break Lorelei Martins out of prison in the hopes of her leading him to Red John.

episodes.name: Black Cherry
episodes.overview: The CBI team investigates the murder of a real estate agent with former gang ties, while Jane searches for leads on his new connection to Red John.

episodes.name: Panama Red
episodes.overview: The death of a young botanist leads the team into the lucrative world of medical marijuana, while Cho’s work with the rapid response team brings him back into contact with Summer.

episodes.name: Days of Wine and Roses
episodes.overview: The CBI team visits a high-end California rehab center in order to investigate the death of a young model who was a patient there, while Lisbon ramps up her investigation into Tommy Volker.

episodes.name: Little Red Corvette
episodes.overview: The CBI investigates the death of a geologist, which Lisbon is convinced is the key to bringing down Tommy Volker.

episodes.name: The Red Barn
episodes.overview: The team investigates a 25-year-old case that seems to involve both Red John and the Visualize group, and Lisbon contemplates her future.

episodes.name: Red in Tooth and Claw
episodes.overview: The team delves into the surprisingly cutthroat world of academics in a case involving a graduate student at a natural history museum.

episodes.name: Red Lacquer Nail Polish
episodes.overview: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an elderly heiress whose remains are found in the living room of her spooky mansion.

episodes.name: There Will Be Blood
episodes.overview: Lorelei Martins returns, determined to find out if Red John had a role in her sister's death, and Jane is forced to confess to Lisbon his part in Lorelei's prison escape.

episodes.name: Red, White and Blue
episodes.overview: The CBI team investigates when the body of a female army medic who worked with soldiers with PTSD is found near a military base.

episodes.name: Behind the Red Curtain
episodes.overview: The CBI team investigates when the young lead of a local theater production dies on the eve of the opening. Meanwhile, Jane hopes to get more information about Red John from the comatose Jason Lennon.

episodes.name: Red Letter Day
episodes.overview: The CBI team heads out to a run-down Wild West tourist town to investigate the death of the town's owner. Meanwhile, Kirkland tries to uncover the extent of Jane's knowledge about Red John.

episodes.name: Red Velvet Cupcakes
episodes.overview: Rigsby and Van Pelt go undercover as a couple with relationship problems to investigate the death of a woman who received advice from a radio love doctor.

episodes.name: Red and Itchy
episodes.overview: J.J. LaRoche personally requests Jane’s help when the mysterious container he’s been hiding for nine years is stolen from his home.

episodes.name: Red John's Rules
episodes.overview: Just as Jane narrows down the Red John suspect list to seven, Red John strikes again, and the victim has a link to Jane’s past.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Armed with a list of seven suspects, confirmed by the killer himself, Patrick Jane and the CBI team are closing in on the elusive serial killer while continuing to solve California's most puzzling crimes. Could Red John be a cult leader? A ghoulish forensic analyst? A super-suspicious Homeland Security Agent? Or one of four law officials, including the director of the CBI himself? The identity of the man who killed Patrick Jane's family is finally revealed in a climactic showdown - but that's not the end of the story! When the CBI shuttered, Jane, Lisbon and the team partner with the FBI to tackle a whole new slew of mysteries... including vicious attack on former CBI members.

episodes.name: The Desert Rose
episodes.overview: Jane and Lisbon secretly continue their mission to narrow down the list of seven Red John suspects as they investigate the murder of a man who was missing for two years.

episodes.name: Black-Winged Redbird
episodes.overview: Jane discovers an important clue to Red John's methods as the team  encounters four of the suspects, and the CBI investigates the case of a  software engineer killed by a drone strike.

episodes.name: Wedding in Red
episodes.overview: Jane gets the CBI involved in a case in Napa in order to focus on Sheriff McAllister, while Van Pelt and Rigsby take a trip down the aisle.

episodes.name: Red Listed
episodes.overview: Jane reveals that a list of fake Red John suspects he planted was stolen, and the team realizes these men are in danger.

episodes.name: The Red Tattoo
episodes.overview: When a prominent member of Visualize is mysteriously killed, Jane investigates in the hopes that the case will provide a clue that will lead him to Red John.

episodes.name: Fire and Brimstone
episodes.overview: With the final clue in hand, Jane attempts to gather the remaining Red John suspects in one place in hopes of finally revealing his identity.

episodes.name: The Great Red Dragon
episodes.overview: Following the shocking events at Jane's house, the Red John list is  narrowed down further, and the CBI's priority is the remaining suspects.

episodes.name: Red John
episodes.overview: Patrick Jane finally comes face-to-face with Red John, the serial killer he’s tracked since the madman murdered his wife and daughter. For 10 years, Jane has doggedly hunted his nemesis in his search for justice.

episodes.name: My Blue Heaven
episodes.overview: Two years after the Red John case was  put to rest, Jane's newfound  peace is interrupted by a surprising job offer that could change  everything for him.

episodes.name: Green Thumb
episodes.overview: The FBI reluctantly enlists Jane’s help to find a missing computer programmer, but he won’t help unless Lisbon is brought on board as well.

episodes.name: White Lines
episodes.overview: The FBI is tasked with finding the killer of several DEA agents, and Jane goes on a date with a beautiful woman associated with the case.

episodes.name: The Golden Hammer
episodes.overview: Jane and the FBI investigate the murder of a high-tech cartographer who may have unearthed a spy ring before his death. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Van Pelt find themselves on the trail of an alarming conspiracy.

episodes.name: Black Helicopters
episodes.overview: Jane's investigation leads him to join a separatist commune after a U.S.  attorney is found dead in Mexico, even though there's no record of her  crossing  the border.  Also, Rigsby and Van Pelt convince J.J. LaRoche to  help them discover who is stalking former CBI members.

episodes.name: Grey Water
episodes.overview: Jane and Fischer investigate a murder at an oil fracking site, while Rigsby and Van Pelt travel to Austin to help investigate suspects in the string of attacks on former CBI team members.

episodes.name: White as the Driven Snow
episodes.overview: Grace is kidnapped by the killer who has been hunting former CBI members, but when the prime suspect appears to have an airtight alibi, Jane must rely on all his skills to locate her before time runs out.

episodes.name: Violets
episodes.overview: Jane enlists his colleagues in a dangerous sting operation to catch a deadly team of art thieves. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and an agent from the FBI’s art squad.

episodes.name: Silver Wings of Time
episodes.overview: Jane and the FBI take up the cause of a death row inmate who has two days to prove his innocence before his sentence is carried out.

episodes.name: Forest Green
episodes.overview: When a woman is found murdered near a remote men’s social club, Jane must find a way to insinuate himself into the insular group to find the killer.

episodes.name: Brown Eyed Girls
episodes.overview: A chance encounter with a suspicious-looking individual leads Jane and Lisbon to uncover a vast human smuggling ring. Meanwhile, Lisbon remains tempted by Pike’s offer to move to D.C. with him.

episodes.name: Il Tavolo Bianco
episodes.overview: Jane’s freedom is at stake when a grand jury is empanelled to decide if he should be tried for the murder of Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon tries to find out how Jane feels about the possibility of her leaving Austin with Agent Pike, and Cho and Abbott follow new leads in the human smuggling ring they recently uncovered.

episodes.name: Black Hearts
episodes.overview: With time running out to save the victims of a kidnapping ring before they are transported overseas, Jane and Lisbon zero in on the criminal enterprise’s mastermind. Meanwhile, Lisbon decides if she will move to D.C. with Agent Pike.

episodes.name: Blue Bird
episodes.overview: A new lead in a cold case requires Lisbon to delay her plans to leave for Washington, D.C., giving Jane time to finally come to terms with his feelings for her and decide on a course of action.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: With serial killer Red John laid to rest, Patrick Jane is finally free to close the door on his past and plan for the future. A fresh start with the FBI has him solving top-security cases alongside former CBI agents Teresa Lisbon and Kimball Cho, new colleagues Jason Wylie and Michelle Vega, and boss Agent Dennis Abbott. And Jane's blossoming connection with Lisbon brings a deeper bond to the partners' already intimate and intense professional relationship. But when femme fatale Erica Flynn resurfaces from Jane's past and another sadistic serial killer appears on the scene, affairs of the heart take a backseat to survival.

episodes.name: Nothing But Blue Skies
episodes.overview: Jane and Lisbon decide to keep their new relationship a secret from  their colleagues as they investigate the murder of an undercover agent.  Also, young, ambitious agent Michelle Vega joins the team.

episodes.name: The Greybar Hotel
episodes.overview: Lisbon goes undercover as a prison inmate in order to get a convict to turn on her boyfriend, who is the leader of a high-end car theft ring.

episodes.name: Orange Blossom Ice Cream
episodes.overview: Jane and Lisbon travel to Beirut where they must work with Jane's familiar adversary Erica Flynn, who agrees to help the FBI apprehend her boyfriend, a courier for terrorist organizations, in exchange for amnesty for her past crimes.

episodes.name: Black Market
episodes.overview: The team investigates a murder linked to a counterfeit diamond operation, but an illness forces Jane to direct his colleagues from the office as he recuperates. Meanwhile, Abbott is concerned that transgressions in his past could harm his wife’s chance to obtain a prestigious job in Washington, D.C.

episodes.name: The Silver Briefcase
episodes.overview: A chance encounter with a military colonel leads Jane to believe the soldier is hiding something, leading him to dig into closed murder case of the man’s wife.

episodes.name: Green Light
episodes.overview: The team is brought in to consult on a botched DEA raid, but when Abbott’s former boss tries to blackmail him into keeping the agency’s missteps quiet, Abbott is forced to choose between his career and his morals.

episodes.name: Little Yellow House
episodes.overview: A murder investigation becomes personal for Lisbon when she learns that her underachieving younger brother, Jimmy, is being sought as a key witness.

episodes.name: The Whites of His Eyes
episodes.overview: Jane worries for Lisbon’s safety when the team puts itself in the line of fire to protect the witness in a murder investigation from a skilled assassin.

episodes.name: Copper Bullet
episodes.overview: When Abbott's old boss, Agent Peterson, threatens Abbott's career - and possibly his freedom - Jane devises a risky plan to protect his friend's  future.

episodes.name: Nothing Gold Can Stay
episodes.overview: Jane takes extreme measures as the team tries to apprehend a deadly gang of armored car robbers before their desperation to remain free costs more innocent people their lives.

episodes.name: Byzantium
episodes.overview: A young man claiming to have psychic powers offers his help to the FBI in solving a pair of murders, but when he leads them to additional victims, Jane and the team begin to suspect that he is in fact the killer they're hunting.

episodes.name: Brown Shag Carpet
episodes.overview: Jane agrees to once again pretend to be a renowned psychic and be used as bait in an attempt to lure out a serial killer and give the FBI a chance to apprehend him.

episodes.name: White Orchids
episodes.overview: Lisbon accepts Jane's surprise marriage proposal, but a killer's quest for revenge may cost them the happy ending they've worked so hard to achieve.

items.title: My Bias, My Boss
items.overview: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A rookie employee joins her favorite idol's agency, transforming from a fan into his most trusted employee.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: To work beside her idol, Chan, Da-reum joins startup APPELLO but instead faces a prickly, suspicious CEO.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Da-reum aims to be employee of the year in order to travel with her idol, Chan, but her enthusiasm only triggers her CEO's deep suspicions.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Da-reum makes a shocking confession.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Da-reum finds herself caught in a love triangle.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Ha-gi and Da-reum grow closer on a secret business trip.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A major shift changes everything after the season's first snow.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Ha-gi prepares to confess his true feelings -- only to be blindsided at the crucial moment.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: A harsh boycott throws the company into chaos.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Ha-gi and Da-reum's secret office romance is put to the test.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Jeong-yeon's return sparks jealousy, while a shocking discovery pushes Da-reum to the edge.

items.title: Reacher
items.overview: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Based on "Killing Floor," when retired Military Police Officer Jack Reacher is arrested for a murder he did not commit, he finds himself in the middle of a deadly conspiracy full of dirty cops, shady businessmen and scheming politicians. With nothing but his wits, he must figure out what is happening in Margrave, Georgia.

episodes.name: Welcome to Margrave
episodes.overview: Reacher is wrongly accused of murder while visiting the small town of Margrave, GA.

episodes.name: First Dance
episodes.overview: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

episodes.name: Spoonful
episodes.overview: Reacher and Finlay’s investigation into the missing Spivey leads them into a confrontation with Kliner Sr. Roscoe learns unsettling news about Reacher.

episodes.name: In a Tree
episodes.overview: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

episodes.name: No Apologies
episodes.overview: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: Papier
episodes.overview: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

episodes.name: Reacher Said Nothing
episodes.overview: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

episodes.name: Pie
episodes.overview: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Based on "Bad Luck and Trouble," when members of Reacher's old military unit start turning up dead, Reacher has just one thing on his mind—revenge.

episodes.name: ATM
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley investigate the murder of a member of 110th, a group of Special investigators assembled by Reacher, only to realize the whole unit may be at risk.

episodes.name: What Happens in Atlantic City
episodes.overview: The investigation into Franz's murder takes Reacher and the surviving members of his former Army unit to Atlantic City where the mystery deepens, danger awaits, and an old flame is rekindled.

episodes.name: Picture Says a Thousand Words
episodes.overview: After more of his friends fall victim, Reacher forges an uneasy alliance with a dogged detective, and their only clue in the case leads the 110th to a troubling discovery.

episodes.name: A Night at the Symphony
episodes.overview: Reacher and his team head to Boston to track down a political aide with insider knowledge of a top secret military-defense contract that may be the reason behind their friends' deaths.

episodes.name: Burial
episodes.overview: Neagley and Dixon discover shocking information about an old friend in Denver while Reacher and O'Donnell learn more about the nefarious and mysterious A.M..

episodes.name: New York's Finest
episodes.overview: As the mystery continues to unfold, Reacher and his team set a trap to even the score.

episodes.name: The Man Goes Through
episodes.overview: As the team close in on Langston, two members of the 110th face danger, compelling Reacher to devise a dangerous plan to rescue them.

episodes.name: Fly Boy
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley make a final desperate attempt to save O’Donnell and Dixon, stop A.M. and avenge their friends’ murder.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Based on "Persuader," Reacher hurtles into the dark heart of a vast criminal enterprise when trying to rescue an undercover DEA informant whose time is running out. There he finds a world of secrecy and violence—and confronts some unfinished business from his own past.

episodes.name: Persuader
episodes.overview: Reacher’s attempt to thwart a kidnapping brings him into contact with mysterious businessman Zachary Beck.

episodes.name: Truckin'
episodes.overview: Tasked with transporting cargo for his new employer Zachary Beck, Reacher must juggle the involvement of the DEA and a nosy new associate.

episodes.name: Number 2 with a Bullet
episodes.overview: As a rising body count threatens his undercover position, Reacher makes a dangerous play to secure Beck’s trust.

episodes.name: Dominique
episodes.overview: Reacher reunites with Duffy and Villanueva and finally shares the painful details of his history with Xavier Quinn.

episodes.name: Smackdown
episodes.overview: When a DEA tragedy puts the entire mission at risk, Reacher, Duffy, and Villanueva improvise a drastic plan to save their cover.

episodes.name: Smoke on the Water
episodes.overview: Reacher is torn between his desire to kill Quinn and his promise to Duffy to save Teresa.

episodes.name: L.A. Story
episodes.overview: After Reacher and Duffy travel to Los Angeles to arrange a deal, Neagley arrives in Maine to help Reacher get answers.

episodes.name: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Reacher finally faces off with both Paulie and Quinn.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview:
Suicide bombers are easy to spot. They give out all kinds of tell-tale signs. Mostly because they're nervous. By definition they're all first-timers. There are twelve things to look for. No one who has worked in law enforcement will ever forget them.

New York City. The subway, two o'clock in the morning. Jack Reacher studies his fellow passengers. Four are OK. The fifth isn't. The train brakes for Grand Central Station. Will Reacher intervene, and save lives? Or is he wrong? Will his intervention cost lives - including his own?

episodes.name: City of Brotherly Love
episodes.overview: A chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a Philadelphia subway car draws Jack Reacher into a deadly mystery involving a missing flash drive that contains secrets worth killing for.

episodes.name: Cage Fight
episodes.overview: Tamara finds herself caught up in the mystery whether she likes it or not as she, Reacher, and Jacob face off against shady government agents and a mysterious squad of professional soldiers all looking for the same missing flash drive.

episodes.name: One Small Step
episodes.overview: Reacher learns that things are more complex than they seem as he and Lila draw closer. Meanwhile, Tamara, Jacob, and Plum find an important clue after another attack from one of their mysterious adversaries sends them back to Philadelphia.

episodes.name: Karambits and Pieces
episodes.overview: Reacher interrogates Sampson, Tamara breaks into a government facility, Jacob receives some crushing news and the team learns a piece of information that changes everything.

episodes.name: Bridge
episodes.overview: After a misunderstanding, Reacher becomes Philadelphia's Most Wanted. Meanwhile, old enemies catch up with him and new ones emerge. Jacob, Tamara and Plum end up in a firefight, giving Jacob his first real shot at avenging his sister's death.

episodes.name: Plum Out of Luck
episodes.overview: Fleeing the police, Reacher and Tamara head out-of-town to find the mysterious Ahlquist only to run into more trouble. Meanwhile, Jacob and Plum deal with their own problems back in Philadelphia.

items.title: Flex x Cop
items.overview: A chaebol cop joins forces with a gritty detective to take down criminals with a touch of wealth and a whole lot of wit.
items.tagline: Money vs money. Power vs power.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Jin Yi-soo, a privileged heir, joins a police force specializing in robbery cases, leveraging his wealth and connections, but clashes with his no-nonsense partner, Detective Lee Kang-hyun.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Jin Isoo, the naïve heir of Hansu Group, gets into a fight with a stranger and Ganghyun arrests him.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A model is found dead on a yacht. Isoo gets his first murder case and investigates with Ganghyun.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The team finds the key suspect in the model murder case. However, other suspects come to light.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A famous painter has been murdered in an art gallery. Meanwhile, Yi Soo visits his childhood home.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Yi Soo captures the prime suspect in the painter's case, and he learns something unexpected.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The death of an elderly is all but simple. Kang Hyun works to prove it, and Yi Soo seeks other methods.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A bizarre body is found in an office. Isoo and Ganghyun start investigating the mysterious death.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: A man is caught at the suspect's house. Isoo investigates the link between the found item and death.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Isoo recovers memories with hypnosis and looks for Myeongchul. Meanwhile, an actress is found dead.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Isoo and Ganghyun discover the actress had a stalker and was harassed by him before her death.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: The sudden death of two people affiliated with Oryunhoe. Ganghyun tries to uncover the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Isoo encounters Ganghyun at Oryunhoe, and they face a crisis of being exposed to the cult leader.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: An unknown body is found in Myeongchul's backyard amidst the election. Isoo investigates the case.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: The team arrests the suspect in the case. Meanwhile, Isoo discovers secrets within the household.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Shocked by unexpected news, Isoo is tormented. Meanwhile, Ganghyun investigates to help Isoo.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Truths start to unfold about his mother's death. Isoo is confronted with an unbearable reality.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Following a gruelling stint at the police academy, where his unruly nature frequently clashed with that of his hellish drill instructor, Isoo returns to work as a fully-fledged police officer, only to discover that his former instructor, Joo Hyera, is now the new leader of the violent crimes team. And as if that wasn't bad enough - the pair are now partners!

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While filming a documentary, Isoo receives an anonymous threat: "Detective Jin. Let the game begin."

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After a string of attacks, Isoo flees to a safe house. The bomber's final message: "FINAL ROUND."

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Isoo and Hyera investigate a haunted house tip. They're attacked and wake up bound inside the house.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Five bodies are found in the abandoned house. Violent Crime Investigation Team 1 begins the hunt.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A concierge is found dead in a hotel room on White Day. Could this be a crime of passion?

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: While questioning the concierge's murder suspect, the hotel owner disappears. The team gives chase...

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A magician dies in a fire onstage. Isoo and Hyera are stunned to meet a man with his exact face.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The boss of the Hammurabi gang emerges as a new suspect. Isoo devises a plan to confront him.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Hyera tells Isoo she's hunting a serial killer. A arts student is found dead in a bizarre state.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: With the victim's three friends as suspects, Isoo works to decode the dying message.

items.title: Our Sticky Love
items.overview: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Go Eun-sae wakes up in the hospital with no recollection of who she is. Suddenly, scruffy-looking Jang Tae-ha shows up claiming to be her boyfriend.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: From quirky villagers to shady little details, everything feels off to Eun-sae — especially Tae-ha. Later, she tries to figure out if he can be trusted.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Tae-ha takes Eun-sae on a fun day out to cheer her up. However, news starts to get back to mafia boss Baek Sang-gil about what happened with Eun-sae.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Eun-sae heads to Seoul in search of answers, only to be confronted with the ugly truth about who she used to be — and the painful past of Tae-ha.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Eun-sae and Tae-ha's relationship grows sweeter, but some sticky encounters with Tae-ha's old friends put their newfound intimacy to the test.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Tiny misunderstandings snowball into wild rumors all over town. The village trio tries to fix it, only to worsen things — and Eun-sae corners Tae-ha.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: When Eun-sae vanishes, the village searches for her. Meanwhile, her doctor An Gi-jun turns up at Tae-ha's door at night with questions about her past.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Sang-gil finally realizes what Tae-ha has done. Realizing Eun-sae's safety is in danger, Tae-ha makes plans to help her escape.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: With her memories revived, Eun-sae buckles down on her plan to go after Sang-gil. But her very existence now puts the whole town in danger — Tae-ha included.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Eun-sae busies herself with putting Sang-gil away. But with Eun-sae held up at work, Tae-ha wonders if there's any space left for him in her life.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Tae-ha and Eun-sae reunite with everyone in the village, but things take a turn when Sang-gil shows up — only to discover a shocking truth.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Tae-ha confronts Sang-gil to save his grandmother. Despite Sang-gil's constant threats, will Tae-ha and Eun-sae stay happily stuck together forever?

items.title: A Shop for Killers
items.overview: A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.
items.tagline: His hidden past, her deadly inheritance.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After the sudden death of Jian's uncle, she learns of a suspicious shopping mall that he left behind. Who was her uncle, and what kind of shopping mall did he run? Before Jian can even fathom what is going on, she is attacked by unidentified people who are after her uncle's supplies.

episodes.name: Murthehelp
episodes.overview: Ji-an, who is helplessly attacked in her own home, dodges the flying bullets.

episodes.name: Jeong Jin-man, Jeong Jin-man, Jeong Jin-man
episodes.overview: Jin-man receives an unexpected call; Ji-an, who is alone at home, is pursued by unidentified men.

episodes.name: The Strong Don't Howl
episodes.overview: Ji-an finds herself in danger as she searches for a rescue phone in the mountains to save Jin-man.

episodes.name: The Shopping Mall
episodes.overview: Ji-an and Jeong-min flee from the killers and meet Brother in the underground shopping mall.

episodes.name: Babylon
episodes.overview: Ji-an gets angry as she watches Jin-man on the screen, and Jeong-min points a gun at Ji-an's head.

episodes.name: Jeong Jin-man
episodes.overview: Jin-man, who was once a mercenary of a large company, Babylon, suffers from the truth he learns.

episodes.name: Trap
episodes.overview: Bale, who was presumed to be dead, begins his revenge, and Jin-man fights back to protect Ji-an.

episodes.name: Listen Up, Ji-an
episodes.overview:
Killers close in on Jin-man's house. Ji-an prepares for the final duel on her own.

Season Finale

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 returns with Jian in control of the weapons shop, Jinman returned from the dead, and BABYLON well and truly on the backfoot. Working to keep Jian safe, Jinman will take the fight to BABYLON's door, but the mercenary organization won't go down easily. Humiliated, BABYLON will bring in help from overseas and unleash a new wave of deadly assassins to rebuild their ranks and exact their revenge.

episodes.name: Jinman, That Same Day
episodes.overview: Jinman returns and the truth behind the day he faked his death begins to emerge.

episodes.name: Recluse
episodes.overview: A new adversary appears, disrupting the balance and challenging the murthehelp team.

episodes.name: Past Is Past, Present Is Present
episodes.overview: Jinman's past and the history Jian tried to erase resurface, placing them both in danger.

episodes.name: Raid
episodes.overview: Jian faces a harsh reality, while Jinman confronts a long-standing enemy.

episodes.name: Negotiation
episodes.overview: Accepting her fate, Jian takes a unique stand against Babylon.

episodes.name: The Trojan Horse
episodes.overview: An unexpected crisis puts the murthehelp team at risk, forcing Jinman to try and resolve it.

episodes.name: The Enemy of My Enemy
episodes.overview: Facing their most difficult challenge yet, Jian and the team struggle to hold on.

episodes.name: Listen Up, Jinman
episodes.overview: Murthehelp and Babylon face off in a final battle.

items.title: Mousetrap
items.overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."
items.tagline: Prove I'm real or I'm the imposter.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While hiding from society, a reclusive genius novelist Je Moon-jae falls victim to identity theft — only to be confronted by his doppelganger.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Noja uncovers the world of identity laundering after Moon-jae escapes his grip. Meanwhile, Detective Park Sun-yong pieces together the link between them.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Suspicious but intrigued, Noja takes Moon-jae on as both a client and a hostage. Their uneasy alliance leads them to setting up a carefully planned trap.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Moon-jae suspects The Rat may be a figure from his past. Following his newly recovered memory, he and Noja head to the island where the man once stayed.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A shocking tie surfaces between Noja and The Rat, while Sun-yong closes in on crucial evidence. Later, The Rat appears publicly, cornering Moon-jae.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Moon-jae reaches out to his longtime editor, hoping she can vouch for him. Lost in confusion, a text from Noja becomes his only lifeline.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: After barely escaping, Moon-jae joins a frantic race for someone who can reveal his identity. Later, Sun-yong discovers a shocking truth about his past.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Moon-jae sinks deeper into trouble. Sun-yong heads to a nursing home for answers — only to find his witness gone. Later, Noja's past buries him alive.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Moon-jae evades police to meet The Rat where it all began. Noja leaves him with heartfelt advice as Sun-yong continues to pursue a key witness.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Moon-jae stands at the center of a trap a lifetime in the making. Every lie and stolen identity surfaces as he questions: Is he the predator or the prey?

items.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
items.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
items.tagline: A brand new day starts now.

items.title: Game of Thrones
items.overview: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected military order of misfits, the Night's Watch, is all that stands between the realms of men and icy horrors beyond.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Trouble is brewing in the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros. For the driven inhabitants of this visionary world, control of Westeros' Iron Throne holds the lure of great power. But in a land where the seasons can last a lifetime, winter is coming...and beyond the Great Wall that protects them, an ancient evil has returned. In Season One, the story centers on three primary areas: the Stark and the Lannister families, whose designs on controlling the throne threaten a tenuous peace; the dragon princess Daenerys, heir to the former dynasty, who waits just over the Narrow Sea with her malevolent brother Viserys; and the Great Wall--a massive barrier of ice where a forgotten danger is stirring.

episodes.name: Winter Is Coming
episodes.overview: Jon Arryn, the Hand of the King, is dead. King Robert Baratheon plans to ask his oldest friend, Eddard Stark, to take Jon's place. Across the sea, Viserys Targaryen plans to wed his sister to a nomadic warlord in exchange for an army.

episodes.name: The Kingsroad
episodes.overview: While Bran recovers from his fall, Ned takes only his daughters to Kings Landing. Jon Snow goes with his uncle Benjen to The Wall. Tyrion joins them.

episodes.name: Lord Snow
episodes.overview: Lord Stark and his daughters arrive at King's Landing to discover the intrigues of the king's realm.

episodes.name: Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things
episodes.overview: Eddard investigates Jon Arryn's murder. Jon befriends Samwell Tarly, a coward who has come to join the Night's Watch.

episodes.name: The Wolf and the Lion
episodes.overview: Catelyn has captured Tyrion and plans to bring him to her sister, Lysa Arryn, at The Vale, to be tried for his, supposed, crimes against Bran. Robert plans to have Daenerys killed, but Eddard refuses to be a part of it and quits.

episodes.name: A Golden Crown
episodes.overview: While recovering from his battle with Jamie, Eddard is forced to run the kingdom while Robert goes hunting. Tyrion demands a trial by combat for his freedom. Viserys is losing his patience with Drogo.

episodes.name: You Win or You Die
episodes.overview: Robert has been injured while hunting and is dying. Jon and the others finally take their vows to the Night's Watch. A man, sent by Robert, is captured for trying to poison Daenerys. Furious, Drogo vows to attack the Seven Kingdoms.

episodes.name: The Pointy End
episodes.overview: Eddard and his men are betrayed and captured by the Lannisters. When word reaches Robb, he plans to go to war to rescue them. The White Walkers attack The Wall. Tyrion returns to his father with some new friends.

episodes.name: Baelor
episodes.overview: Robb goes to war against the Lannisters. Jon finds himself struggling on deciding if his place is with Robb or the Night's Watch. Drogo has fallen ill from a fresh battle wound. Daenerys is desperate to save him.

episodes.name: Fire and Blood
episodes.overview: With Ned dead, Robb vows to get revenge on the Lannisters. Jon must officially decide if his place is with Robb or the Night's Watch. Daenerys says her final goodbye to Drogo.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The cold winds of winter are rising in Westeros...war is coming...and five kings continue their savage quest for control of the all-powerful Iron Throne. With winter fast approaching, the coveted Iron Throne is occupied by the cruel Joffrey, counseled by his conniving mother Cersei and uncle Tyrion. But the Lannister hold on the Throne is under assault on many fronts. Meanwhile, a new leader is rising among the wildings outside the Great Wall, adding new perils for Jon Snow and the order of the Night's Watch.

episodes.name: The North Remembers
episodes.overview: Tyrion arrives to save Joffrey's crown from threats old and new; Daenerys searches for allies and water in the Red Waste.

episodes.name: The Night Lands
episodes.overview: Arya shares a secret with a familiar recruit; a scout returns to Dany with disturbing news; Theon comes home to the Iron Islands.

episodes.name: What Is Dead May Never Die
episodes.overview: Tyrion roots out a spy; Catelyn meets a new king and queen; Bran dreams; Theon drowns.

episodes.name: Garden of Bones
episodes.overview: Catelyn tries to save two kings from themselves; Tyrion practices coercion; Robb meets a foreigner; Dany finds her ally.

episodes.name: The Ghost of Harrenhal
episodes.overview: The Baratheon rivalry ends; Tyrion learns of Cersei's secret weapon; Dany suffers a loss; Arya collects a debt she didn't know was owed.

episodes.name: The Old Gods and the New
episodes.overview: Arya has a surprise visitor; Dany vows to take what is hers; Joffrey meets his subjects; Qhorin gives Jon a chance to prove himself.

episodes.name: A Man Without Honor
episodes.overview: Jaime meets a distant relative; Dany receives an invitation; Theon leads a search party; Jon loses his way in the wilderness.

episodes.name: The Prince of Winterfell
episodes.overview: Theon holds down the fort; Arya calls in her debt with Jaqen; Robb is betrayed; Stannis and Davos approach their destination.

episodes.name: Blackwater
episodes.overview: Tyrion and the Lannisters fight for their lives as Stannis’ fleet assaults King’s Landing.

episodes.name: Valar Morghulis
episodes.overview: Tyrion wakes up in a new world; Dany goes to a strange place; Jon proves himself.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Duplicity and treachery...nobility and honor...conquest and triumph...and, of course, dragons. In Season 3, family and loyalty are the overarching themes as many critical storylines from the first two seasons come to a brutal head. Meanwhile, the Lannisters maintain their hold on King's Landing, though stirrings in the North threaten to alter the balance of power; Robb Stark, King of the North, faces a major calamity as he tries to build on his victories; a massive army of wildlings led by Mance Rayder march for the Wall; and Daenerys Targaryen--reunited with her dragons--attempts to raise an army in her quest for the Iron Throne.

episodes.name: Valar Dohaeris
episodes.overview: Jon is tested by the wildling king; Tyrion asks for his reward; Dany sails to Slaver's Bay.

episodes.name: Dark Wings, Dark Words
episodes.overview: Sansa says too much. Shae asks Tyrion for a favor. Jaime finds a way to pass the time, while Arya encounters the Brotherhood Without Banners.

episodes.name: Walk of Punishment
episodes.overview: Tyrion shoulders new responsibilities. Jon is taken to the Fist of the First Men. Daenerys meets with the slavers. Jaime strikes a deal with his captors.

episodes.name: And Now His Watch Is Ended
episodes.overview: The Night's Watch takes stock. Varys meets his better. Arya is taken to the commander of the Brotherhood. Dany exchanges a chain for a whip.

episodes.name: Kissed by Fire
episodes.overview: The Hound is judged by the gods. Jaime is judged by men. Jon proves himself. Robb is betrayed. Tyrion learns the cost of weddings.

episodes.name: The Climb
episodes.overview: Four Houses consider make-or-break alliances. Jon and the Wildlings face a daunting climb.

episodes.name: The Bear and the Maiden Fair
episodes.overview: Dany exchanges gifts in Yunkai; Brienne faces a formidable foe in Harrenhal.

episodes.name: Second Sons
episodes.overview: Dany meets the Titan's Bastard; King's Landing hosts a royal wedding.

episodes.name: The Rains of Castamere
episodes.overview: House Frey joins forces with House Tully. Jon faces his most difficult test yet.

episodes.name: Mhysa
episodes.overview: Joffrey challenges Tywin. Dany waits to see if she is a conqueror or a liberator.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The War of the Five Kings is drawing to a close, but new intrigues and plots are in motion, and the surviving factions must contend with enemies not only outside their ranks, but within.

episodes.name: Two Swords
episodes.overview: King's Landing prepares for a royal wedding; Dany finds the way to Meereen; the Night's Watch braces for a new threat.

episodes.name: The Lion and the Rose
episodes.overview: The Lannisters and their guests gather in King's Landing; Stannis loses patience with Davos; Ramsay finds a purpose for his pet.

episodes.name: Breaker of Chains
episodes.overview: Tyrion ponders his options; Tywin extends an olive branch; Jon proposes a bold plan; The Hound teaches Arya the way thing are.

episodes.name: Oathkeeper
episodes.overview: Dany balances justice and mercy; Jaime tasks Brienne with his honor; Jon readies his men.

episodes.name: First of His Name
episodes.overview: Cersei and Tywin plot the Crown's next move. Dany discusses future plans. Jon Snow embarks on a new mission.

episodes.name: The Laws of Gods and Men
episodes.overview: Stannis and Davos set sail with a new strategy. Dany meets with supplicants. Tyrion faces down his father in the Throne Room.

episodes.name: Mockingbird
episodes.overview: Tyrion enlists an unlikely ally. Daario entreats Dany to allow him to do what he does best. Jon's warnings fall on deaf ears.

episodes.name: The Mountain and the Viper
episodes.overview: Mole's Town receives some unexpected visitors. Littlefinger's motives are questioned. Tyrion's fate is decided.

episodes.name: The Watchers on the Wall
episodes.overview: Jon Snow and the rest of the Night's Watch face the biggest challenge to the Wall yet.

episodes.name: The Children
episodes.overview: Circumstances change after an unexpected arrival from north of the Wall. Dany must face harsh realities. Bran learns more about his destiny. Tyrion sees the truth about his situation.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: The War of the Five Kings, once thought to be drawing to a close, is instead entering a new and more chaotic phase. Westeros is on the brink of collapse, and many are seizing what they can while the realm implodes, like a corpse making a feast for crows.

episodes.name: The Wars to Come
episodes.overview: Cersei and Jaime adjust to a world without Tywin. Varys reveals a conspiracy to Tyrion. Dany faces a new threat to her rule. Jon is caught between two kings.

episodes.name: The House of Black and White
episodes.overview: Arya arrives in Braavos. Podrick and Brienne run into trouble on the road. Cersei fears for her daughter's safety in Dorne as Ellaria Sand seeks revenge for Oberyn's death. Stannis tempts Jon. An adviser tempts Daenerys.

episodes.name: High Sparrow
episodes.overview: In Braavos, Arya sees the Many-Faced God. In King's Landing, Queen Margaery enjoys her new husband. Tyrion and Varys walk the Long Bridge of Volantis.

episodes.name: Sons of the Harpy
episodes.overview: The Faith Militant grow increasingly aggressive. Jaime and Bronn head south. Ellaria and the Sand Snakes vow vengeance.

episodes.name: Kill the Boy
episodes.overview: Dany makes a difficult decision in Meereen. Jon recruits the help of an unexpected ally. Brienne searches for Sansa. Theon remains under Ramsay's control.

episodes.name: Unbowed, Unbent, Unbroken
episodes.overview: Arya trains. Jorah and Tyrion run into slavers. Trystane and Myrcella make plans. Jaime and Bronn reach their destination. The Sand Snakes attack.

episodes.name: The Gift
episodes.overview: Jon prepares for conflict. Sansa tries to talk to Theon. Brienne waits for a sign. Stannis remains stubborn. Jaime attempts to reconnect with family.

episodes.name: Hardhome
episodes.overview: Arya makes progress in her training. Sansa confronts an old friend. Cersei struggles. Jon travels.

episodes.name: The Dance of Dragons
episodes.overview: Stannis confronts a troubling decision. Jon returns to The Wall. Mace visits the Iron Bank. Arya encounters someone from her past. Dany reluctantly oversees a traditional celebration of athleticism.

episodes.name: Mother's Mercy
episodes.overview: Stannis marches. Dany is surrounded by strangers. Cersei seeks forgiveness. Jon is challenged.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Following the shocking developments at the conclusion of season five, survivors from all parts of Westeros and Essos regroup to press forward, inexorably, towards their uncertain individual fates. Familiar faces will forge new alliances to bolster their strategic chances at survival, while new characters will emerge to challenge the balance of power in the east, west, north and south.

episodes.name: The Red Woman
episodes.overview: The fate of Jon Snow is revealed. Daenerys meets a strong man. Cersei sees her daughter once again.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: Bran trains with the Three-Eyed Raven. In King’s Landing, Jaime advises Tommen. Tyrion demands good news, but has to make his own. At Castle Black, the Night’s Watch stands behind Thorne. Ramsay Bolton proposes a plan, and Balon Greyjoy entertains other proposals.

episodes.name: Oathbreaker
episodes.overview: Daenerys meets her future. Arya trains to be No One.

episodes.name: Book of the Stranger
