episodes.name: The World Will Burn! The Onslaught of a Navy Admiral!
episodes.overview: As the Navy Admiral Ryokugyu comes to strike the Flower Capital, the Akazaya samurai notice and try to stop him, but his Woods-Woods Fruit power overwhelms them. Meanwhile, another formidable, yet friendly, guest approaches the Land of Wano

episodes.name: The Coming of the New Era! The Red-Haired's Imperial Rage
episodes.overview: Navy Admiral Ryokugyu keeps up a savage assault against the Akazaya samurai who are still recovering from the last battle. Momonosuke tries to defend the Land of Wano with all his might, but he gets driven into a corner.

episodes.name: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild
episodes.overview: Momonosuke and Hiyori are happy to see their grandfather who was supposed to be dead and the Straw Hats are surprised when Robin tells them about Pluton the Ancient Weapon. Meanwhile, Momonosuke is kept busy in his role as the new Shogun.

episodes.name: Time to Depart - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hats
episodes.overview: An untold story from before the Straw Hats’ departure. Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle where Oden’s grave once was and Zoro visits Yasuie’s grave where he meets Hiyori. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time and share their feelings with each other.

episodes.name: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow
episodes.overview: Angered by Luffy's attempt to leave without saying goodbye, Momonosuke rushes with Kin’emon and Yamato to the port from where the Straw Hats are about to leave, thinking back on his days with Luffy.

episodes.name: A New Emperor! Buggy the Genius Jester!
episodes.overview: Luffy and the other Straw Hats’ new bounties are revealed. Meanwhile, at Emptee Bluffs Island,　Crocodile and the greatest swordsman in the world Mihawk, visit Buggy to discuss their newly-established organization, Cross Guild.

episodes.name: The War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero
episodes.overview: Navy Captain Koby comes to the Island of Women to arrest Pirate Empress Hancock with the new Pacifistas. While the Navy and Kuja fighters clash, Blackbeard comes to raid, also targeting Hancock.

episodes.name: Luffy's Dream
episodes.overview: The three-way struggle between the Navy, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy’s words surprise everyone.

seasons.name: Egghead
seasons.overview: The aftermaths of both the Levely and the Raid on Onigashima, as well as the erasure of the Lulusia Kingdom, cause major shifts across the world that could lead to global war. The Straw Hat Pirates, following their Log Pose, arrive at the mysterious, futuristic island Egghead where the super genius Dr. Vegapunk resides. However, after being tipped off about Vegapunk's research into the Void Century, the World Government decides to dispatch a CP0 team to assassinate Vegapunk. Betrayal and intrigue on all sides leads to a Marine siege on the island that will escalate into an incident that will shock the world.

episodes.name: Entering a New Chapter! Luffy and Sabo's Paths!
episodes.overview: Sabo, the Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, contacts Koala and everyone in Kamabakka Queendom. He explains to them about the things that he is accused of, but someone who was eavesdropping on the call takes a stunning action.

episodes.name: A New Island! Future Island Egghead
episodes.overview: Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.

episodes.name: Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!
episodes.overview: A young girl who came out of the big robot names herself Dr. Vegapunk and it surprises Franky and the rest of the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Luffy’s group gets to the surface of the island where futuristic buildings stand and unknown giant creatures wander about.

episodes.name: Bonney's Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island
episodes.overview: While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.

episodes.name: The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!
episodes.overview: The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates’ top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.

episodes.name: The Mystery Deepens! Egghead Labophase
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats without Luffy, Chopper, and Jimbei are taken to the laboratory on the clouds far above the ground by Lilith. They get excited about the things they've never seen before. However, inside the laboratory, a new threat is waiting for them.

episodes.name: The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!
episodes.overview: Nami and the others are attacked by a Pacifista who resembles Jimbei and while they’re in battle, some of Vegapunk’s Satellites look on with excitement. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others find something extraordinary at the scrap heap.

episodes.name: A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom
episodes.overview: Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.

episodes.name: The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research
episodes.overview: Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work.

episodes.name: The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!
episodes.overview: Vegapunk reveals the shocking history of the ancient giant robot and asks Luffy to take him off Egghead. Rob Lucci and his fellow Cipher Pol agents arrive at the island and ask for permission to enter the port.

episodes.name: Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!
episodes.overview: CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.

episodes.name: Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!
episodes.overview: Luffy transforms into the Warrior of Liberation as Rob Lucci also shows his awakened Devil Fruit form. As the two clash, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth of the Gum-Gum Fruit and his eye-opening theory on Devil Fruits.

episodes.name: The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim's Powers!
episodes.overview: Vegapunk describes how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers, which surprises Franky and the others. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his savage, awakened form, but the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.

episodes.name: Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead
episodes.overview: Vegapunk asks the Straw Hats to take him on board their ship which makes Franky and Usopp happy but annoys Nami. Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk’s escape routes and looks to invade the heavily-secured Labophase.

episodes.name: Turn Back My Father! Bonney's Futile Wish!
episodes.overview: CP-0 enters the Labophase and starts attacking the Thousand Sunny as soon as they find it. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others but finds out that Vegapunk is missing. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.

episodes.name: A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim's All-out Attack!
episodes.overview: The Seraphim come following CP-0 to the Labophase, pitting Zoro and Brook against the seven of them. Sanji, Franky, Edison, and Lilith leave the lab to fight them, but the Seraphim launch a full-scale attack on the lab.

episodes.name: A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy
episodes.overview: Stussy suddenly knocked out Lucci to the Straw Hats’ surprise, and when Shaka reveals her true identity, they’re stunned again. Meanwhile, a major incident occurs on an island called Sphinx where Whitebeard came from.

episodes.name: Trouble Occurs! Seek Dr. Vegapunk!
episodes.overview: CP-0 takes control of the Fabriophase but gets attacked by an unknown force. Meanwhile, in the Labophase, the Straw Hats and Dr. Vegapunk’s Satellites find out that Vegapunk has disappeared and begin searching for him.

episodes.name: A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory
episodes.overview: Bonney witnesses her father Bartholomew Kuma’s painful memories. Meanwhile at the lab, Shaka notices that their communications and surveillance cameras are being cut off by somebody.

episodes.name: Incomprehensible! The Seraphim's Rebellion!
episodes.overview: The Seraphim suddenly start attacking the Straw Hats and the Vegapunk Satellites. They are not stopping even when the Satellites order them to. When Luffy and Zoro are cornered, Lucci and Kaku wake up and make them a surprising offer.

episodes.name: A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!
episodes.overview: Lucci and Kaku from CP-0, who came to Egghead with a mission to eliminate the seven Vegapunks, ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but Luffy and Zoro are reluctant to do so.

episodes.name: Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats and CP-0 relentlessly attack the Seraphim, but the Seraphim keep getting back up. Then, Zoro notices that the Seraphim remind him of someone who he fought before. Meanwhile, Shaka goes to check one place where he thinks Vegapunk Stella might be.

episodes.name: The Second Ohara! The Mastermind's Ambition!
episodes.overview: Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.

episodes.name: Clash! Shanks vs. Eustass Kid
episodes.overview: Kid gives his crew a pep talk before the battle with Shanks. And Shanks also prepares for the battle but learns how his own subordinates do as they like to protect their beloved boss. Finally, Kid has his Damned Punk ready to shoot.

episodes.name: Run, Koby! A Desperate Escape Strategy!
episodes.overview: Perona breaks into the Blackbeard Pirates' prison to rescue her captain, Gecko Moria, and frees Koby, who then helps free other prisoners. Koby, now with a high bounty, distracts a mob of pirates to protect the others. He recalls Blackbeard's plan to trade him for Hachinosu's entry into the World Government. The pirates face attacks from clay golems, SWORD member Kujaku, and a Marine force led by Garp and Tashigi.

episodes.name: For the Beloved Pupil - The Fist of Vice Admiral Garp!
episodes.overview: A massive warship comes flying towards the Pirate Island of Beehive and Vice Admiral Garp launches a crushing attack on top of it to save his pupil Koby. Koby almost reaches the ship with Navy HQ Commander Hibari running by his side.

episodes.name: The Navy Surprised! The Navy Headquarters' Former Admiral, Kuzan
episodes.overview: Kuzan, a former Navy Admiral, stands in the way of Garp who came to rescue Koby. He was once Garp’s pupil but is now a member of the Blackbeard Pirates. What happened to him after he was defeated by Sakazuki is now revealed.

episodes.name: Let's Go Get It! Buggy's Big Declaration
episodes.overview: Sengoku, the former Admiral of the Fleet, and Great Adviser Tsuru discuss the murder of Vice Admiral T-Bone and concerns about Cross Guild. Meanwhile, Buggy gives a passionate speech to Crocodile, Mihawk, and his crew.

episodes.name: Sabo Returns - The Shocking Truth to Be Told!
episodes.overview: Sabo returns to Kamabakka Queendom and starts recounting what happened at the Holy Land Mary Geoise. A month ago, during the Reverie, he and the captains of the Revolutionary Army raided the Land of Gods and Sabo witnessed Bartholomew Kuma being the Celestial Dragons’ slave.

episodes.name: The Holy Land in Tumult! Sai and Leo's Full-Power Blow!
episodes.overview: In the Holy Land Mary Geoise during the Reverie, Sabo runs into Bartholomew Kuma’s daughter Bonney. Meanwhile, King Cobra of the Kingdom of Alabasta begins asking the Five Elders questions that trouble them.

episodes.name: The Entrusted Message! King Cobra’s Resolve
episodes.overview: King Cobra is surprised by seeing someone sitting on the Empty Throne and by learning about the truth of the world. When he is subject to a deadly attack, Sabo cuts in to save him. The injured king entrusts Sabo with a message.

episodes.name: The World Is Shaken! The Ruler's Judgment and the Five Elders' Actions!
episodes.overview: Vivi tries to escape the Holy Land Mary Geoise with Wapol while the injured Sabo also looks for a way to leave to deliver King Cobra’s message to Luffy and Vivi. Meanwhile, Imu orders the Five Elders to test a horrendous weapon.

episodes.name: Garp and Kuzan - A Master and a Pupil's Beliefs Clash
episodes.overview: At the Pirate Island of Beehive, Vice Admiral Garp, who came to rescue the kidnapped Koby, deals with an overwhelming number of pirates alone. As he and his fellow Navy soldiers try to escape the island, Kuzan, the former Navy admiral, stands in their way.

episodes.name: The Last Lesson! Impact Inherited
episodes.overview: Avalo Pizarro, who merged with the Pirate Island, reaches his giant hand to crush the Navy ship with many soldiers and civilians on board. The wounded Garp gives orders to Koby, Helmeppo, and Prince Grus, and delivers a powerful blow to save the ship.

episodes.name: The World Shakes! The Straw Hats' Hostage Situation
episodes.overview: As the news about Garp’s disappearance and Luffy’s hostage situation spreads, a mysterious earthquake suddenly shakes the entire world. Meanwhile, a huge Navy fleet led by Admiral Kizaru surrounds Egghead and listens in as York contacts Mary Geoise to negotiate a deal.

episodes.name: Completely Surrounded! The Operation to Escape Egghead
episodes.overview: In the Labophase on Egghead, which is completely surrounded by the Navy, Luffy and the others devise a plan to escape the island. However, the Frontier Dome, the laser defense system, cannot be deactivated without York’s secret passcode.

episodes.name: A Clash of Two Men's Determination! Kizaru and Sentomaru
episodes.overview: Navy Admiral Kizaru finally makes landfall on Egghead and Sentomaru, Vegapunk’s bodyguard, stands in his way. The two men who were once close now clash violently. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others try their best to move the Sunny to the back side of the island to escape.

episodes.name: Looming Despair! Admiral Kizaru's Depressing Mission
episodes.overview: Kuma finally reaches Mary Geoise and keeps advancing even without free will or mind. But Fleet Admiral Akainu stands in his way. On Egghead, Kizaru enters the Labophase and delivers a powerful kick to Luffy who tries to stop him.

episodes.name: Luffy vs. Kizaru!  A Fierce Kaleidoscopic Battle
episodes.overview: A bizarre battle between Luffy and Kizaru heats up. Meanwhile, in the Fabiriophase, Bonney is all alone and being chased by the Navy soldiers. Dr. Vegapunk sees this and can’t help but leave the Labophase to rescue her, risking his life.

episodes.name: The Nightmare Strikes - Godhead of Science & Defense, St. Saturn
episodes.overview: Vegapunk successfully wrests back the Pacifistas from the Navy, but another party soon gains control of them. At the same time, Luffy, Zoro, and the others sense an unearthly presence just as a pentagram suddenly appears on Egghead.

episodes.name: Kuma's Past - Better Off Dead in This World
episodes.overview: Bonney gets captured by St. Saturn, whose enigmatic power keeps Sanji and Franky from saving her. In St. Saturn's clenched fist, she recalls the memories of her father, Kuma. 47 years ago, Kuma was born to a father of a race on the verge of extinction.

episodes.name: A History Erased! God Valley of Despair
episodes.overview: The human hunt begins and the Celestial Dragons start chasing locals of God Valley and slaves for prizes. Ivankov and Ginny share with Kuma and the others their surprising plan to survive the game. Meanwhile, ships full of infamous pirates start arriving on the island one after another.

episodes.name: A Fleeting Moment of Happiness - Kumachi and Ginny
episodes.overview: Kuma and Ginny live peacefully in the Sorbet Kingdom eight years after the God Valley Incident. However, their new king initiates a policy of enslaving the poor. Kuma tries to free those who were captured but ends up being imprisoned himself. But a familiar face comes to rescue him.

episodes.name: A Pledge to Ginny - Kuma Becomes a Father
episodes.overview: Two years after Ginny’s abduction, the Revolutionary Army suddenly receives a call from her.

episodes.name: To Save His Daughter - Kuma the Timid Pacifist
episodes.overview: By fighting off King Bekori who is supported by the World Government, Kuma is put on the wanted list and decides to travel around the world in search of a cure for Bonney's disease. He reunites with Dragon and learns about the Government’s eccentric scientist who might be able to cure Bonney.

episodes.name: Cruel Fate - Kuma's Decision as a Father
episodes.overview: Taking advantage of Kuma’s love for his daughter Bonney, the World Government imposes three harsh conditions on him in exchange for her treatment. Kuma agrees to them and Bonney’s treatment starts at Laboratory 8 in tandem with the clone development with which Kuma agrees to cooperate.

episodes.name: To the Sea Where My Father Is! The Future Bonney Chooses
episodes.overview: Bonney has been waiting for a letter from her father Kuma who promised to write to her. But with no letters in sight, she turns nine and one day realizes her disease is cured. She then decides to go out to sea to search for her father.

episodes.name: Kuma's Life
episodes.overview: Bonney sails out to sea in search of her father and rises to prominence. At the same time, Luffy makes his name by defeating the Arlong Pirates and declaring war against the World Government. Watching his actions, Kuma begins to hold a certain belief.

episodes.name: I'm Sorry, Dad - Bonney's Tears and Kuma's Fist
episodes.overview: The present day on Egghead, Bonney is caught in St. Saturn’s grasp, knowing he is responsible for her father’s transformation into a cyborg. However, Saturn reveals an even more shocking truth that throws Bonney into despair.

episodes.name: Thank You, Dad - Bonney and Kuma's Warm Embrace
episodes.overview: Kuma, battered and without free will, approaches Bonney. Overcome with emotion, she tells him she saw all his memories and learned everything that he did for her. Watching the scene, Vegapunk wonders what compelled Kuma to come to Egghead.

episodes.name: Destroy Egghead - The Buster Call Is Invoked
episodes.overview: As an order comes down to evacuate the island in preparation for bombardment, Navy soldiers rush to their ships. Meanwhile, Vegapunk pleads with Saturn to halt the attack, arguing how vital the island is for the future of humanity, but Saturn refuses to listen.

episodes.name: An Admired Hero - The Warrior of Liberation Who Saves Bonney
episodes.overview: Vegapunk reveals the secret he alone has been keeping regarding the Pacifistas. Meanwhile, Bonney, her back against the wall, hears a familiar rhythm. It’s the rhythm that her father taught her along with the legend of the hero he admired.

episodes.name: Reliable Reinforcements! Dorry and Brogy Arrive!
episodes.overview: The Giant Pirate Crew led by Dorry and Brogy arrive at Egghead, which deeply moves Usopp and the others. Zoro keeps fighting Rob Lucci and the Pacifistas continues to torment the Navy while Luffy shows Bonney how to throw a real punch.

episodes.name: Come In, World - Vegapunk's Message
episodes.overview: Caribou begs Augur and Devon to let him meet Blackbeard. An order is given to the Navy vice admirals to kill Jewelry Bonney at all costs in order to take back control over the Pacifistas. Sanji flees with the injured Vegapunk while Luffy holds St. Saturn back.

episodes.name: Vegapunk's Secret Plan - A Tense Worldwide Broadcast
episodes.overview: Suddenly, Vegapunk’s broadcast begins and the whole world is taken by surprise. As everyone rushes to set up Video Transponder Snails and screens to watch it, the Five Elders grow concerned and discuss countermeasures.

episodes.name: The Worst Nightmare - The Five Elders Come Together
episodes.overview: Just like when St. Saturn emerged on Egghead, black lightning strikes and pentagrams appear again. The Pacifistas are rendered immobile by an unknown shadow. Meanwhile, as the time for the Straw Hats to evacuate the island is drawing near, the fight between Zoro and Lucci intensifies.

episodes.name: Friends Fight Together! Luffy and the Warriors of Elbaph
episodes.overview: Dorry and Brogy finally reunite with Luffy. However, they are still facing St. Saturn and St. Warcury in their alternate forms. Dorry blows a horn to alert his people to prepare to escape, but St. Warcury unleashes a deafening roar.

episodes.name: An Imminent Threat - Stussy and Edison's Resolve
episodes.overview: Franky and Bonney clash with Navy vice admirals in front of the Elbaph ship. St. Mars tries to find the room from Vegapunk’s broadcast. The heavily injured Stussy tells Kaku the reason she chose to stay behind while Edison takes desperate action to help the Straw Hats escape.

episodes.name: A Stunning Conclusion - Vegapunk's Great Prediction
episodes.overview: Vegapunk’s broadcast resumes as people in various locations all over the world listen closely. St. Mars rushes to find the Transponder Snail that is the source of the broadcast while the Straw Hats and their allies clash with the other members of the Five Elders.

episodes.name: The Lost History - Joyboy, the First Pirate
episodes.overview: Vegapunk's revelation sends shockwaves around the world. St. Saturn abandons his fight with Nami and the others and rushes to stop the broadcast at all costs. Vegapunk goes on to expose another stunning truth, this time about Joyboy, the first pirate.

episodes.name: The Void Century - A Revelation About a Sinking World
episodes.overview: The severely injured Edison begs Stussy to escape, but she makes a stunning request in exchange. Meanwhile, Vegapunk presents another astonishing disclosure about a past cataclysm and the Ancient Weapons that will fundamentally challenge the beliefs of people everywhere.

episodes.name: Get the Ship Moving! The Iron Giant Activates
episodes.overview: Vegapunk’s revelation shocks even Koby and his fellow SWORD members, leading them to discuss what to do next.

episodes.name: Her and Her Father's Dream! Bonney's Free Future
episodes.overview: Luffy finally hops on the Elbaph ship along with Dorry and Brogy, but the Five Elders catch up to them and begin their assault. Aboard the burning ship, Bonney hears a familiar sound and then finds a new strength in her memories of her father.

episodes.name: Her Father and Mother's Legacy! Bonney's Nika Punch
episodes.overview: Zoro and the others who are on the Sunny in the Labophase finally attempt to escape, but at the cost of an unexpected sacrifice. Meanwhile, as Vegapunk concludes his speech, Bonney once again faces St. Saturn, the object of her great hatred.

episodes.name: The Upheaval of an Era! The Color of the Supreme King That Leads Luffy
episodes.overview: Vegapunk's speech raises the spirits of the pirates across the world, infuriating the Navy and the civilians. However, the broadcast is suddenly cut off while Vegapunk is still speaking. Meanwhile, off the coast of Egghead, the Five Elders are about to deliver the Straw Hats and the Giants a deadly strike.

episodes.name: The Truth Behind the Secret Plan - Vegapunk Claims Victory
episodes.overview: Two weeks before the battle erupted on Egghead, Vegapunk found out someone stole a portion of the Mother Flame. Along with Pythagoras and Shaka, he launched an investigation and identified the culprit, also learning their shocking motivation. Then, for the future of humanity, he resolved himself to make a bold decision.

episodes.name: The Promised Horizon - Off to the Long-Awaited Elbaph!
episodes.overview: York wakes up to see Island Clouds rising, and to her surprise, something is about to be taken away. Meanwhile, at Mary Geoise, the Celestial Dragons realize their food stock is dwindling and become belligerent. Another one of Vegapunk’s Satellites, Lilith wakes up and receives astonishing news.

seasons.name: Elbaph
seasons.overview: After a daring escape from the Future Island Egghead, the Straw Hat Crew set their course for a legendary destination. Joined by the mighty Giant Warrior Pirates, they finally reach Elbaph, the long-awaited Land of Giants. New encounters with Giants, and long hoped-for reunions unfold. A colossal new chapter begins as the crew heads into an adventure unlike anything before, all in the pursuit of the ultimate treasure, the "One Piece!"

episodes.name: The Long-sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet!
episodes.overview: After leaving Egghead, the Straw Hats and the Giant Pirate Crew celebrate their reunion with a big banquet.

episodes.name: Nami in a Fix! An Adventure in Block Kingdom
episodes.overview: Nami awakens to find herself in a completely unfamiliar place. Giant creatures attack one after another, driving her into a corner. At that moment, she hears a voice calling her name.

episodes.name: Episode 1158
episodes.overview: Luffy and the others come across a warrior riding a grasshopper.

episodes.name: Episode 1159
episodes.overview: Pursued by the Sun God, the Straw Hats flee across Block Kingdom at full speed. Amidst the chaos, the Sun God's true objective begins to surface. But as they run, another wall blocks their path. Their breakthrough rests on Luffy’s fists.

episodes.name: Episode 1160
episodes.overview: Leaving the Block Kingdom behind, Luffy and the others find themselves facing a vast snowy landscape and a massive suspension bridge. They resolve to move forward, only to be halted by approaching figures and a mysterious roar.

episodes.name: Episode 1161
episodes.overview: Luffy encounters Loki, the Accursed Prince, who offers him a deal. He hints at a connection to Shanks, all while savage beasts crowd around, staring Luffy down. Meanwhile, Zoro and the others on the suspension bridge realize someone is following them.

episodes.name: A Gargantuan Wave of Emotion - The Dreamlike Scenery of Elbaph
episodes.overview: As the Great Erik, carrying Robin and the others, reaches the island of Elbaph, a breathtaking rainbow stretches out before them. Yet even greater astonishment awaits them in the direction the ship is traveling.

episodes.name: Episode 1163
episodes.overview: Robin and the others finally arrive at the port of the Western Village in Elbaph.

episodes.name: Episode 1164
episodes.overview: Robin formally introduces Luffy and the others to Saul. Then his assistant, Ange, shows them around the school, where Usopp is shocked by the education being provided there. Meanwhile, Robin is taken to the library by Saul, where she is met with an incredible sight.

episodes.name: Episode 1165
episodes.overview: Robin, Chopper, Bonney, and Lilith enjoy the Owl Library.

episodes.name: Episode 1166
episodes.overview: Amidst the roaring banquet with the Giants, Luffy hears the legend of the Sun God passed down in Elbaph and learns why Loki is being held captive. In the Underworld, two mysterious guests appear before Loki, expressing their desire to recruit him into their order of knights.

episodes.name: Episode 1167
episodes.overview: Luffy and some of his companions snuck out of the banquet to explore the deceased king's castle.

episodes.name: Episode 1168
episodes.overview: Leaving behind a brutal parting gift, Shamrock and Gunko of the Knights of God abandon Loki and move on to their next strategy. Meanwhile, Franky is shown old wall paintings, and Robin reads an important religious text passed down since ancient times in Elbaph.

items.title: Teach You a Lesson
items.overview: When respect collapses in schools, unconventional inspectors arrive to set things right — with sharp, no-nonsense lessons you won't find in textbooks.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Na Hwa-jin steps into the chaos and takes control of a school plagued by the spoiled son of a powerful politician — to teach him a lesson.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With unassuming Bong Geun-dae on his side, Hwa-jin uses his special ops skills to handle a school gang and defend a student who just wants to study.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When a teen influencer spreads false claims about her teachers, the team's loose-cannon Inspector Im Han-rim steps in to set the record straight.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Choi Gang-seok weathers a political attack on his bureau. Hwa-jin's team visits an elite school to uncover why a student attacked a respected teacher.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: When an elementary school teacher's spirit wears down under pressure, Hwa-jin steps in to be her substitute — turning the tables to solve the case.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Four juvenile delinquents think they're above the law — until the team takes an interest in their extracurricular crimes and gives a harsh reality check.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Geun-dae goes undercover to help a father find his gambling addict son. To undermine the bureau politically, Hwang Gi-tae visits a juvenile inmate.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After a pre-med student collapses in class, Hwa-jin investigates his obsessive mother, whose access to illicit pills hints at a larger conspiracy.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: To help a student escape his exploitative friends, Han-rim adopts a new persona to join his circle. Cho Gyu-cheol's return puts the bureau in danger.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: After public backlash hits the bureau, Hwa-jin and his team go rogue to expose a deadly conspiracy led by a violent student-run gang.

items.title: Taxi Driver
items.overview: A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.
items.tagline: For the wronged victims who no one protect.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.

episodes.name: Do You Want to Take Revenge?
episodes.overview: Shaken by an abusive experience, a young woman with an intellectual disability takes up the services of Kim Do-gi and his team of revenge seekers.

episodes.name: Do-gi Meets Ju-chan
episodes.overview: With an eye on payback, Do-gi transforms into a deep-pocketed customer to trick Kang Maria's tormentors. Kang Ha-na wonders about a missing criminal.

episodes.name: A Victim of a School Violence
episodes.overview: Do-gi goes undercover as a high school substitute teacher after receiving a call for help from a student who is being severely bullied.

episodes.name: Teacher vs Students
episodes.overview: The three bullies' attempts to mess with Do-gi come to a halt when they realize he possesses video footage that could ruin their lives.

episodes.name: The Evil Businessman
episodes.overview: While Ha-na looks into allegations of employees suffering physical abuse inside a powerful tech company, Do-gi poses as a new recruit there.

episodes.name: Into the Strategic Planning Team
episodes.overview: To gain access to Park Yang-jin's inner circle, Do-gi focuses his efforts on infiltrating a key department within the company.

episodes.name: An Untimely Goodbye
episodes.overview: As the truth behind an exploitative incident involving An Go-eun's sister comes to light, Do-gi sets out for revenge. Ha-na shows up with a warrant.

episodes.name: The Vacation Home
episodes.overview: Do-gi finds himself in danger after Yang-jin gives him a cruel test of loyalty. Go-eun returns to locate and destroy the data servers.

episodes.name: The Voice Phishing Scam
episodes.overview: Ha-na grows suspicious when she finds Do-gi's ID card at the scene of the explosion. Meanwhile, the team takes on a phone scam case.

episodes.name: Mr. Wang and Madam Lim
episodes.overview: Do-gi dons another disguise to lay his charms on the leader of the voice phishing operation. Ha-na keeps a close eye on the team's whereabouts.

episodes.name: Tracking Down the Missing Murder Victim
episodes.overview: Certain that Jang Seong-cheol and his employees are hiding something, Ha-na storms his home. A pastor worries about his missing son.

episodes.name: A Colleague's Funeral
episodes.overview: In mourning, Ha-na goes to Do-gi as a client in search of vengeance. While investigating, the team uncovers a larger scheme at play.

episodes.name: A Prisoner Exchange
episodes.overview: The team is taken by surprise when Baek Yeong-mi empties the secret prison cells. Do-gi plans to use Gu Yeong-tae as a bargaining chip.

episodes.name: The Rainbow Transport Team In Danger
episodes.overview: When Yeong-mi comes after the team, Do-gi throws himself into action to save them from her cruel clutches before it's too late.

episodes.name: Rainbow Transport Decide to Disband
episodes.overview: It's the end of the road for Seong-cheol and the team as they agree to shut down their operation. Do-gi is made to face the demons of his past.

episodes.name: One Year Later
episodes.overview: The team pulls together for one final mission to nail the true culprit behind the death of Do-gi's mother. Ha-na attempts to resign.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Rainbow Deluxe Taxi crew reunites to fight injustice once again, with a new member joining their ranks, but they must now face a mysterious organization that threatens them while they continue to seek justice for the wronged.

episodes.name: The Missing Son
episodes.overview: Despite the disbandment of Rainbow Taxi, Do-ki is still out there going after bad guys. While keeping it from the rest of the members, Do-ki and Sung-cheol secretly help out a father who is searching for his missing son. To confirm his whereabouts, Do-ki sets off abroad to a foreign country to accomplish his first mission.

episodes.name: Back in Business
episodes.overview: Do-ki successfully infiltrates Cheongeum with the help of his old crew. He pretends to be an abducted recruit but secretly searches for Dong-jae. During the search, he runs into Lim Bok-ja. He uses her revengeful anger to make it easier to find the missing boy. Just when he is about to capture the mastermind, a mysterious gun shot interrupts his arrest.

episodes.name: The Trot Singer
episodes.overview: An elderly woman visits Rainbow Transport as a victim. She owes a lot of money because of a young scammer who only rips money off old people. Do-ki and the team get infuriated upon seeing this and set up a plan to prevent this criminal from ever scamming the elderly again.

episodes.name: Sang-gi’s Prison
episodes.overview: Rainbow Transport officially begins its operation to bring punishment to Sang-gi. The plan mainly depends on Sung-cheol being a loaded old man as bait. As soon as Sang-gi sees this and plans to scam him, he does not realize the karma that he is about to face. Meanwhile, the secret organization Do-ki is after is also keeping an eye on Do-ki as well.

episodes.name: Feel Consulting
episodes.overview: Do-ki runs into a stray little girl on the street. Out of concern, he takes her to Rainbow Transport and learns that suspicious people are after her. Do-ki and the team tries to infiltrate Feel Consulting and get some info on Kang Pil-seung to find out why he is in search of this poor little girl.

episodes.name: The Evil Uncle
episodes.overview: Do-ki and Go-eun get busted by Pil-seung for putting up an act. However, Do-ki manages to win back his trust by acting how desperate he is for a house. Now that they are back on track, Do-ki learns how Pil-seung is able to help couples get housing by using children. Disgusted by his ways, the team is determined to bring down Pil-seung at all costs.

episodes.name: The SunBaek Cult
episodes.overview: The next client is a woman named Lee Jin-hee. Her beloved sister Jin-sun is suffering from a terminal disease and is relying on a cult to cure her. To save her from the cult and to take down its leader, Rainbow Transport begins service. However, Do-ki is not the one who will be infiltrating the cult this time.

episodes.name: Beating a Cult with a Cult
episodes.overview: The plan to destroy Ok Ju-man is now set. The only thing that remains is for Ju-man to take the bait. Although he does not have faith in any kind of religion, the Rainbow Transport team makes it seem believable. By setting the perfect scam, Ok Ju-man becomes faithful to the fake cult that Do-ki makes.

episodes.name: The Surgery Malpractice
episodes.overview: A smelly drunk man protests alone in front of a big hospital. He claims that his daughter is in a coma due to a surgery malpractice. Although Rainbow Transport took him in as a client, they are not sure whether this is an actual case or just an accident. Before they start anything, Do-ki looks into Ahn Young-sook, the director who performed the surgery.

episodes.name: Jeil Chakhan Factory
episodes.overview: Do-ki becomes a patient himself to infiltrate the operating room. When he is put to sleep, Go-eun finds out that there is a proxy who does the actual surgery while Young-sook goes somewhere else for a drink. Now that the team knows she is a complete fraud, they set up a meticulous plan to bring the witch down.

episodes.name: The Late Kim Do-gi
episodes.overview: Do-ki makes it out alive from the car bomb explosion. He uses his death to track down the person behind the vicious attack. While his funeral progresses, Do-ki and the team monitor any suspicious people coming and going, which leads them to a club for the rich in Gangnam. Do-ki makes his entrance to find out more.

episodes.name: The Playground of Evil
episodes.overview: After Do-ki gets kicked out from Black Sun and gets beaten up, the police arrive. However, the police arrest Do-ki instead. Although Yong-min helps him to bail out, Do-ki now knows that the police are working with Black Sun. Rainbow Transport infiltrates the club to take them down for all the crimes they are committing.

episodes.name: Do-gi Crashes the Party
episodes.overview: An angry VIP client at Black Sun puts the security team on edge. The security team gets a second chance to make another delivery. Only this time, Do-ki joins the team. What he learns is shocking. Meanwhile, Sung-cheol digs into Ha-joon's past.

episodes.name: Ha-joon's Defeat
episodes.overview: While Do-ki wakes up from getting drugged, the bishop comes back to Korea. Now that Do-ki has evidence of how Black Sun is circulating drugs, he sets up a plan. Meanwhile, Ha-joon notices that Rainbow Transport is on Black Sun’s tail. Knowing how skillful Do-ki is, he takes every precaution he can take.

episodes.name: Ha-joon Versus Do-gi
episodes.overview: Rainbow Transport takes in another client. However this time, it is a set-up made by the Bishop and Ha-joon. Not knowing that it is a trap, Do-ki blindly goes into Jangsan Correctional with Kyung-goo and Jin-eon to save a victim. The only thing that is waiting for him is Ha-joon's trap that will break Do-ki into pieces.

episodes.name: The Final Client
episodes.overview: Do-ki goes into Jangsan Correctional as an undercover inmate. He fights all the way through every trap that Ha-joon has prepared for him. Although he barely makes it in one piece, he saves Lee Si-wan. Meanwhile, Ha-joon learns about his true identity and what the Bishop has done to him since his childhood.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The Rainbow Deluxe Taxi is back in business. This time, a call from Japan brings the team together. A girl goes missing after making a call to the Rainbow Taxi. The only lead they have is her name and the phone she called. But even so, the team tenaciously looks for the lead, which is what they are good at. As the team investigates, they find out that there’s a Japanese loan company behind this case. With new cars and equipment, the team goes to help out the girl who needs help. Starting with this international case, the team will fight on behalf of everyone who has been wronged in this society again this season.

episodes.name: A Call From Japan
episodes.overview: A call brings the team together again. A girl named I-seo calls for help, but she disappears as soon as Sung-cheol answers. The investigation begins with only a name, but the team discovers that there’s a scam game that lures teenagers, and there’s a Japanese loan company behind it. To find I-seo, the team goes to Japan.

episodes.name: A Man Who Trusts No One
episodes.overview: Do-ki’s plan to meet the boss of the yakuza seems successful. He gains Matsuda’s trust in his own way and gets closer to the crimes they’ve been committing. However, an unexpected group of people appears. It turns out that the Interpol is also looking into this human trafficking case. Michael, the Interpol inspector, wants Do-ki to support the investigation, but Do-ki has his own goals.

episodes.name: The Faulty Taxi Driver
episodes.overview: A bolt-from-the-blue piece of news strikes Driver Oh, who had been preparing to operate his own private taxi. The Taxi Driver License he had hurriedly obtained ends up holding him back. When Rainbow Taxi discovers that there are serious issues with Driver Oh’s previously stolen Taxi Driver License, everyone steps up to help. Will they be able to catch the illegally operated car dealer?

episodes.name: Reap What You Sow
episodes.overview: To catch the used-car dealer gang, Do-ki begins aggressively buying up their used cars. Becoming suspicious, the gang follows him after seeing that he even brings in a car carrier to purchase the vehicles. Falling into a trap Do-ki has set, they ultimately end up signing a malicious contract — just as they once forced their victims to do.

episodes.name: An Old Friend
episodes.overview: Dong Su was on the verge of giving up his life 15 years ago when he first met Mr. Jang. To right the injustice done to Min Ho, his son, Dong Su tried everything but failed. Mr. Jang helped him with all his might, but Dong Su just disappeared one day. Hearing the story, the Rainbow Deluxe Taxi takes on the case and starts digging into the old case.

episodes.name: Fragments of Memory
episodes.overview: Do Gi and Chief Choi sneak into the gambling den to see what Im Dong Hyeon is up to. Do Gi even manage to take over Im Dong Hyeon's gym through gambling. Meanwhile, Dong Su passes out after attempting to harm himself, and Mr. Jang finds mysterious codes next to the bed.

episodes.name: The Final Blow
episodes.overview: After learning that the gym was being used to fix volleyball matches, Do Gi returns it to Im Dong Hyeon for a bigger plan. He pretends to be a big-shot agent from Europe to win over Jeong Yeon Tae, a player who rigged matches for Im Dong Hyeon and Jo Seong Uk. On the day of the finals, Do Gi delivers the final blow that will help him find the body of Park Min Ho.

episodes.name: The Final Boss
episodes.overview: A fire breaks out at Im Dong Hyeon's gym, and he's found dead at the scene. Jo Seong Uk is also found drowned. The van transporting Min Ho's body is hit by a car, and the body is stolen. Do Gi and the team figure out that there's a man behind all three incidents, and they finally encounter him.

episodes.name: The Trap
episodes.overview: While driving the Deluxe Taxi, Do Gi rescues Ro Mi, an idol trainee who jumped into the Han River. Ro Mi is facing a crisis where her debut could be cancelled because of the trap her managers put her in. After hearing Ro Mi's story, the Rainbow Taxi members infiltrate her agency, Yellowstar, to uncover the full circumstances.

episodes.name: The Dirty Truth
episodes.overview: On the day of Elements' debut, Ji An passes out, so Do Gi covers for her during the rehearsal. After seeing Do Gi's good performance, CEO Kang Ju Ri gives him more trust, and she even shares her dark past. Do Gi then figures out that CEO Kang is using the trainees to entertain her clients, instead of making them real idol singers.

episodes.name: Scam or Be Scammed
episodes.overview: Chief Choi tries to help Maria’s sister, Da Som, on his own, but he ends up getting scammed instead. The Rainbow Transport members learn about Yoo Min Jung, who was scammed like how Chief Choi was through a resale app. Do Gi figures out there’s a whole organization behind it.

episodes.name: The Suspicious Island
episodes.overview: Do Gi finds the mastermind behind the resale app scheme, but the scammer gets killed by a bomb delivered by a guy in a fish truck. Do Gi and Mr. Jang trace the fish truck, which leads them to Samheung Island. The islanders seem unusually hostile toward Do Gi and Mr. Jang. Later, Do Gi finds out that the islanders have been watching their every move.

episodes.name: Knowing Your Enemy
episodes.overview: Do Gi and his group infiltrate the island and encounter a series of unexpected situations. Jin Eon and Gyeong Gu, who were tailing Writer Go, find themselves in danger, and even Go Eun, who was chasing the fish truck driver, ends up in peril. Realising that all of his teammates are in danger, Do Gi ultimately joins their scheme to rescue his comrades.

episodes.name: Undermining Their Foundation
episodes.overview: Do Gi and his crew find out the entire criminal history of the Samheung Island criminal ring. Do Gi's crew sees how they don't even hesitate to kill people to achieve what they want, so they come up with a plan to break up the organisation. However, Do Gi falls into danger after the criminals find out what they are after.

episodes.name: A Bird’s Nest
episodes.overview: Upon hearing the news that Master Sergeant Yoo Sun A, with whom he had served, has died, Do Gi immediately heads to the military unit where Master Sergeant Yoo last served. Before she died, she was demoted three ranks, which is unusual. Do Gi seeks to uncover the truth behind her death by following the last mission she carried out before she died.

episodes.name: The Last Operation
episodes.overview: Do Gi finds the bird nest where the late Yoo Sun A left the intel and learns that she sacrificed her life to save her comrades. He also finds out that higher-ranking officers fabricated the special mission for their personal gains. To eliminate the problematic officers, Do Gi uses all the help he can get.

items.title: Loki
items.overview: After stealing the Tesseract during the events of “Avengers: Endgame,” an alternate version of Loki is brought to the mysterious Time Variance Authority, a bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space and monitors the timeline. They give Loki a choice: face being erased from existence due to being a “time variant” or help fix the timeline and stop a greater threat.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Loki, the God of Mischief, steps out of his brother's shadow to embark on an adventure that takes place after the events of "Avengers: Endgame."

episodes.name: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: After stealing the Tesseract in "Avengers: Endgame," Loki lands before the Time Variance Authority.

episodes.name: The Variant
episodes.overview: Mobius puts Loki to work, but not everyone at TVA is thrilled about the God of Mischief's presence.

episodes.name: Lamentis
episodes.overview: Loki finds out The Variant's plans, but he has his own that will forever alter both their destinies.

episodes.name: The Nexus Event
episodes.overview: Frayed nerves and paranoia infiltrate the TVA as Mobius and Hunter B-15 search for Loki and Sylvie.

episodes.name: Journey into Mystery
episodes.overview: Loki tries to escape The Void, a desolate purgatory where he meets variant versions of himself.

episodes.name: For All Time. Always.
episodes.overview: The clock is ticking in the season finale which finds Loki and Sylvie on a date with destiny.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In the aftermath of Season 1, Loki finds himself in a battle for the soul of the Time Variance Authority. Along with Mobius, Hunter B-15 and a team of new and returning characters, Loki navigates an ever-expanding and increasingly dangerous multiverse in search of Sylvie, Judge Renslayer, Miss Minutes and the truth of what it means to possess free will and glorious purpose.

episodes.name: Ouroboros
episodes.overview: Loki finds himself lost to time and torn, quite literally, between past, present and future.

episodes.name: Breaking Brad
episodes.overview: With the TVA on the verge of a temporal meltdown, Loki & Mobius will stop at nothing to find Sylvie.
Loki & Mobius go on the hunt to find everyone’s favorite cartoon clock as they try to save the TVA.

episodes.name: Heart of the TVA
episodes.overview: The TVA's Loom nears catastrophic failure but Loki, Mobius and Sylvie have a He Who Remains variant.

episodes.name: Science/Fiction
episodes.overview: Loki traverses dying timelines in an attempt to find his friends, but Reality is not what it seems.

episodes.name: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: Loki learns the true nature of 'glorious purpose' as he rectifies the past.

items.title: The Odyssey
items.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

items.title: Breaking Bad
items.overview: Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live. He becomes filled with a sense of fearlessness and an unrelenting desire to secure his family's financial future at any cost as he enters the dangerous world of drugs and crime.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: High school chemistry teacher Walter White's life is suddenly transformed by a dire medical diagnosis. Street-savvy former student Jesse Pinkman "teaches" Walter a new trade.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: When an unassuming high school chemistry teacher discovers he has a rare form of lung cancer, he decides to team up with a former student and create a top of the line crystal meth in a used RV, to provide for his family once he is gone.

episodes.name: Cat's in the Bag...
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse attempt to tie up loose ends. The desperate situation gets more complicated with the flip of a coin. Walt's wife, Skyler, becomes suspicious of Walt's strange behavior.

episodes.name: ...And the Bag's in the River
episodes.overview: Walter fights with Jesse over his drug use, causing him to leave Walter alone with their captive, Krazy-8. Meanwhile, Hank has a scared straight moment with Walter Jr. after his aunt discovers he has been smoking pot. Also, Skylar is upset when Walter stays away from home.

episodes.name: Cancer Man
episodes.overview: Walter finally tells his family that he has been stricken with cancer. Meanwhile, the DEA believes Albuquerque has a new, big time player to worry about. Meanwhile, a worthy recipient is the target of a depressed Walter's anger, and Jesse makes a surprise visit to his parents home.

episodes.name: Gray Matter
episodes.overview: Walter and Skyler attend a former colleague's party. Jesse tries to free himself from the drugs, while Skyler organizes an intervention.

episodes.name: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
episodes.overview: The side effects of chemo begin to plague Walt. Meanwhile, the DEA rounds up suspected dealers.

episodes.name: A No Rough Stuff Type Deal
episodes.overview: Walter accepts his new identity as a drug dealer after a PTA meeting. Elsewhere, Jesse decides to put his aunt's house on the market and Skyler is the recipient of a baby shower.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Walt must deal with the chain reaction of his choice, as he and Jesse face new and severe consequences. When danger and suspicion around Walt escalate, he is pushed to new levels of desperation. Just how much higher will the stakes rise? How far is Walt willing to go to ensure his family's security? Will his grand plan spiral out of control?

episodes.name: Seven Thirty-Seven
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse are vividly reminded of Tuco’s volatile nature, and try to figure a way out of their business partnership. Hank attempts to mend fences between the estranged Marie and Skyler.

episodes.name: Grilled
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse find themselves in close quarters with an unhinged Tuco. Marie and Hank comfort Skyler, who is distraught over Walt’s disappearance. Hank pays a visit to Mrs. Pinkman on some not-so-official business.

episodes.name: Bit by a Dead Bee
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse become short on cash when they try to cover their tracks. Meanwhile, the DEA has a lead that could them straight to Walt and Jesse.

episodes.name: Down
episodes.overview: Walt attempts to reconnect with his family, while Jesse struggles to rebuild his life.

episodes.name: Breakage
episodes.overview: Hank suffers from the aftermath of his encounter with Tuco. Meanwhile, Jesse hires a crew to get their product out on the streets.

episodes.name: Peekaboo
episodes.overview: Walt's secret is in jeopardy when Skyler thanks Gretchen for paying for his treatment.

episodes.name: Negro y Azul
episodes.overview: Jesse and Walt discuss expanding into new territories; Hank struggles to fit in; Skyler pursues a new job opportunity; Jesse gets to know his landlord.

episodes.name: Better Call Saul
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse seek advice from a shady attorney when Badger gets in trouble with the law; the DEA believes they have caught up with "Heisenberg" ; Hank returns.

episodes.name: 4 Days Out
episodes.overview: Walt and his family wait for news after he undergoes a PET-CT scan. Walt follows Saul's advice; Jesse's relationship with Jane is put on hold when he and Walt head to the desert for a marathon of cooking.

episodes.name: Over
episodes.overview: Walt and Hank get into a heated argument at a party. Skyler opens up to her boss. Jane hides her relationship with Jesse from her father.

episodes.name: Mandala
episodes.overview: As the end of her pregnancy finds Skyler conflicted about her feelings, a dealer's death forces Walt to look for somewhere to unload a load of meth.

episodes.name: Phoenix
episodes.overview: As Walt explores money laundering options, he and Jesse spar over the profits from their latest deal. Jesse and Jane clash with her father. Walt makes a fatal decision.

episodes.name: ABQ
episodes.overview: Skyler confronts Walt about his secrecy; Jesse falls apart; and Jane's grief-stricken father takes action that results in further tragedy.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Walt continues to battle dueling identities: a desperate husband and father trying to provide for his family, and a newly appointed key player in the Albuquerque drug trade. As the danger around him escalates, Walt is now entrenched in the complex worlds of an angst-ridden family on the verge of dissolution, and the ruthless and unrelenting drug cartel.

episodes.name: No Más
episodes.overview: Walt faces a new threat, on a new front and deals with an increasingly angry Skyler, who must consider what to do next with her life and the kids. Meanwhile, Jesse comes face-to-face with some startling self-revelations.

episodes.name: Caballo sin Nombre
episodes.overview: Despite ever-increasing tension between Walt and Skyler, he pulls out all the stops in an effort to reconcile with the family. Elsewhere, Saul is instrumental in getting Jesse involved in a most-unusual investment opportunity.

episodes.name: I.F.T.
episodes.overview: Walt ignores Skyler's demands, furthering the rift between them and pushing her to break bad. Still suffering from panic and anxiety attacks, Hank crosses a line at work.

episodes.name: Green Light
episodes.overview: Walt loses control as he reacts to Skyler's news, endangering his job and relationships with Saul and Jesse. Hank throws himself into his blue meth investigation. Jesse enacts a new plan.

episodes.name: Más
episodes.overview: Gus increases his efforts to lure Walt back into business, forcing a rift between Walt and Jesse. Skyler doubts her new relationship. Marie confides in Skyler about her concern for Hank's well-being.

episodes.name: Sunset
episodes.overview: Walt settles into his new surroundings; Walt, Jr. wants answers about his parents' relationship; Hank's investigation causes problems for Walt and Jesse.

episodes.name: One Minute
episodes.overview: Hank's increasing volatility forces a confrontation with Jesse and trouble at work. Skyler pressures Walt to make a deal. Gus' actions have severe consequences.

episodes.name: I See You
episodes.overview: The family waits for news about Hank. While Jesse covers at the lab, Walt attempts to placate Gus. After witnessing a disturbing outburst, Walt worries he and his family are in danger.

episodes.name: Kafkaesque
episodes.overview: As Hank's hospital bills stack up, Skyler hatches a plan. Walt and Gus come to a better understanding. Jesse, looking for more independence, pursues a new opportunity.

episodes.name: Fly
episodes.overview: Walt becomes obsessed with a contaminant in the lab and refuses to finish the cook until it is eliminated. A frustrated Jesse attempts to get Walt back on track.

episodes.name: Abiquiu
episodes.overview: Skyler gets involved with Walt's business. Hank struggles with his recovery. Jesse makes a startling discovery after meeting a girl at group therapy.

episodes.name: Half Measures
episodes.overview: Against Walt's advice, Jesse lashes out. Fearing for Jesse's safety, Walt takes drastic action to intervene and tragic event leads to a shocking confrontation.

episodes.name: Full Measure
episodes.overview: With Jesse on the run and Mike in hot pursuit, Walt negotiates a bargain with Gus and concocts a disturbing plan to provide for his and Jesse's safety.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Walt and Jesse must cope with the fallout of their previous actions, both personally and professionally. Tension mounts as Walt faces a true standoff with his employer, Gus, with neither side willing or able to back down. Walt must also adjust to a new relationship with Skyler, whom while still reconciling her relationship with Walt, is committed to properly laundering Walt’s money and ensuring her sister Marie and an ailing Hank are financially stable.

episodes.name: Box Cutter
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse face the deadly consequences of their actions. Skyler deals with a puzzling disappearance, as Marie struggles to help Hank with his recovery.

episodes.name: Thirty-Eight Snub
episodes.overview: Walt attempts to form a new alliance as he plans his next move. Skyler pushes Walt towards a business opportunity, in hopes of protecting the family.

episodes.name: Open House
episodes.overview: Events spiral out of control at Jesse's place. Skyler reluctantly asks for Saul's help. Marie returns to an old pastime and a friend asks Hank for help.

episodes.name: Bullet Points
episodes.overview: The Cartel takes steps to gain the upper hand. Walt and Skyler share an embarrassing secret with the rest of the family. Jesse's activities draw unwanted attention.

episodes.name: Shotgun
episodes.overview: When Jesse goes missing, Walt fears the worst. Skyler has an unlikely reunion. Hank shares some bad news with Detective Tim Roberts.

episodes.name: Cornered
episodes.overview: Skyler makes an unsettling discovery. Walter, Jr. pushes his dad into a questionable purchase. Jesse offers Mike some unexpected help.

episodes.name: Problem Dog
episodes.overview: A frustrated Walt gambles on a risky new plan. Skyler's business venture hits a snag. Hank recruits Walter, Jr. for an unusual outing.

episodes.name: Hermanos
episodes.overview: Skyler develops an unusual solution to her money troubles. Hank enlists Walt to investigate a theory. Walt's impatience with Jesse grows.

episodes.name: Bug
episodes.overview: Skyler's past mistakes come back to haunt her. Gus takes action to thwart his rivals. Jesse seeks Walt's help, with mixed results.

episodes.name: Salud
episodes.overview: Walt's family worries when he doesn't turn up for Walter, Jr.'s 16th birthday. Jesse is forced to put his lab skills to the test without Mr. White's help.

episodes.name: Crawl Space
episodes.overview: Walt takes drastic action to protect his secret and Gus. Skyler's efforts to solve Ted's financial problems hit a wall.

episodes.name: End Times
episodes.overview: Hank pushes Gomez to pursue one last lead, while Walt struggles to protect the family. Jesse gets alarming news and rushes to meet with Mr. White.

episodes.name: Face Off
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse team up to take on Gus. With Saul's help, Walt finds an unexpected ally.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Walt is faced with the prospect of moving on in a world without his enemy. As the pressure of a criminal life starts to build, Skyler struggles to keep Walt’s terrible secrets. Facing resistance from sometime adversary and former Fring lieutenant Mike, Walt tries to keep his world from falling apart even as his DEA Agent brother in law, Hank, finds numerous leads that could blaze a path straight to Walt.

episodes.name: Live Free or Die
episodes.overview: As Walt deals with the aftermath of the Casa Tranquila explosion, Hank works to wrap up his investigation of Gus' empire.

episodes.name: Madrigal
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse pursue an unlikely business partner. The DEA filters through various leads in hopes of finding something.

episodes.name: Hazard Pay
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse formulate a new business plan. Walt shares a secret with Marie.

episodes.name: Fifty-One
episodes.overview: Walt celebrates another birthday. Skyler contemplates her options, and an associate puts a crimp in Walt and Jesse's business strategy.

episodes.name: Dead Freight
episodes.overview: Walt's team gets creative to obtain the methylamine they need to continue their operation.

episodes.name: Buyout
episodes.overview: Walt, Jesse, and Mike struggle over the future of their business, as occupational hazards weigh on Jesse.

episodes.name: Say My Name
episodes.overview: Walt takes control of business matters; Mike deals with the consequences of his actions.

episodes.name: Gliding Over All
episodes.overview: Walt takes care of loose ends; Walt makes a dangerous decision.

episodes.name: Blood Money
episodes.overview: As Walt and Jesse adjust to life out of the business, Hank grapples with a troubling lead.

episodes.name: Buried
episodes.overview: While Skyler's past catches up with her, Walt covers his tracks. Jesse continues to struggle with his guilt.

episodes.name: Confessions
episodes.overview: Jesse decides to make a change, while Walt and Skyler try to deal with an unexpected demand.

episodes.name: Rabid Dog
episodes.overview: An unusual strategy starts to bear fruit, while plans are set in motion that could change everything.

episodes.name: To'hajiilee
episodes.overview: Things heat up for Walt in unexpected ways.

episodes.name: Ozymandias
episodes.overview: Everyone copes with radically changed circumstances.

episodes.name: Granite State
episodes.overview: Events set in motion long ago move toward a conclusion.

episodes.name: Felina
episodes.overview: All bad things must come to an end.

items.title: Mutiny
items.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

items.title: Coyote vs. Acme
items.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

cast.character: Foghorn Leghorn / Daffy Duck / Porky Pig / Elmer Fudd / Bugs Bunny / Tweety / Road Runner (voice)
