items.title: Ted Lasso
items.overview: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, moves to England when he's hired to manage a soccer team—despite having no experience. With cynical players and a doubtful town, will he get them to see the Ted Lasso Way?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Slowly but surely, Ted makes England his new home. Throughout the season, the down-on-their-luck players cannot help but be charmed and inspired by Ted. Even team owner Rebecca Welton who initially hired Ted to tank the team’s chances and to annoy her cheating ex-husband, was moved by Ted’s boyish innocence, determination, and outrageous tea biscuits.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: American football coach Ted Lasso is hired by a wealthy divorcée to coach the English soccer team AFC Richmond.

episodes.name: Biscuits
episodes.overview: It's Ted's first day of coaching, and fans aren't happy. He makes little headway but remains undeterred as the team plays its first match.

episodes.name: Trent Crimm: The Independent
episodes.overview: To arrange an in-depth exposé, Rebecca pairs cynical journalist Trent Crimm with Ted for a day. Ted and Roy venture into the community.

episodes.name: For the Children
episodes.overview: Rebecca hosts the team's annual charity benefit, where Ted stages a reconciliation between Roy and Jamie.

episodes.name: Tan Lines
episodes.overview: With his wife and son visiting from America, Ted makes drastic changes to the lineup during a critical match.

episodes.name: Two Aces
episodes.overview: When Jamie refuses to train, Ted turns to talented new signing Dani Rojas—and the team is struck by an age-old curse.

episodes.name: Make Rebecca Great Again
episodes.overview: Rebecca celebrates her first anniversary as a divorcée as the team plays a match in Liverpool.

episodes.name: The Diamond Dogs
episodes.overview: Ted and Roy are both having relationship problems. Ted consults the Diamond Dogs while Roy has a talk with Keeley.

episodes.name: All Apologies
episodes.overview: After a series of mistakes on the pitch, pressure mounts to bench Roy. Rebecca drops a bombshell.

episodes.name: The Hope That Kills You
episodes.overview: Richmond plays a climactic match that will determine the fates of Ted and his club.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 will no doubt be a redemption story. While the team will face struggles, Ted’s illuminating, yet often frustrating kindness will encourage the team to move forward. As Ted believes, everything will work out the way it’s supposed to. Struggling to adjust to their lower league status, Ted focuses the team’s attention toward leaving behind their losing streak. Ted adjusts to his life without his now ex-wife Michelle and his young son, Henry, who have returned to the US. A psychologist named Sharon joins the team. The lovable Keeley Jones and newly retired Roy Kent continue dating. Roy is adjusting to his new life on the sidelines. As for Rebecca Welton starts dating again.

episodes.name: Goodbye Earl
episodes.overview: AFC Richmond brings in a sports psychologist to help the team overcome their unprecedented seven game tie-streak.

episodes.name: Lavender
episodes.overview: Ted is surprised by the reappearance of a familiar face. Roy tries out a new gig.

episodes.name: Do the Right-est Thing
episodes.overview: Rebecca has a special visitor shadow her at work. A player's return is not welcomed by the team.

episodes.name: Carol of the Bells
episodes.overview: It's Christmas in Richmond. Rebecca enlists Ted for a secret mission, Roy and Keeley search for a miracle, and the Higginses open up their home.

episodes.name: Rainbow
episodes.overview: Nate learns how to be assertive from Keeley and Rebecca. Ted asks Roy for a favor.

episodes.name: The Signal
episodes.overview: Ted is fired up that the new team dynamic seems to be working. But will they have a chance in the quarterfinal?

episodes.name: Headspace
episodes.overview: With things turning around for Richmond, it's time for everyone to work on their issues—like Ted's discomfort, Nate's confidence, and Roy's attention.

episodes.name: Man City
episodes.overview: Ted and Dr. Sharon realize they might have to meet each other halfway. Tensions are high as the team prepares for the semifinal.

episodes.name: Beard After Hours
episodes.overview: After the semifinal, Beard sets out on an all-night odyssey through London in an effort to collect his thoughts.

episodes.name: No Weddings and a Funeral
episodes.overview: Rebecca is stunned by a sudden loss. The team rallies to show their support, but Ted finds himself grappling with a piece of his past.

episodes.name: Midnight Train to Royston
episodes.overview: A billionaire football enthusiast from Ghana makes Sam an unbelievable offer. Ted plans something special for Dr. Sharon's last day with the team.

episodes.name: Inverting the Pyramid of Success
episodes.overview: Richmond gets their final chance to win promotion as Ted deals with the fallout of Trent Crimm's painfully honest exposé.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In this third season, the newly-promoted AFC Richmond faces ridicule as media predictions widely peg them as last in the Premier League and Nate, now hailed as the "wonder kid," has gone to work for Rupert at West Ham United. In the wake of Nate's contentious departure from Richmond, Roy Kent steps up as assistant coach, alongside Beard. Meanwhile, while Ted deals with pressures at work, he continues to wrestle with his own personal issues back home, Rebecca is focused on defeating Rupert and Keeley navigates being the boss of her own PR agency. Things seem to be falling apart both on and off the pitch, but Team Lasso is set to give it their best shot anyway.

episodes.name: Smells Like Mean Spirit
episodes.overview: The newly promoted AFC Richmond face mockery as pundits predict they'll finish dead last this season.

episodes.name: (I Don't Want to Go to) Chelsea
episodes.overview: News of a top player looking to move to London sends the English clubs into a frenzy. Richmond play their first game back in the Premier League.
Richmond adjust to an exciting change, but Jamie has reservations. Ted learns there's something new going on back in Kansas as well.

episodes.name: Big Week
episodes.overview: Everyone's feeling the pressure as Richmond gear up to play West Ham. Ted is reunited with an old friend.

episodes.name: Signs
episodes.overview: With their season in a tailspin, Richmond try to right the ship against mighty Manchester City. Off the pitch, everyone faces their own setbacks.

episodes.name: Sunflowers
episodes.overview: A friendly match takes the team to Amsterdam, where one night out unlocks truths for many.

episodes.name: The Strings That Bind Us
episodes.overview: The Greyhounds try a new strategy that has everyone thinking outside the box. Sam prepares to host a VIP guest at Ola's.

episodes.name: We'll Never Have Paris
episodes.overview: While watching Henry, Ted fights the urge to spiral when Michelle and Dr. Jacob go on a romantic trip. An online leak has massive implications for Keeley.

episodes.name: La Locker Room Aux Folles
episodes.overview: Colin and Isaac's friendship is tested. Roy is asked to do a press conference.

episodes.name: International Break
episodes.overview: While some of the Greyhounds head home to play for their countries in international matches, Edwin Akufo brings a business proposal to Rebecca.

episodes.name: Mom City
episodes.overview: An unexpected guest has Ted on edge. When Richmond travel to Manchester for a big match, Roy and Keeley become concerned about Jamie.

episodes.name: So Long, Farewell
episodes.overview: AFC Richmond play their final game of the season.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In season four, Ted returns to Richmond, taking on his biggest challenge yet: coaching a second division women's football team. Throughout the course of the season, Ted and the team learn to leap before they look, taking chances they never thought they would.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: Ted is convinced to return to Richmond to take on his biggest challenge yet: coaching a second division women's team

episodes.name: Curiouser and Curiouser
episodes.overview: Ted returns to Richmond to meet the Lady Greyhounds, but not everyone is glad to see him.

episodes.name: Richmond's Got Talent
episodes.overview: Richmond's shareholders are unsure about a women's team. The coaches hold tryouts to fill out their roster.

episodes.name: Greyhounds' Day Off
episodes.overview: The coaches must figure out how to break up team cliques. Ted adjusts to life outside the locker room.

episodes.name: Riches of Embarrassment
episodes.overview: The ladies face off against Chelsea. Alice feels the pressure. Rebecca navigates a complicated dynamic.

items.title: The Walking Dead
items.overview: Sheriff's deputy Rick Grimes awakens from a coma to find a post-apocalyptic world dominated by flesh-eating zombies. He sets out to find his family and encounters many other survivors along the way.
items.tagline: Fight the dead. Fear the living.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Rick Grimes wakes up from a coma to a world overrun by zombies, on a journey to find his family he must learn to survive the streets of post-apocalyptic Atlanta.

episodes.name: Days Gone Bye
episodes.overview: Rick searches for his family after emerging from a coma into a world terrorized by the walking dead. Morgan and Duane, whom he meets along the way, help teach Rick the new rules for survival.

episodes.name: Guts
episodes.overview: Rick unknowingly causes a group of survivors to be trapped by walkers. The group dynamic devolves from accusations to violence, as Rick must confront an enemy far more dangerous than the undead.

episodes.name: Tell It to the Frogs
episodes.overview: Rick makes a decision to go back to Atlanta to retrieve the bag of guns and save a man's life. Lori and Shane must deal with the surprising return of someone they thought was dead.

episodes.name: Vatos
episodes.overview: Rick's mission to Atlanta is jeopardized when things go awry. Jim becomes unhinged in camp.

episodes.name: Wildfire
episodes.overview: Rick leads the group to the CDC after the attack. Jim must make a terrible life and death decision.

episodes.name: TS-19
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are allowed into the CDC by a strange doctor, but all is not what it seems in their newfound haven.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Under Rick's leadership, the group leave Atlanta in search of sanctuary and find a possible safe haven.

episodes.name: What Lies Ahead
episodes.overview: Rick leads the group out of Atlanta. On the highway, they are stopped by a threat unlike anything they have seen before. The group searches for someone who has gone missing.

episodes.name: Bloodletting
episodes.overview: Coming to the aid of another, Rick discovers a possible safe haven. Shane must go on a dangerous mission to get badly-needed medical supplies.

episodes.name: Save the Last One
episodes.overview: The group desperately awaits Shane's return. Shane finds himself trapped in a school, surrounded by the undead. Daryl and Andrea search for someone in the woods.

episodes.name: Cherokee Rose
episodes.overview: Shane makes a deadly sacrifice which leads to unusual behavior and self-distancing. The rest of the group tries to hang on somewhere between living to die and dying to live.

episodes.name: Chupacabra
episodes.overview: Glenn, the only one breaking barriers between both groups, knows far too much for his comfort level. Daryl finds a sign of life and, in his delirium, tries to make it back to the farm alive.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: Secrets are told and secrets are revealed. Hershel refuses to acknowledge the world’s new reality. Andrea comes out of her shell. Everyone is becoming more and more aware that “everything is food for something.”

episodes.name: Pretty Much Dead Already
episodes.overview: Hershel sets a deadline. All secrets are out in the open. Glenn stands up for himself and Shane takes charge.

episodes.name: Nebraska
episodes.overview: Rick and the others try to restore order in the aftermath of a terrible discovery. Hershel takes up an old habit and disappears, Rick and Glenn must follow him into town.

episodes.name: Triggerfinger
episodes.overview: Trapped, Rick, Hershel and Glenn fight to survive against new foes, both dead and alive. Shane finds Lori in danger on the road and makes it his mission to bring her back to the farm.

episodes.name: 18 Miles Out
episodes.overview: Rick and Shane are in conflict over the fate of an outsider; Andrea helps Hershel's daughter face a crucial decision.

episodes.name: Judge, Jury, Executioner
episodes.overview: Rick sides with Shane on an important decision, causing Dale to worry that the group is losing its humanity. Carl's actions have unintended consequences on the group.

episodes.name: Better Angels
episodes.overview: The group learns that someone dangerous may be on the loose near the farm. As night falls, Rick, Shane, Daryl, and Glenn comb the woods to handle the situation and keep the group safe.

episodes.name: Beside the Dying Fire
episodes.overview: Rick and Carl return from the woods to find the farm in jeopardy. The group is split up in the ensuing chaos. With things looking grim, Rick's leadership is questioned.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Having seemingly found a place of security, the group are faced with an unprecedented new threat.

episodes.name: Seed
episodes.overview: With the world growing increasingly more dangerous and Lori’s pregnancy advancing, Rick discovers a potentially safe haven. But first he must secure the premises, pushing his group to its limit.

episodes.name: Sick
episodes.overview: After a traumatic event, a life hangs in the balance. Complicating matters, the group must also deal with a potential threat to their new surroundings.

episodes.name: Walk with Me
episodes.overview: After witnessing an accident, Andrea and Michonne are introduced to a new community of survivors. As conflicts arise with their new acquaintances, a decision must be made.

episodes.name: Killer Within
episodes.overview: The group is severed and lives are put in jeopardy. In Woodbury, Merle has a request for the Governor.

episodes.name: Say the Word
episodes.overview: After another loss, Rick struggles. Michonne remains suspicious of the Governor as he throws a party with a unique twist for the people of Woodbury.

episodes.name: Hounded
episodes.overview: As Andrea grows closer to the Governor, Michonne makes a decision about Woodbury. Glenn and Maggie go on a run. Rick struggles.

episodes.name: When the Dead Come Knocking
episodes.overview: The Governor presses for information. A new guest arrives at the prison, forcing Rick's hand.

episodes.name: Made to Suffer
episodes.overview: Andrea steps up as the people of Woodbury are thrown into uncharted territory. At the prison, a new threat arises.

episodes.name: The Suicide King
episodes.overview: Rick tries to rescue a member of his group. Woodbury is in disarray after a recent attack. New guests raise concerns at the prison.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: As the group debates their next course of action, Rick wanders after a lost friend. Daryl and Merle question their choices. The Governor restores order in Woodbury and makes plans to punish those responsible.

episodes.name: I Ain't a Judas
episodes.overview: Rick and the group must make a choice when security is threatened. With Woodbury in a police state, Andrea grows uneasy.

episodes.name: Clear
episodes.overview: Realizing they are heavily outgunned against the Governor's forces, Rick leads an expedition to get more weapons.

episodes.name: Arrow on the Doorpost
episodes.overview: In an effort to prevent any more deaths, Rick and the Governor meet to come up with a peace treaty.

episodes.name: Prey
episodes.overview: The Governor chases a dissenter who fled Woodbury. While the Governor is gone, a traitor tries to sabotage his upcoming plans.

episodes.name: This Sorrowful Life
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are faced with a serious problem. If they want a truce with the Governor, they will have to make a huge sacrifice.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Tombs
episodes.overview: Rick and the group have to seriously consider if the prison is worth defending as the Governor's impending attack looms over their heads.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: As the group settle into life in a stable shelter, a new danger threatens disaster.

episodes.name: 30 Days Without an Accident
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are as close to an ideal life as possible at the prison. Will they be able to hold on to humanity in the face of a new evil?

episodes.name: Infected
episodes.overview: As the group faces a brand new enemy, Rick and the others must fight to protect the livelihood they worked so hard to create at the prison.

episodes.name: Isolation
episodes.overview: As one group leaves the prison in search for supplies at a local college, those who stay must deal with recent losses while preserving what remains.

episodes.name: Indifference
episodes.overview: While on a supplies mission to a local college, members of the group run into multiple hurdles. Things at the prison are getting worse.

episodes.name: Internment
episodes.overview: Multiple enemies put pressure on Rick and the group. Could this finally be the breaking point for the survivors and the prison?

episodes.name: Live Bait
episodes.overview: A familiar face returns as each member of the group struggles to find his or her humanity in a world of constant threats.

episodes.name: Dead Weight
episodes.overview: A new and scary chapter is unfolding at a camp outside the prison. Will peace be attainable with the addition of new members?

episodes.name: Too Far Gone
episodes.overview: Just when everything started to calm down at the prison, Rick and his group now face imminent danger and destruction. This time, they might not win.

episodes.name: After
episodes.overview: As Rick deals with old wounds, members of the prison have to come to terms with their new environment and ask themselves if survival alone is enough.

episodes.name: Inmates
episodes.overview: The group encounters many obstacles in their quest to find stability and safety, but sometimes all they have to guide them is hope.

episodes.name: Claimed
episodes.overview: Just when Rick thinks he's going to be able to relax, he's faced with multiple immediate threats. Other members of the group deal with their past.

episodes.name: Still
episodes.overview: Faced with the day-to-day survival of life outside shelter, a simple request by someone in the group leads to a bizarre but enlightening mission.

episodes.name: Alone
episodes.overview: As one group finds what may be an ideal shelter, another group comes to realize that the best protection comes from those around them.

episodes.name: The Grove
episodes.overview: After finding an idyllic place to establish a new shelter, the group starts to question whether it is possible to go back to the way things were.

episodes.name: Us
episodes.overview: However brutal some survivors believe they must be to stay alive, we get to see that faith can sometimes be the strongest survival tool.

episodes.name: A
episodes.overview: Many paths collide. Rick faces sheer brutality. The group struggles to survive.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: After the season 4 finale left most of the main characters at the mercy of the sadistic inhabitants of Terminus. Season 5 will offer new directions for the group of survivors as scientist Eugene Porter promises a cure to the zombie virus if he can be safely escorted to Washington DC, but getting there is easier said than done.

episodes.name: No Sanctuary
episodes.overview: We learn the true motives of the Terminans as Rick and the group find themselves in a vulnerable situation. Will they be able to work together?

episodes.name: Strangers
episodes.overview: With supplies running low and not knowing whether to trust the people around them, Rick leads a mission where the risk might not be worth the reward.

episodes.name: Four Walls and a Roof
episodes.overview: Rick and the group find themselves pitted against some very nasty people, but our group might just have a plan to gain the upper hand.

episodes.name: Slabtown
episodes.overview: Beth gets to meet a whole group of other survivors, but what looks safe and nice on the outside has a bit of a dark side.

episodes.name: Self Help
episodes.overview: A new set of issues confront our group while on a mission. Will they be able to push through and survive these challenges? Or better yet, each other?

episodes.name: Consumed
episodes.overview: Cautiously, members of our group must venture into a familiar location on a heroic rescue mission. It's a huge stage, but so are the stakes.

episodes.name: Crossed
episodes.overview: Between holding down the church and going on a rescue mission, our group is spread pretty thin. Is this going to be the breaking point?

episodes.name: Coda
episodes.overview: Rules and morals have been tossed aside by new enemies. Rick will try to find a peaceful agreement, but they might prefer violence.

episodes.name: What Happened and What's Going On
episodes.overview: After all the recent trials the group has faced, a slight detour might prove to be the solution they've been looking for.

episodes.name: Them
episodes.overview: Life on the road has left the group beaten and beleaguered. Will they be able to trudge along? Are they even the same people they once were?

episodes.name: The Distance
episodes.overview: Lasting through a spectacular storm, Rick and the group meet a seemingly friendly person. Can they be trusted or are they just manipulating Rick?

episodes.name: Remember
episodes.overview: Adjusting into a new lifestyle is proving difficult for the group. Has life on the road proven too treacherous to go back to who they once were?

episodes.name: Forget
episodes.overview: Rick and the group continue to acclimate to their new surroundings. Will they be able to go back to normalcy? Then again, what is normal now?

episodes.name: Spend
episodes.overview: While trying to secure their new home, Rick and his group face many challenges, some life threatening. Is this really the utopia it seems to be?

episodes.name: Try
episodes.overview: The group realizes that sheltered life might not be possible as life within the walls starts to mimic life outside. Will these setbacks break Rick?

episodes.name: Conquer
episodes.overview: Daryl experiences trouble on a run, while Rick and his group continue to feel like outsiders in Alexandria, where trouble is creeping into the gates.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Rick attempts to use his authority in Alexandria to keep the inhabitants safe, even as a new threat looms.

episodes.name: First Time Again
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are still having trouble assimilating into Alexandria. Will a new threat bring them closer together or drive them further apart?

episodes.name: JSS
episodes.overview: Just when it looks like things can return to normal, or as normal as things can be in the apocalypse, a new problem arises for the Alexandrians.

episodes.name: Thank You
episodes.overview: A return home doesn't go as expected.

episodes.name: Here's Not Here
episodes.overview: A new face and setting are introduced. With all that's gone on in the apocalypse, can people be trusted?

episodes.name: Now
episodes.overview: Trouble is inside and outside the gate.

episodes.name: Always Accountable
episodes.overview: Daryl, Abraham and Sasha encounter many obstacles and a new threat while trying to return to Alexandria.

episodes.name: Heads Up
episodes.overview: Things in Alexandria are quiet, briefly.

episodes.name: Start to Finish
episodes.overview: Multiple problems crash together.

episodes.name: No Way Out
episodes.overview: While trying to escape Alexandria, Rick and his group meet trouble when sudden noise draws walkers towards them with what could be fatal consequences.

episodes.name: The Next World
episodes.overview: A simple scavenging run proves to be more tricky, when the survivors are not the only ones after a goldmine of supplies.

episodes.name: Knots Untie
episodes.overview: After Rick comes to the realization that Alexandria might not be as safe as he thought, decisions must be made about where to go from here.

episodes.name: Not Tomorrow Yet
episodes.overview: Rick and the group realize the only way to maintain the peace of Alexandria is to fight a new enemy. This time, though, our group might be outmatched.

episodes.name: The Same Boat
episodes.overview: With no hope of safety in Alexandria, Rick and his band of survivors soon discover a larger world with new dangers and new opportunities.

episodes.name: Twice as Far
episodes.overview: Two separate groups leave Alexandria for supplies, and while both worry over the future of the community, they will face immediate danger.

episodes.name: East
episodes.overview: When someone goes missing in Alexandria, the community goes on alert, and search parties venture out.

episodes.name: Last Day on Earth
episodes.overview: To save one of their own, Rick's group must venture outside the walls; their experience changes their lives forever.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Rick and his group's world becomes even more brutal due to Negan's deadly example of what happens if they don't live under his rules. Everyone must begin again.

episodes.name: The Day Will Come When You Won't Be
episodes.overview: Rick and his group kneel helplessly before Negan and the Saviors. What Negan does will haunt those who survive forever.

episodes.name: The Well
episodes.overview: For a number of familiar faces, a new, well-established community seems too good to be true.

episodes.name: The Cell
episodes.overview: A new group of survivors seem to have it all in their impressive community, however, there is a price.

episodes.name: Service
episodes.overview: Alexandria gets a sobering visit.

episodes.name: Go Getters
episodes.overview: Saddled with grief and surrounded by enemies, members of the group try to find safety at the Hilltop before it's too late.

episodes.name: Swear
episodes.overview: Someone stumbles upon a brand new society unlike anything seen before.

episodes.name: Sing Me a Song
episodes.overview: A deeper look at the Sanctuary and the world of the Saviors. Members of Alexandria look for supplies.

episodes.name: Hearts Still Beating
episodes.overview: Negan's unwelcome visit to Alexandria continues as other members scavenge for supplies and things quickly spin out of control.

episodes.name: Rock in the Road
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are led to a new community where they are introduced to its inhabitants and ruler. A familiar face resurfaces.

episodes.name: New Best Friends
episodes.overview: While searching for a missing Alexandrian, Rick and his group encounter a mysterious collective, its inhabitants unlike any they have come across.

episodes.name: Hostiles and Calamities
episodes.overview: An Alexandrian discovers that he must navigate the mysterious, confusing and horrifying world within the Saviors' Sanctuary.

episodes.name: Say Yes
episodes.overview: The group scavenges for supplies; back in Alexandria, someone must make a morally challenging decision.

episodes.name: Bury Me Here
episodes.overview: Things do not go as planned when a group of Kingdommers deliver goods to the Saviors during a routine supply drop-off.

episodes.name: The Other Side
episodes.overview: The Saviors visit the Hilltop unexpectedly, surprising everyone, with plans of taking more than supplies.

episodes.name: Something They Need
episodes.overview: A group of Alexandrians embarks on a journey to the distant community; one member of the group must make a heartbreaking decision.

episodes.name: The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
episodes.overview: The stakes continue to grow higher as paths cross; the group enacts an intricate plan.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: Rick and his survivors bring "All-Out War" to Negan and his forces. The Saviors are larger, better-equipped, and ruthless - but Rick and the unified communities are fighting for the promise of a brighter future. The battle lines are drawn as they launch into a kinetic, action-packed offensive.

episodes.name: Mercy
episodes.overview: Rick and his group, along with the Kingdom and Hilltop, have banded together to bring the fight to Negan and the Saviors.

episodes.name: The Damned
episodes.overview: The plan involving Alexandrians, Kingdommers and Hilltoppers unfolds. As Rick continues to fight, he encounters a familiar face.

episodes.name: Monsters
episodes.overview: Conflict with the Saviors leads to unintended consequences for the Hilltop, the Kingdom, and Alexandria; morality proves tricky in wartime.

episodes.name: Some Guy
episodes.overview: A new weapon in the Savior arsenal proves to be a giant hurdle as fighting continues between Rick's forces and those of the Saviors.

episodes.name: The Big Scary U
episodes.overview: With war raging all around him, we get a close look at Negan and the lives of the Saviors during the conflict through a familiar set of eyes.

episodes.name: The King, the Widow, and Rick
episodes.overview: With things looking up for Rick and the group, an argument breaks out at the Hilltop; the consequences of the decision are life versus death.

episodes.name: Time for After
episodes.overview: Negan has to enlist the help of his lieutenants in solving a huge issue facing the Sanctuary; Rick and the group continue to enact the plan.

episodes.name: How It's Gotta Be
episodes.overview: Every story and battle comes crashing together.

episodes.name: Honor
episodes.overview: Rick faces new difficulties after a battle. Meanwhile, the fight continues in other communities as core members face hard decisions.

episodes.name: The Lost and the Plunderers
episodes.overview: Groups unite their forces and converge on the Hilltop. Meanwhile, Aaron and Enid search for allies. Simon takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.name: Dead or Alive Or
episodes.overview: Daryl finds himself in bad company as his group heads to the Hilltop; Maggie makes difficult decisions at the Hilltop; Gabriel's faith becomes tested.

episodes.name: The Key
episodes.overview: Hilltop's leadership faces a difficult dilemma after the arrival of unexpected visitors. Rick comes face to face with an adversary.

episodes.name: Do Not Send Us Astray
episodes.overview: Trouble arises when unexpected visitors arrive at the Hilltop and the community is thrust into action; heartbreaking discoveries are made.

episodes.name: Still Gotta Mean Something
episodes.overview: A Heaps prisoner makes a discovery; Carol searches for someone in the nearby forest; Rick and Morgan find themselves in the company of strangers.

episodes.name: Worth
episodes.overview: With the threat of the Saviors still looming, Aaron continues searching for allies. Daryl and Rosita take action and confront an old friend.

episodes.name: Wrath
episodes.overview: The communities join forces in the last stand against the Saviors as all-out war unfolds.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: With the defeat of Negan and the Saviors, the survivors are now rebuilding civilisation under Rick’s leadership. However, the group are forced to face their biggest threat yet as the walkers around them have started whispering.

episodes.name: A New Beginning
episodes.overview: Rick and his group make a risky run into Washington, D.C. to search for artifacts they will need to build the civilization he and Carl envisioned.

episodes.name: The Bridge
episodes.overview: The communities join forces to restore a bridge that will facilitate communication and trade. Someone is gravely injured at the construction site.

episodes.name: Warning Signs
episodes.overview: Rick's vision for the future is threatened by a mysterious disappearance that divides the work camp where the communities are building a bridge.

episodes.name: The Obliged
episodes.overview: Rick's vision of a civilized future is threatened by a sudden reckoning with past sins that remain unavenged and unforgiven.

episodes.name: What Comes After
episodes.overview: Rick is forced to face the past as he struggles to maintain the safety of the communities and protect the future he and Carl envisioned.

episodes.name: Who Are You Now?
episodes.overview: The Survivors encounter unfamiliar faces outside the safety of their community's walls and must decide whether or not this new group can be trusted.

episodes.name: Stradivarius
episodes.overview: Carol seeks out an old friend living alone in a wilderness teeming with walkers; survivors make the perilous trek to a new home.

episodes.name: Evolution
episodes.overview: A small rescue mission braves a dangerous herd in their hunt for a missing comrade, only to discover a surprising threat that could doom them all.

episodes.name: Adaptation
episodes.overview: The group unmasks a disturbing and dangerous new threat. An escaped captive revisits his past.

episodes.name: Omega
episodes.overview: A captive or a refugee? A new arrival at the Hilltop opens up about the leader of a group of mask-wearing savages. A search party sets out on a daring mission to find two missing friends.

episodes.name: Bounty
episodes.overview: The savage group led by Alpha confronts the Hilltop in a harrowing attempt to retrieve her daughter; a supply run for the Kingdom turns into a dangerous quest.

episodes.name: Guardians
episodes.overview: While one community struggles to ease tensions that threaten to divide from within, the true nature of another group comes into focus; a mission to rescue a friend has deadly consequences.

episodes.name: Chokepoint
episodes.overview: Daryl's daring rescue mission forces Alpha to unleash a group of her own to retrieve what belongs to her, even if the price is paid in blood; the Kingdom's plans to reunite the communities are put in jeopardy.

episodes.name: Scars
episodes.overview: An outsider's arrival forces Alexandria to rehash devastating old wounds; eye-opening secrets from the past are revealed.

episodes.name: The Calm Before
episodes.overview: The fair at the Kingdom is underway, with all four communities coming together in celebration for the first time in years, while some pacts are renewed, other deals will come at a much steeper price.

episodes.name: The Storm
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of an overwhelming loss, the communities must brave a ferocious blizzard; as one group deals with an enemy from within, another is forced to make a life or death decision.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: It is now Spring, a few months after the end of Season 9, when our group of survivors dared to cross into Whisperer territory during the harsh winter. The collected communities are still dealing with the after effects of Alpha’s horrific display of power, reluctantly respecting the new borderlines being imposed on them, all while organizing themselves into a militia-style fighting force, preparing for a battle that may be unavoidable. But the Whisperers are a threat unlike any they have ever faced. Backed by a massive horde of the dead it is seemingly a fight they cannot win.

episodes.name: Lines We Cross
episodes.overview: The group continue to train in Oceanside in case the Whisperers return. Tensions are high as our heroes struggle to hold onto their concept of civilization.

episodes.name: We Are the End of the World
episodes.overview: The origins of Alpha and Beta are revealed. Alpha attempts to toughen up Lydia as they prepare to walk with the dead. Meanwhile, the Whisperers create their herds.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.overview: The threat of the Whisperers return leads to paranoia sweeping over Alexandria; in the meantime, Carol battles with the need for revenge.

episodes.name: Silence the Whisperers
episodes.overview: Still paranoid Alexandrians get riled up over the Whisperers and take their fear out on Negan; back at Hilltop, the group deals with an unexpected safety issue.

episodes.name: What It Always Is
episodes.overview: Supplies go missing from Hilltop, Negan is idolized by an Alexandrian, and Ezekiel holds a secret.

episodes.name: Bonds
episodes.overview: Carol and Daryl go on a mission together while Siddiq struggles to solve a mystery.

episodes.name: Open Your Eyes
episodes.overview: Carol pushes boundaries that make Daryl uncomfortable. Alpha and Beta have reservations about someone.

episodes.name: The World Before
episodes.overview: A fight causes tensions in Oceanside while the Alexandrians set out on a high-stakes mission.

episodes.name: Squeeze
episodes.overview: Our group must figure out how to get out of a precarious situation.

episodes.name: Stalker
episodes.overview: Our group must defend Alexandria from a threatening outside force.

episodes.name: Morning Star
episodes.overview: The Whisperers are coming for Hilltop. After Daryl and Lydia's encounter with Alpha, the communities must decide whether to run or fight. Meanwhile, Eugene's communication with Stephanie gets complicated.

episodes.name: Walk with Us
episodes.overview: Alpha and the Whisperers attack Hilltop, with Negan's help.

episodes.name: What We Become
episodes.overview: Michonne takes Virgil back to his mysterious island to reunite with his family; in exchange, Virgil promises weapons that could change the tide of the Whisperer War.

episodes.name: Look at the Flowers
episodes.overview: Heroes and villains reckon with the aftermath of the Hilltop fire; Eugene takes a group on a journey to meet Stephanie, with the hopes of befriending another civilisation.

episodes.name: The Tower
episodes.overview: The communities prepare for the final battle of the Whisperers' War. Meanwhile, Eugene's group encounters Princess.

episodes.name: A Certain Doom
episodes.overview: The final battle against Beta and his allies is at its peak. Aaron and Alden find themselves in a predicament.

episodes.name: Home Sweet Home
episodes.overview: Maggie has returned with a story she is not ready to share, even when her past catches up to her. Negan’s safety is at stake again. Daryl and Maggie fight an unseen and unknown threat.

episodes.name: Find Me
episodes.overview: An adventure for Daryl and Carol turns sideways when they come across an old cabin. It takes Daryl back to the years when he left the group after Rick disappeared as he relives a time that only the apocalypse could manifest.

episodes.name: One More
episodes.overview: Gabriel and Aaron search for food and supplies to bring back to Alexandria. Small tragedies lead to bigger tragedies as faith is broken and optimism is fragmented when they are put to the ultimate test.

episodes.name: Splinter
episodes.overview: Eugene, Ezekiel, Yumiko and Princess are captured and separated. Princess struggles with memories of her traumatic past and tries to escape one way or another with the help of Ezekiel.

episodes.name: Diverged
episodes.overview: Daryl and Carol come to a fork in the road and head their separate ways. Each going into their own type of survival mode, the easiest of challenges become much harder. Will their individual journeys be the tipping point needed to mend their friendship, or is the distance between them permanent?

episodes.name: Here's Negan
episodes.overview: Carol takes Negan on a journey, hoping to minimize the increasing tension. Negan reflects on the events that led him to this point and comes to a conclusion about his future.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: Alexandria has more people than it can manage to feed and protect. They must secure more food while they attempt to restore Alexandria before it collapses like countless other communities they have come across throughout the years. More haggard and hungrier than ever before, they must dig deeper to find the effort and strength to safeguard the lives of their children, even if it means losing their own.

episodes.name: Acheron (1)
episodes.overview: Daryl leads a mission team to scavenge the military base he discovered. Maggie tells her story, prompting a new mission for survival that only Negan can lead. Eugene and his group go through assessment by the Commonwealth's paramilitary police.

episodes.name: Acheron (2)
episodes.overview: Maggie's mission takes the team through a subway tunnel, challenged by lurking walkers and a recalcitrant Negan. With Eugene's group, Yumiko seeks answers about her brother and demands expedited processing into the Commonwealth.

episodes.name: Hunted
episodes.overview: Maggie's mission team gets separated and hunted by the Reapers. Carol, Rosita, Magna, and Kelly attempt to catch horses for Alexandria. Judith, R.J., Hershel, and Gracie cope with their parents going away.

episodes.name: Rendition
episodes.overview: Daryl and Dog get captured by the Reapers. Taken to the Meridian, they reconnect with a familiar figure from their past.

episodes.name: Out of the Ashes
episodes.overview: Aaron, Carol, Lydia, and Jerry go to the Hilltop ruins for blacksmith tools and nearby game; Eugene's group goes through orientation at the Commonwealth; Maggie and Negan trudge through the woods; Judith and the kids clash with teenagers.

episodes.name: On the Inside
episodes.overview: Escaping from walkers, Connie and Virgil hide in a house occupied by mysterious creatures. Pope tests Daryl's loyalty to the Reapers with a conflicting mission. Kelly leaves Alexandria in search of Connie.

episodes.name: Promises Broken
episodes.overview: Maggie and Elijah learn a new survival tactic from Negan. Eugene's group clears walkers to pay their fines. Yumiko interviews for an upper-class job. Daryl learns more about Leah and the Reapers. Gabriel encounters a man of God.

episodes.name: For Blood
episodes.overview: The Reapers defend Meridian from an incoming herd. Pope suspects Maggie is behind the attack, while Daryl treads carefully. Alexandrians scramble to protect themselves when a violent storm leaves them vulnerable to walkers.

episodes.name: No Other Way
episodes.overview: Daryl, Maggie, Gabriel, Negan, and Elijah battle the Reapers for food. Aaron and the Alexandrians must survive a storm.

episodes.name: New Haunts
episodes.overview: The heroes experience Halloween in the Commonwealth; Daryl and Rosita undergo military training led by Mercer; Carol investigates Ezekiel's medical condition.

episodes.name: Rogue Element
episodes.overview: Eugene looks for Stephanie after she mysteriously goes missing. Connie investigates a story on Trooper Davis. Carol helps Hornsby with a labor dispute at a drug farm.

episodes.name: The Lucky Ones
episodes.overview: Aaron and Maggie meet Governor Pamela Milton as she tours Alexandria, Oceanside and Hilltop. Ezekiel finds himself lucky during a routine checkup. Eugene processes Max's story.

episodes.name: Warlords
episodes.overview: Maggie, Lydia, and Elijah help a stranger from another community called Riverbend. They run into Aaron, who tells them about a mission he embarked on with Gabriel as emissaries for the Commonwealth.

episodes.name: The Rotten Core
episodes.overview: Maggie, Lydia, and Elijah help Aaron and Gabriel on a rescue mission. In the chaos, Negan finds himself watching over Hershel. Sebastian coerces Daryl and Rosita into pulling a heist.

episodes.name: Trust
episodes.overview: Hornsby marches Daryl and troops to confront Maggie at Hilltop. After a harrowing heist, Rosita gets Connie, Kelly, Eugene, and Max to investigate the Miltons. Ezekiel helps hospital patients in need.

episodes.name: Acts of God
episodes.overview: Maggie prepares to defend Hilltop and the people of Riverbend against Hornsby. Meanwhile, Hornsby hires Leah to kill her.

episodes.name: Lockdown
episodes.overview: Daryl and Negan rush to the Commonwealth to stop Hornsby from going after their families. Pamela deals with protestors demanding justice for Sebastian's crimes. Mercer needs Rosita's help to fight a swarm.

episodes.name: A New Deal
episodes.overview: Carol makes a deal with Pamela to wipe the slate clean on behalf of her friends. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia, and Elijah get on the road to Oceanside to fill them in on a plan. The Commonwealth celebrates Founders Day.

episodes.name: Variant
episodes.overview: Eugene goes on the run after the Founders Day incident. Pamela tasks Mercer to investigate his whereabouts, to Max and Princess' dismay. Meanwhile, Aaron, Jerry, Lydia, and Elijah encounter an unusual complication at an abandoned Renaissance Faire.

episodes.name: What's Been Lost
episodes.overview: Daryl and Carol investigate the whereabouts of their friends after Pamela disappeared them from the Commonwealth. Unfortunately, their only lead is Hornsby. Meanwhile, Pamela asks Yumiko to prosecute Eugene on behalf of the Commonwealth.

episodes.name: Outpost 22
episodes.overview: Separated from their children, Maggie, Gabriel, and Rosita track a military convoy to a mysterious destination. Ezekiel, Kelly, Negan, and Annie find themselves at a work site. Daryl and Carol follow a train that has taken Connie aboard.

episodes.name: Faith
episodes.overview: Ezekiel and Negan team up to lead a clandestine labor revolt against the Warden. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia, and Elijah catch up with Luke and Jules fleeing Oceanside. Eugene stands trial with Yumiko as his defense attorney.

episodes.name: Family
episodes.overview: The Alexandrians and the prisoners head back to the Commonwealth to confront Pamela Milton. A swarm approaches the city.

episodes.name: Rest in Peace
episodes.overview: Daryl and Carol rush Judith to the hospital. Rosita, Eugene, and Gabriel search for Coco. Maggie and Negan take arms against Pamela. As the citizens of the Commonwealth deal with the herd, our heroes assemble for one last stand to save their future.

items.title: Twinkling Watermelon
items.overview: A CODA (child of deaf adult) student born with a gift for music crash lands at an unfamiliar place after time traveling through a suspicious music shop. There, he forms the band Watermelon Sugar with other mysterious youths.
items.tagline: One's youth is like twinkling watermelons. It is just there to shine.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Eun-gyeol, a seemingly ordinary high school student, leads a clandestine double life. By day, he is a model student, but by night, he becomes a guitarist for a band in Hongdae. Unexpectedly, he travels back in time. Together, they form a band called 'Watermelon Sugar' and forge a deep bond. Along the way, Eun-gyeol encounters an enigmatic girl and falls in love. This tale intertwines elements of coming-of-age, fairytales, and magic, creating a captivating story of growth and self-discovery.

episodes.name: Passion Is Born
episodes.overview: Eun-gyeol and his family move into a new neighborhood. He meets a man who offers to teach him how to play the guitar, and Eun-gyeol works hard to learn it. As he deals with bullies at school, he practices playing the guitar until he is as good as the man who taught him. However, tragedy strikes, and he and his family are forced to move again.

episodes.name: Eun-gyeol Quits Music
episodes.overview: Eun-gyeol tries his best to quit music, but it's not easy for him to do. He gets scouted to join SPINE9, an indie band in Hongdae. To make things worse, he finally gets his hands on the guitar promised by the Viva Music store owner. He is torn by which path to take and finds himself walking into a suspicious music store.

episodes.name: Seoul 1995
episodes.overview: Eun-gyeol gets stuck in 1995 and doesn't know how to return to the present. What's worse is that he meets his young father, Yi-chan, who can talk and wants to start a band to impress a girl who isn't Eun-gyeol's mother. Eun-gyeol poses as Yoon Dong-jin, a musical genius, in order to try to become a member of Yi-chan's band.

episodes.name: Eun-gyeol Becomes Yi-chan's Tutor
episodes.overview: Eun-gyeol encounters Se-gyeong in her teens and learns a few things about her life that don't make sense in the future. Meanwhile, Yi-chan meets Chung-ah for the first time, but she doesn't say a word. Yi-chan tries to get away from Eun-gyeol, but Eun-gyeol follows him to the Snail Guesthouse and ends up becoming Yi-chan's math tutor.

episodes.name: Se-gyeong Leaves the Country
episodes.overview: Eun-gyeol resolves to stop the accident that caused Yi-chan to become deaf and clings to him, vowing to teach him everything he needs to know. He even promises to gift him the band Yi-chan needs. However, the school festival is in one month, and the person Yi-chan is doing this for has left the country and isn't going to return.

episodes.name: Se-gyeong Returns
episodes.overview: Everyone is confused at Se-gyeong's return, especially Eun-gyeol, who sternly warns her to stay away from Yi-chan. However, it doesn't work, and Se-gyeong approaches Yi-chan with different intentions. Meanwhile, Chung-ah can only stand by and watch as she realizes she's lost her chance to tell Yi-chan how she feels.

episodes.name: Where Are You Eun-gyeol?
episodes.overview: Chung-ah wakes up, realizing she's lying on a hospital bed, with the revelation that Yi-chan carried her there on his back. Later, Yi-chan learns her name from her tag for the first time. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol has been silent for days, causing concern for Yi-chan. Attempting to locate him, Yi-chan hands out flyers and ends up facing trouble with local thugs. Se-gyeong desperately meets with each band member to verify something important.

episodes.name: I Found Ha Eun-gyeol
episodes.overview: Eun-gyeol wakes up at the house of the Jinsung Family after the accident. He finds out that Chung-ah was the daughter of Chairman Yoon Gun-hyung. Meanwhile, Yi-chan is hospitalized after getting beat up by the local thugs. Se-gyeong tells him that Chung-ah was the one who called for help to save him. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol decides to help Chung-ah learn the sign language.

episodes.name: Friendship or Love?
episodes.overview: Astounded by Eun-gyeol's candid love confession for Se-gyeong, Yi-chan retaliates with a spirited punch. Eun-gyeol's attempts at self-defense lead to Yi-chan having a bleeding nose on both sides. The schoolyard transforms into a battleground as students try to intervene, and the entire situation gains momentum. Se-gyeong (actually Eun-yu) is left in shock by the unexpected confession. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol uncovers a hidden secret about Chung-ah.

episodes.name: Let Yourself Twinkle
episodes.overview: Eun-gyeol can't hide his feelings for Se-gyeong and ends up kissing her. Chung-ah's stepmother calls Eun-gyeol separately and tells him to quit before he teaches Chung-ah sign language. The members of the band decide to change their band name and theme right before the festival and ask Se-gyeong and Chung-ah for help. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol learns that Master has sent a helper for him.

episodes.name: Dangerous Rehearsal
episodes.overview: As the festival draws near, the boys are intensely focused on fine-tuning their band performance. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol reflects on a pivotal clue related to a potential accident leading to hearing loss. Believing Dong-jin to be the helper that Master mentioned, he pleads with Yi-chan to skip the rehearsal, but his request is dismissed. Meanwhile, Eun-yu grapples with the challenge of uncovering her mother's genuine first love.

episodes.name: The Day of Decision
episodes.overview: Eun-gyeol successfully cancels the rehearsal and prevents Yi-chan from getting seriously hurt. Chairman Yoon extends the contract with Eun-gyeol and changes the terms and conditions. The day of the festival is finally here, and Se-gyeong has to choose between Eun-gyeol and Yi-chan. Chung-ah decides not to show up at the festival.

episodes.name: The Final Festival
episodes.overview: As the enchanting glow of their festival fades, Eun-gyeol and Eun-yu acknowledge the depth of their feelings, hoping for a lasting connection. Meanwhile, the anticipated disbandment takes an unexpected turn, giving the boys another shot at the stage. The hurdle now is creating their own song, and Yi-chan suggests a gathering for this endeavor while musing on how to persuade Chung-ah to join.

episodes.name: Another Time Traveler
episodes.overview: Eun-gyeol and Se-gyeong realize that they’re both time travelers. He learns that Se-gyeong also had a mission to accomplish while she was in 1995. Eun-gyeol finds out that Chung-ah has been confined and abused for the past 12 years. Meanwhile, Se-gyeong tells Eun-gyeol that Yi-chan’s accident didn’t happen on the day before the festival and that it hasn’t happened yet.

episodes.name: The Hints
episodes.overview: Eun-yu drops clues about Yi-chan's real hearing loss incident to Eun-gyeol. Knowing that Eun-gyeol tends to shoulder blame for everything, she pledges to support him through this tough time. However, suspicions linger in her mind about the complexity of her connection with Eun-gyeol. Together, they methodically investigate everyone linked to the accident in search of the truth. Meanwhile, Yi-chan assures Eun-gyeol that he won't leave the house for the entire day.

episodes.name: Everything You Hoped for and More
episodes.overview: Yi-chan gets hit by a car and loses his hearing. Master tells Eun-gyeol to go back to his time, but he refuses, determined to catch the guy who hit Yi-chan. Se-gyeong convinces Eun-gyeol to return to 2023, and when he finally does, a completely different life awaits him.

items.title: Sterling Point
items.overview: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.

episodes.name: But I Just Took an Ambien
episodes.overview: After getting rejected from her dream summer program, Annie Jacobson discovers she and her twin brother, Connor, have inherited Sterling Point - a small island in the Muskoka area of Canada. A mysterious letter from the grandfather she was never allowed to meet sends Annie out on a secret solo trip in hopes of uncovering the truth about her family history.

episodes.name: She's Giving Single & Bi
episodes.overview: Annie's arrival in Muskoka takes a surprise turn when she finds the cabin she's inherited is already occupied by Ramona, a stranger with an uncanny resemblance to her adoptive mother. Their not-so-burgeoning relationship hits another bump over a letter from Gordon to Ramona that points to a buried connection between them, forcing both girls to reckon with a shared past they never knew existed.

episodes.name: My Lifelong Debilitating Wolf Phobia
episodes.overview: As Annie and Ramona clash, a revealing mixtape, an impulsive cottage party, and an unexpected kiss begins to thaw their tension-until Connor arrives with a bombshell that could tear it all apart.

episodes.name: Take Me to the Cliffs
episodes.overview: Desperate to convince Connor against selling Sterling Point, Annie spends the day showing him the island's charm, but tensions peak during a chaotic night at an outdoor movie. Ramona spirals over Oona's new flame, Ellis and Rory compete for Annie's attention, and new revelations emerge about Ramona's birth and Goldie's death.

episodes.name: I'm Not a Shots Girl Either
episodes.overview: It's Annie and Connor's 18th birthday, and they're spiraling in opposite directions - Connor throws an over-the-top birthday party, while Rory decides to take Annie for a night out with old friends. Meanwhile, Ramona, having been told the truth about her mother's death, does what she does best - avoidance. But when a distraught Maple shows up, Ramona's feelings finally come to the surface.

episodes.name: I Still Bleed Through My Pants All the Time
episodes.overview: Unable to hide from his past, Steven returns to Muskoka hoping to repair broken relationships and bring Annie and Connor home. Meanwhile, Annie, Ramona, Oona, Ellis, and Connor head to Maple's camp to support her big performance, while Ramona and Oona enter the honeymoon phase of their blossoming romance. A shocking reveal sends Ramona into a spiral, threatening the fragile balance of the group.

episodes.name: Maybe It's Mackerel
episodes.overview: As tensions rise around the potential sale of Sterling Point, Ramona grapples with her decision to sell, while Annie, Ellis, Oona, and Sully struggle to sway her. When Ramona's past and future collide, she confronts her relationships with the people who want to control her fate, leading to unexpected revelations, an emotional confrontation, and a twist that changes everything.

episodes.name: I'm the Kid
episodes.overview: Annie and Ramona confront hard truths about their families and themselves, forcing each woman to decide what truly matters as they navigate the tensions between their past choices and future hopes.

items.title: Outer Banks
items.overview: A tight-knit group of teens unearths a long-buried secret, setting off a chain of illicit events that takes them on an adventure they'll never forget.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: On an island of haves and have-nots, teen John B enlists his three best friends to hunt for a legendary treasure linked to his father's disappearance.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: After a hurricane, John B, JJ, Pope and Kiara plunge headlong into danger and adventure when they find a mysterious sunken wreck.

episodes.name: The Lucky Compass
episodes.overview: Convinced that the clue found onboard the boat connects to his missing father, John B leads his friends on an increasingly frantic search for answers.

episodes.name: The Forbidden Zone
episodes.overview: As the gang hatches an illicit scheme to get to the bottom of the deep-sea mystery, John B confronts Sarah while Pope jumps at the chance for revenge.

episodes.name: Spy Games
episodes.overview: When John B's supervision-free home life catches up to him, he receives a well-timed assist — and some spiffing up — from the last person he expects.

episodes.name: Midsummers
episodes.overview: John B believes he's made a breakthrough in the hunt for the gold, but his desire to include Sarah in the quest causes friction among the friends.

episodes.name: Parcel 9
episodes.overview: A spooky island legend, a broken friendship and John B’s new living situation keep the crew on their toes as they search high and low for the treasure.

episodes.name: Dead Calm
episodes.overview: JJ's reckless behavior ramps up when the friends try to score some quick cash. Meanwhile, John B grows closer to Sarah — and makes her dad suspicious.

episodes.name: The Runway
episodes.overview: John B finally learns the truth about his dad — and sets off a chain of events that jeopardizes everything he and his friends have fought to accomplish.

episodes.name: The Bell Tower
episodes.overview: With his options dwindling and enemies closing in, John B looks for an exit plan. Sarah feels pressured to pick a side. Pope lets his emotions out.

episodes.name: The Phantom
episodes.overview: An island crawling with law enforcement and a looming tropical storm are just two of the obstacles facing John B as he tries to make his escape.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: With a fortune in gold at stake and their futures on the line, the Pogues rush headlong into danger and a fresh mystery as they face foes old and new.

episodes.name: The Gold
episodes.overview: John B tries to evade capture as he zeroes in on the gold, but a promise to Sarah could derail his plans. Back home, his friends face life without him.

episodes.name: The Heist
episodes.overview: With time running out, John B and Sarah strike an uneasy bargain, while Kiara, JJ and Pope search for evidence that could implicate Ward and Rafe.

episodes.name: Prayers
episodes.overview: A desperate scramble for help lands John B and Sarah in questionable surroundings. Pope receives a mysterious summons to an out-of-town meeting.

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: Low on gas and strapped for cash, John B and Sarah run into trouble. Pope's appointment in Charleston takes an ominous turn over a proposed trade.

episodes.name: The Darkest Hour
episodes.overview: JJ cooks up a risky plan to help out John B. Pope hunts down information about the key. Kiara and Sarah both deal with family fallout over the Pogues.

episodes.name: My Druthers
episodes.overview: John B bristles when Sarah reconnects with a former flame. Ward's web of lies starts to unravel. Pope discovers a shocking family secret.

episodes.name: The Bonfire
episodes.overview: Reeling from Ward's actions, Sarah finds her loyalties to John B and the Pogues put to the test. At the annual bonfire, jealousies and tempers flare.

episodes.name: The Cross
episodes.overview: Armed with new clues, the group braves perilous roads and swampland as they race to keep part of Pope's history from falling into the wrong hands.

episodes.name: Trapped
episodes.overview: The Pogues deal with a slew of setbacks — a medical emergency, a nosy neighbor, parental ultimatums — as they attempt to save Pope's family legacy.

episodes.name: The Coastal Venture
episodes.overview: John B, Pope, JJ and Kiara brace for a showdown on board the ship, while Sarah realizes the harsh truth of her distressing family situation.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: New adventures take the Pogues to the Caribbean and far beyond as the friends are pulled into a dangerous rival's hunt for a legendary lost city.

episodes.name: Poguelandia
episodes.overview: An unexpected rescuer takes the Pogues from a remote island to Barbados, where they encounter a powerful treasure hunter with his own agenda.

episodes.name: The Bells
episodes.overview: As her friends mount a rescue attempt, Kiara agrees to an uneasy truce with Rafe. A familiar sound grabs John B's attention.

episodes.name: Fathers and Sons
episodes.overview: Big John and John B pick up where they left off — for better or worse. Cleo and Pope form a new club. Rafe reconnects with Ward.

episodes.name: The Diary
episodes.overview: An emotional homecoming is easier for some than others. Big John searches for the diary. Ward's plans for a prized possession don't sit well with Rafe.

episodes.name: Heists
episodes.overview: Sarah convinces an old friend to help with a high-risk, high-reward mission. Looking to access a museum collection, John B and his dad get creative.

episodes.name: The Dark Forest
episodes.overview: Secrets threaten to drive a wedge between John B and his friends. Sarah revisits a past life. Pope reaches a breaking point.

episodes.name: Happy Anniversary
episodes.overview: With Singh on the move, John B and JJ scramble to catch him. Pope makes a breakthrough. Sarah questions where her loyalties lie.

episodes.name: Tapping the Rudder
episodes.overview: Rafe lays his cards on the table and Sarah calls in two favors. JJ's unorthodox plan to get to South America lands John B in hot water.

episodes.name: Welcome to Kitty Hawk
episodes.overview: With their ride to Orinoco waiting on the tarmac, Kiara and JJ run into several complications. Rafe has a change of heart.

episodes.name: Secret of the Gnomon
episodes.overview: The Pogues' search for El Dorado brings them deep into the jungle, where John B and Sarah face the ultimate test of their courage and family bonds.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The Pogues return home and start living their best life, but it's not long before they're back to doing what they do best: hunting for treasure.

episodes.name: The Enduro
episodes.overview: Flush with success, the Pogues have big plans to invest in their future. But when their fortunes take a turn, will a bold gamble pay off?

episodes.name: Blackbeard
episodes.overview: A strange tale of a family curse makes the Pogues think twice about accepting a lucrative offer to search for an amulet linked to Blackbeard.

episodes.name: The Lupine Corsairs
episodes.overview: The sheriff grills the Pogues about their dealings with Wes Genrette. JJ and Kiara have another close call. Pope gets wind of a mysterious artifact.

episodes.name: The Swell
episodes.overview: Tensions rise along with the waves when the Pogues and the Kooks hit the beach for the year's best swell. As Pope digs for info, Cleo faces down danger.

episodes.name: Albatross
episodes.overview: The Pogues scramble when the sheriff turns up at the worst possible time. JJ receives a mysterious letter. The amulet's clues point to Charleston.

episodes.name: The Town Council
episodes.overview: JJ learns about his past. The Pogues rally support for a zoning meeting that will decide their fate. Sarah and John B suss out a theory about the scroll.

episodes.name: Mothers and Fathers
episodes.overview: As a confrontation on Goat Island turns perilous, Sarah confirms a suspicion while searching for JJ, Pope's future falters, and Topper taunts John B.

episodes.name: Family Plot
episodes.overview: While JJ heads out on a grim mission with Groff, Sarah reveals her big news, Pope faces a moment of truth, and Rafe helps the sheriff connect the dots.

episodes.name: The Storm
episodes.overview: Pursued by police, the Pogues embark on the next stage of their mission with help from an unexpected source. Tensions flare when John B confides in JJ.

episodes.name: The Blue Crown
episodes.overview: The hunt for Groff heats up in Morocco. In a deadly race to claim the crown, loyalties are tested — and a moment of treachery changes everything.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Season 5 finds the Pogues at their absolute breaking point following the tragic loss  in Morocco. Stranded far from home and mourning the heart of their crew, they’ve lost the Blue Crown and continue to face a gauntlet of familiar threats. With Chandler Groff still at large, Dalia and the Corsairs closing in, and the Kooks ensuring the Pogues have no home to return to, John B, Sarah, Kiara, Pope, and Cleo must rely on their scrappy instincts—and an uneasy alliance with Rafe—to keep from falling apart for good. Their mission is now a desperate race to reclaim their future and finally win the freedom they’ve been chasing since the beginning. It’s the Pogues against the world as they seek to avenge their best friend and bring it on home…one final time.

items.title: Obsession

seasons.name: Season 1

episodes.name: Episode 1

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Having finally reached his goal, Hae-kang prepares to disappear without a trace. But when he heads to the bank to claim the cash, everything unravels.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Conflict erupts between owners and rental tenants after outsiders are caught using the sauna, forcing Hae-kang to find a way to bridge the divide.

episodes.name: Episode 9

episodes.name: Episode 10

episodes.name: Episode 11

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Despite setbacks, Hae-kang sets his endgame in motion to bring down Chung-won once and for all. Will justice finally come to the apartment complex?

items.title: Bleach
items.overview: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever. Now, with a newfound wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil.

episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai remembers his past with Rukia Kuchiki and begs Ichigo Kurosaki to save her in his stead.

episodes.name: Miracle! The Mysterious New Hero
episodes.overview: In the Human World, Yuzu Kurosaki finds a cat named Raku and is drawn into an adventure with Don Kanonji and his Karakura-Raizer Team.

episodes.name: Tragedy of Dawn
episodes.overview: As the Gotei 13 reacts to 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai's defeat, Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto declares war against the Ryoka.

episodes.name: Aizen Assassinated! The Darkness which Approaches
episodes.overview: While the Gotei 13 deals with the death of 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen, Ichigo Kurosaki and his group attempt to enter Senzaikyū once again.

episodes.name: Zaraki Kenpachi Approaches!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes.name: Motive of the Fist
episodes.overview: Yasutora Sado battles with 8th Division captain, Shunsui Kyōraku.

episodes.name: Desperation! The Broken Zangetsu
episodes.overview: As the high-ranking members of the Gotei 13 continue to react to 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen's murder, Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes.name: The Immortal Man
episodes.overview: After learning to access the power of Zangetsu in addition to his own, Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes.name: The Shinigami whom Ganju Met
episodes.overview: While 11th Division Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi reminisces about her history with her captain, Kenpachi Zaraki, Ganju Shiba and 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada reach Rukia Kuchiki's cell in Senzaikyū.

episodes.name: Reunion, Ichigo and Rukia
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki arrives at the White Tower and reunites with Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.name: Yoruichi, Goddess of Flash, Dances!
episodes.overview: Yoruichi Shihōin saves Ichigo Kurosaki and decides to help him attain Bankai.

episodes.name: The Despicable Shinigami
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida and Orihime Inoue are confronted by 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

episodes.name: Ishida Ultimate Power!
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida removes his Sanrei Glove to defeat 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

episodes.name: Overcome Your Limits!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his Bankai Training.

episodes.name: Authentic Records! School of Shinigami
episodes.overview: 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori recalls her past at the Shin'ō Academy.

episodes.name: The Avengers
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki continues his Bankai Training, 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori confronts 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya over the contents of the letter left by her captain, Sōsuke Aizen.

episodes.name: Hitsugaya Roars!
episodes.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru.

episodes.name: Rukia's Nightmare
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki recalls her past with Kaien Shiba.

episodes.name: The Reviving Lion
episodes.overview: The Karakura Superheroes come together once more and fight a Hollow.

episodes.name: Morning of the Sentence
episodes.overview: As the day of Rukia Kuchiki's execution arrives, various groups around the Seireitei move out and clash with one another.

episodes.name: Renji, Oath of the Soul! Death Match with Byakuya
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai battles his captain, Byakuya Kuchiki.

episodes.name: Ichimaru Gin's Temptation, Resolution Shattered
episodes.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and his subordinates battle the 7th and 9th Division captains and lieutenants.

episodes.name: An Accomplished Oath! Get back Rukia!
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki's execution ceremony commences, but does not proceed as planned.

episodes.name: The Strongest Shinigami! Ultimate Confrontation Between Teacher and Students
episodes.overview: After the interruption of Rukia Kuchiki's execution, battles commence all across the Seireitei.

episodes.name: Supersonic Battle! Determine the Goddess of Battle
episodes.overview: Yoruichi Shihōin battles 2nd Division Captain Suì-Fēng.

episodes.name: Senbonzakura, Crushed! Zangetsu Thrusts through the Sky
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki continue their battle.

episodes.name: Unseal! The Black Blade, the Miraculous Power
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki activate their Bankai.

episodes.name: Conclusion of the Death Match! White Pride and Black Desire
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki's battle reaches its conclusion.

episodes.name: Reality of the Despair, the Assassin's Dagger is Swung
episodes.overview: A conspiracy connecting several recent events in Soul Society is revealed.

episodes.name: Aizen Stands! Horrible Ambitions
episodes.overview: 4th Division Lieutenant Isane Kotetsu informs the Gotei 13 that Sōsuke Aizen is alive as the latter reveals his machinations.

episodes.name: Gather Together! Group of the Strongest Shinigami!
episodes.overview: 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen removes the Hōgyoku from Rukia Kuchiki's Soul and retreats to Hueco Mundo.

episodes.name: Rukia's Resolution, Ichigo's Feelings
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends say their goodbyes in Soul Society before heading back home through the Dangai.

episodes.name: Invasion of the Shinigami World, Again
episodes.overview: The Bounts arrive in Soul Society. Rukia Kuchiki meets up with Yoshi once more.

episodes.name: The Bount Assault! The Gotei 13 of Destructive Earthquake
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki squares off against Yoshi. Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto informs the other captains of the Bounts' origins.

episodes.name: Hitsugaya's Decision! The Clash Approaches
episodes.overview: Jin Kariya recruits men from Kusajishi as Ichigo Kurosaki and friends finally arrive at Kūkaku Shiba's house.

episodes.name: Byakuya Takes the Field! Dance of the Wind-Splitting Cherry Blossoms
episodes.overview: Captain Byakuya Kuchiki battles Jin Kariya when Ichigo Kurosaki shows up to help.

episodes.name: Ichigo, Byakuya, Kariya, The Battle of the Three Extremes!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki continue to fight a continuously healing Jin Kariya, Ran'Tao shows up, prompting Kariya to leave.

episodes.name: Hitsugaya Strikes! Slice the Enemy in the Middle of the Forest
episodes.overview: Ran'Tao reveals the reason for her resemblance to Yoshino Sōma as Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya faces off against Maki Ichinose.

episodes.name: Clash! Kenpachi Zaraki vs. Maki Ichinose
episodes.overview: Captain Kenpachi Zaraki arrives to stop Maki Ichinose.

episodes.name: Shinigami vs. Shinigami! The Uncontrollable Power
episodes.overview: The Bounts break into Seireitei and Captain Suì-Fēng encounters Mabashi.

episodes.name: Suì-Fēng Dies? The Last of the Special Forces
episodes.overview: Captain Suì-Fēng survives her poisoning by using her own poison to nullify Mabashi's, and kills Mabashi.

episodes.name: Mayuri's Bankai!! Sawatari: Clash of the Demon
episodes.overview: Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi, of the 12th Division, battles against the Bount, Sawatari.

episodes.name: The Last Quincy! The Exploding Power
episodes.overview: As Jin Kariya looks for the Jokai Crest, Uryū Ishida battles the Bount, Yoshi.

episodes.name: Ishida, Exceeding the Limits to Attack!
episodes.overview: As Uryū Ishida defeats the Bount, Yoshi, Jin Kariya prepares to destroy the Soul Society.

episodes.name: 10th Division's Death Struggle! The Release of Hyōrinmaru
episodes.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles against the Bount, Gō Koga.

episodes.name: Kariya! Countdown to the Detonation
episodes.overview: As the Shinigami learn more about the Jōkaishō, Ran'Tao confronts Jin Kariya.

episodes.name: Life and Revenge! Ishida, the Ultimate Choice
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida confronts the Bount, Jin Kariya.

episodes.name: The Swung-Down Edge! The Moment of Ruin
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Jin Kariya battle each other, the Shinigami look for the other Jōkaishō to re-seal them.

episodes.name: The Wailing Bount! The Last Clash
episodes.overview: The battle between Ichigo Kurosaki and Jin Kariya concludes.

episodes.name: Ichigo and Rukia, Thoughts in the Revolving Around Heaven
episodes.overview: Following the battle with the Bounts, things slowly return to normal.

seasons.name: Thousand-Year Blood War
seasons.overview: The final arc of the Bleach series, where Ichigo Kurosaki and the Soul Reapers face off against the powerful Quincy army, led by Yhwach, in a battle that threatens the balance of all worlds.

episodes.name: The Blood Warfare
episodes.overview: The Soul Society is observing a sudden surge in the number of Hollows being destroyed.

episodes.name: Foundation Stones
episodes.overview: Arrancars Nel Tu and Pesche Guatiche have come to seek Ichigo’s help explaining that Hueco Mundo is under attack by an unknown enemy. Unable to ignore the situation, Ichigo and his friends decide to set out for Hueco Mundo.

episodes.name: March of the Starcross
episodes.overview: Ichigo and his friends arrive in Hueco Mundo to confront Quilge Opie and learn that their latest enemy are Quincies.

episodes.name: Kill the Shadow
episodes.overview: The Wandenreich mobilizes its elite force, the Stern Ritter, to annihilate the Soul Society. Creating massive flaming pillars of Reishi as a distraction, the Stern Ritter easily enter the Soul Society to bring carnage to the Soul Reapers.

episodes.name: Wrath as a Lightning
episodes.overview: Quilge Opie uses his power to imprison Ichigo inside the Garganta. As he tries to break free, Ichigo begins to hear, through his Soul Phone, the screams of the Soul Reapers falling to the enemy's onslaught.

episodes.name: The Fire
episodes.overview: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto confronts Yhwach for the first time in a thousand years. As Yhwach finally draws his sword against Genryusai, the Soul Reapers notice an abnormal change taking place across the Seireitei.

episodes.name: Born in the Dark
episodes.overview: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto learns that the Yhwach he defeated was an impostor. The real Yhwach then reveals himself and easily kills Genryusai, sending a wave of shock and devastation across the Soul Reapers.

episodes.name: The Shooting Star Project [Zero Mix]
episodes.overview: Rescue efforts are being made across the Seireitei to find and help those who've survived the Stern Ritter attack. Meanwhile, Ichigo meets with Mayuri Kurotsuchi about fixing his broken Tensa Zangetsu.

episodes.name: The Drop
episodes.overview: Squad Zero brings Ichigo back to the Royal Palace to prepare for the coming battle. Meanwhile, Kyoraku is appointed as the new Head Captain to lead the Thirteen Court Guard Squads.

episodes.name: The Battle
episodes.overview: Kenpachi Zaraki removes his eye patch to fight Retsu Unohana, a.k.a. Yachiru Unohana, “The First Kenpachi.” Meanwhile, Ichigo and Renji head to Hoohden to meet Oh-Etsu Nimaiya, the man who is said to have created the Zanpakuto.

episodes.name: Everything but the Rain
episodes.overview: Ichigo is kicked out of the Royal Palace by Oh-etsu Nimaiya for failing his test. When Ichigo next opens his eyes, he finds himself standing in front of his house in the World of the Living.

episodes.name: Everything but the Rain: June Truth
episodes.overview: Squad 10 Captain Isshin Shiba of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads decides to not report his encounter with the Quincy named Masaki Kurosaki in the World of the Living to the Head Captain.

episodes.name: The Blade Is Me
