episodes.overview: Ichigo learns that he is the child born of a Soul Reaper and a Quincy. Finally understanding the truth behind his heritage, Ichigo decides to return to Hoohden with a renewed resolve to finish what he has started.

episodes.name: The Last 9 Days
episodes.overview: Ichigo prepares to leave the Royal Palace to return to the Seireitei but is stopped by Hyosube, who claims that Ichigo cannot defeat Yhwach as he is now.

episodes.name: PEACE FROM SHADOWS
episodes.overview: Yhwach sets his plan to end the world in nine days in motion.

episodes.name: THE FUNDAMENTAL VIRULENCE
episodes.overview: Mayuri receives a call from Urahara, who had stayed behind in Hueco Mundo.

episodes.name: HEART OF WOLF
episodes.overview: The Stern Ritters drive the Soul Reapers deeper into a corner.

episodes.name: RAGES AT RINGSIDE
episodes.overview: Kensei Muguruma joins the battle against Masculine.

episodes.name: THE WHITE HAZE
episodes.overview: A fearless Rukia takes on Äs Nödt.

episodes.name: I AM THE EDGE
episodes.overview: Isane and Yachiru are attacked by Gwenael.

episodes.name: THE HEADLESS STAR
episodes.overview: Candice, Meninas, Giselle, and Liltotto try to take down Kenpachi.

episodes.name: MARCHING OUT THE ZOMBIES
episodes.overview: Ichigo tries to stop Yhwach upon learning that his real target lies within the Royal Palace.

episodes.name: MARCHING OUT THE ZOMBIES 2
episodes.overview: Ikkaku, Yumichika, and the Arrancars work together to fight off Giselle’s zombies.

episodes.name: TOO EARLY TO WIN TOO LATE TO KNOW
episodes.overview: Yhwach finally enters the Royal Palace.

episodes.name: THE MASTER
episodes.overview: Yhwach confronts Hyosube, who is protecting the real Royal Palace.

episodes.name: BLACK
episodes.overview: Yhwach performs Auswählen to bestow power to his fallen Royal Guards.

episodes.name: A
episodes.overview: The battle between Squad Zero and Yhwach's Royal Guards for the Soul King rages on.

episodes.name: KILL THE KING
episodes.overview: Ichigo and his friends hurry to the Reio Greater Palace to stop Yhwach.

episodes.name: THE DARK ARM
episodes.overview: Ichigo tries to remove the impaled sword from the Soul King and save his life.

episodes.name: THE BETRAYER
episodes.overview: Ukitake takes the place of the slain Soul King by releasing the power of Mimihagi.

episodes.name: AGAINST THE JUDGEMENT
episodes.overview: Yhwach is overflowing with power from having absorbed the Soul King.

episodes.name: THE HOLY NEWBORN
episodes.overview: The Soul Reapers regroup to prepare their counterattack against the Quincies.

episodes.name: GATE OF THE SUN
episodes.overview: Yhwach builds his new castle, Wahr Welt.

episodes.name: BABY, HOLD YOUR HAND
episodes.overview: Kenpachi and Mayuri's group advance through Vier Ast.

episodes.name: DON'T CHASE A SHADOW
episodes.overview: The change in Mayuri's Spiritual Pressure is also felt elsewhere by Urahara and Kyoraku.

episodes.name: BABY, HOLD YOUR HAND 2 [NEVER ENDING MY DREAM]
episodes.overview: Nemu ignores Mayuri's orders by intervening in his battle against Pernida.

episodes.name: SHADOWS GONE
episodes.overview: Lille undergoes further transformation to hunt down and pass judgment on Kyoraku.

episodes.name: FRIEND
episodes.overview: As the battle between the soul reapers and the quincies rages, Haschwalt finds himself confronted by Bazz-B inside Wahrwelt

episodes.name: THE VISIBLE ANSWER
episodes.overview: Kyoraku has paved the way for the soul reapers to reach the enemy's stronghold within Wahrwelt, but Gerard Valkyrie prevents them from advancing any further.

episodes.name: MY LAST WORDS
episodes.overview: Haschwalt suddenly attacks Uryu to pass judgement. The ensuing explosion and smoke draw Ichigo to the scene where he and Uryu are reunited.

episodes.name: GOD OF THUNDER
episodes.overview: Ichigo, Orihime and Chad head out to defeat Yhwach while Yoruichi clashes with Nakk Le Vaar.

episodes.name: SON OF DARKNESS
episodes.overview: The battle between Nakk Le Vaar, Yoruichi and Urahara rages and Ichigo and Orihime confront Yhwach.

episodes.name: BLOOD FOR MY BONE
episodes.overview: Ichigo and Orihime confront Yhwach in a battle that will shape the fate of the Three Worlds.

episodes.name: THE PERFECT CRIMSON
episodes.overview: Gerard's ability remains unbroken, while Ichigo endures Yhwach's fierce assault.

episodes.name: Episode 45
episodes.overview: Confronting Yhwach, Ichigo awakens the power of the Hollow deep within, becoming Demi-Hollowfied.

episodes.name: Episode 46
episodes.overview: The battle between Uryu and Haschwalth intensifies and nears its conclusion.

items.title: Colony
items.overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

items.title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
items.overview: A military cook, Kang Seong-jae, accepts a quest to become legendary. With quirky comrades—a foul-mouthed sergeant, a strict lieutenant, and a clueless senior cook—he brings chaos and heartwarming humor to the camp.
items.tagline: A kitchen knife instead of a rifle, an apron instead of a bullet belt.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Equipped with only an apron and a ladle, Kang Seong-jae becomes a legendary cook in the army.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Kang Seong-jae enlists in the army as a cook and receives mysterious game-like commands that appear only to him.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Facing reassignment, Seong-jae must complete a high-stakes cooking quest within 72 hours to secure his role as military cook.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Seong-jae must improvise a daring dish during a surprise inspection to save his military kitchen.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Seong-jae's culinary success lifts unit morale but triggers professional jealousy and tension after an unexpected encounter.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Stripped of his skills while on leave, Seong-jae works as a kitchen assistant to save his mother's business and discovers a secret ingredient.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Seong-jae rallies the troops with an improvised arancini, but encounters danger after overhearing Captain Lee's plot.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A quest challenges Seong-jae to turn his rival, Sergeant Kim Kwan-cheol, into an ally.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Seong-jae navigates rising tensions and a sudden offer to join the officer's mess.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Seong-jae enters the officer's mess and completes a crucial quest.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Seong-jae begins his final quest and participates in a cooking competition.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Seong-jae teams up with Sergeant Yoon and Sergeant Kim, as they go head-to-head with Lee Ho-young.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: As Seong-jae emerges as the contest winner, a brand new quest comes to light, challenging his skills once again.

items.title: High Potential
items.overview: Morgan is a single mom with an exceptional mind, whose unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: A single mom with an exceptional mind is recruited to the LAPD Major Crimes unit, where her unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

episodes.name: Dancers in the Dark
episodes.overview: As Morgan and the detectives adjust to her new role as a consultant, they investigate the attempted murder of a tap dancer and discover things are not quite as they seem. Meanwhile, Ava learns more about her father, and Morgan surprises her kids.

episodes.name: Dirty Rotten Scoundrel
episodes.overview: Morgan's intellect and cleaning experience prove useful when the detectives are called to a hotel room murder scene, eventually uncovering the victim's many cons. Morgan navigates Ava's dating while Soto reveals details about Roman's disappearance.

episodes.name: Survival Mode
episodes.overview: Morgan is excited to get her official LAPD badge despite Karadec's reluctance. The detectives work tirelessly on an emotional missing children case, which hits close to home for Morgan and sends her mind into overdrive.

episodes.name: Croaked
episodes.overview: The team investigates the death of an exotic animal veterinarian, uncovering a complicated love triangle in the process. Work interferes with Karadec's dating life, while Morgan follows a parental hunch about her teenage daughter and snoops on Ava.

episodes.name: Hangover
episodes.overview: A wild office party at a high-profile medical technology startup leads to the shocking murder of the founder and CEO, and Morgan and the team are on the case. Meanwhile, a new co-worker at the precinct catches Morgan's eye.

episodes.name: One of Us
episodes.overview: Morgan agrees to show Ava around the LAPD, but things quickly take a dangerous turn when the precinct is held hostage by the friends of a recently convicted man. Can Morgan and the detectives outsmart their captors and lead everyone to safety?

episodes.name: Obsessed
episodes.overview: The team investigates a mysterious young girl who was found attacked on a beach. Meanwhile, Morgan begins to let her guard down on her date with Tom, and Soto comes one step closer to finding out what happened to Roman.

episodes.name: The RAMs
episodes.overview: A famous baseball newscaster is murdered, and the team is on the case. Meanwhile, Soto and Morgan meet with a potential lead to discuss Roman's disappearance, and Tom has some personal news to share with Morgan.

episodes.name: Chutes and Murders
episodes.overview: A nanny is found bludgeoned to death in the park. Elsewhere, Morgan interferes when Elliot admits to not being invited to his classmate’s party.

episodes.name: The Sauna at the End of the Stairs
episodes.overview: Soto reopens an old murder case in the famous Donovan family, determined to uncover the true killer in classic “whodunit” style.

episodes.name: Partners
episodes.overview: The FBI joins the investigation into the murder of a controversial tech magnate, forcing Karadec to reunite with his former partner. Meanwhile, Ludo becomes overwhelmed with his increasing childcare duties.

episodes.name: Let's Play
episodes.overview: An anonymous tip to the LAPD sparks an unusual multiple-victim kidnapping investigation, forcing the team to rely on board games and puzzles to track down their suspect.

episodes.name: Pawns
episodes.overview: While working tirelessly to shield her family from the Game Maker's threats, another crime drags Morgan back into his game and the LAPD must decide whether to trust her instincts before the next move turns fatal.

episodes.name: Checkmate
episodes.overview: As the Major Crimes team desperately seek answers amidst a string of unresolved crimes, Morgan suspects the Game Maker is responsible. Meanwhile, Daphne and Oz set out to find Roman, and Elliot prepares a surprise act for his school’s talent show.

episodes.name: Eleven Minutes
episodes.overview: When a man with a troubled past is killed under mysterious circumstances, Morgan and the LAPD uncover a tragic motive behind his death. Meanwhile, Morgan opens up to Ava about her father, forcing Ava to confront truths she isn’t ready to face.

episodes.name: Behind the Music
episodes.overview: An investigation involving the murder of a local singer uncovers details that reopen a strikingly similar decades-old cold case. Later on, the team rallies around Soto after she is passed over for the captain’s chair.

episodes.name: Content Warning
episodes.overview: When a social media stunt turns deadly, Morgan and Karadec head to an influencer content house to track down answers. Meanwhile, the LAPD team adjusts to Captain Nick Wagner's new role, and Ava seeks out more information on Roman’s disappearance.

episodes.name: Chasing Ghosts
episodes.overview: It's almost Halloween, and a wealthy lawyer is found dead in his "haunted" Victorian mansion. As the team investigates the spooky case, Captain Wagner surprises everyone with his skills. At home, Elliot plays mediator between Morgan and Ava.

episodes.name: The One That Got Away (1)
episodes.overview: When a priceless painting is stolen in a museum heist, Morgan and Karadec team up with an art-recovery expert to unravel a tangled case and fierce ownership battle. Meanwhile, Soto is determined to uncover the secrets hidden inside Roman’s backpack.

episodes.name: The One That Got Away (2)
episodes.overview: Morgan’s suspicions of Rhys grow deeper as the case of the missing Rembrandt artwork continues. Elsewhere, Roman’s missing backpack causes problems for all involved.

episodes.name: Under the Rug
episodes.overview: As Morgan and Karadec investigate the mysterious death of a hitman in a car crash, they uncover details that force the LAPD and FBI to partner on the case. Meanwhile, Elliott tries to rekindle romance for his parents.

episodes.name: Grounded
episodes.overview: The team investigates the midair murder of an Air Force veteran, and Morgan works to crack the case despite being sidelined to mandatory detective training. Elsewhere, Wagner and Soto's leadership conflict comes to a head.

episodes.name: NPC
episodes.overview: When a former esports champion is mysteriously murdered, both his gaming rival and a sushi chef are under suspicion. Time spent with Elliot unexpectedly provides Morgan with insights on the case. Karadec reconnects with a woman from his past.

episodes.name: The Faust and the Furious
episodes.overview: Oz faces a deeply personal struggle when he discovers his late father’s headstone was never ordered. Elsewhere, the team investigates the murder of a tech founder obsessed with life extension.

episodes.name: In the Driver's Seat
episodes.overview: The team investigates a late-night luxury car heist turned deadly, uncovering a complex web of details and multiple perpetrators. Meanwhile, Morgan has mixed feelings when Ava begins focusing on her future.

episodes.name: If You Come for the Queen
episodes.overview: Daphne leads an investigation into the attempted murder of a beloved colleague and mentor, which is further complicated when it intertwines with another case. Later on, Ava comes to Daphne for advice and support.

episodes.name: Pie in the Sky
episodes.overview: When a renowned retired astronaut is murdered in plain sight, Morgan and the team uncover some of his mysterious entanglements. Soto travels to New York City to meet a high-profile political fixer connected to Roman’s disappearance.

episodes.name: Turn, Up the Heat
episodes.overview: Morgan relies on old friends to help with a case involving street artists, while Karadec leans on the women in his life during a time of need.

episodes.name: Second Sunday
episodes.overview: Wagner joins Morgan and the team on a hunt for the crew behind a series of heists ripping through elite private vaults - only to uncover a far more dangerous endgame: a looming cyberattack that could cripple Los Angeles' core infrastructure.

episodes.name: Family Tree
episodes.overview: A woman is found dead at the luxury hotel where Lucia works, posing a potential complication for Karadec and Morgan's investigation. Elsewhere, Ava races to come up with the perfect idea for her art show.

items.title: Prison Break
items.overview: Due to a political conspiracy, an innocent man is sent to death row and his only hope is his brother, who makes it his mission to deliberately get himself sent to the same prison in order to break the both of them out, from the inside out.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Lincoln Burrows is currently on death row and scheduled to die in a few months for an assassination his younger brother Michael is convinced he did not commit. With no other options and time winding down, Michael takes drastic measures to get himself incarcerated alongside his brother in Fox River State Penitentiary. Once he's inside, Michael, a structural engineer with the blueprints for the prison, begins to execute an elaborate plan to break Lincoln out and prove him innocent.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Michael Scofield, a structural engineer, attempts to rob a bank in order to get incarcerated at Fox River State Penitentiary, where his brother Lincoln Burrows, accused of murdering the Vice President's brother, is scheduled to be executed. At Fox River, Michael approaches a number of inmates, all of whom play an important role in his plan to free his brother from the inside. Meanwhile, agents Kellerman and Hale are determined to make sure the execution goes through as planned. Lincoln's son LJ gets into trouble.

episodes.name: Allen
episodes.overview: Michael seeks help of his fellow prison inhabitants to execute his escape plans.

episodes.name: Cell Test
episodes.overview: When Michael reveals his escape plan to Sucre, Sucre chooses to be no part of it, and requests a cell transfer. Michael gets a new cellmate called Haywire.

episodes.name: Cute Poison
episodes.overview: Veronica keeps uncovering new information regarding Lincoln's case and decides she wants to work on the case full-time.  When no one wants to help her on the case, Nick Savrinn (an attorney) offers his assistance and the two of them visit Lincoln.

episodes.name: English, Fitz or Percy
episodes.overview: Kellerman and Hale blackmail Warden Pope. Michael finds out he might get out earlier than anticipated. Veronica becomes uncertain of her allies.

episodes.name: Riots, Drills and the Devil (1)
episodes.overview: Michael creates a lockdown by sabotaging the air conditioning in order to execute his breakout plan properly, and unintentionally causes a riot that gets Sara into huge trouble. Meanwhile, an ex-con is blackmailed into seeing to that Lincoln is killed.

episodes.name: Riots, Drills and the Devil (2)
episodes.overview: While the riot intensifies, Abruzzi and Sucre join forces. Michael must decide whether or not to save the life of Dr. Tancredi.

episodes.name: The Old Head
episodes.overview: Michael finds out a storeroom fundamental to his escape plans has been converted into a break room. Veronica and Nick are being threatened.

episodes.name: Tweener
episodes.overview: Abruzzi's demotion in the prison hierachy puts the entire escape plan at risk. Michael finds himself in the uneviable position of trying to protect T-Bag's new "fish" and facing the threat of T-Bag exposing the plan to the guards. The inmates dig themselves into a hole.

episodes.name: Sleight of Hand
episodes.overview: Michael is forced to give up Fibonacci's location to Philly Falzone, and Kellerman and Hale get a little unwanted help to track down LJ who has gone missing. Veronica and Nick uncover evidence against the man Lincoln was convicted of murdering.

episodes.name: And Then There Were 7
episodes.overview: The escapees and Dr. Tancredi are shocked when they learn the identity of Michael's visitor, who brings with her a very important piece of the escape plan.

episodes.name: Odd Man Out
episodes.overview: Michael sees proof his plan is working, so he begins to overcome the last obstacle. As the escape draws near, the group tries to reduce its number by one and targets T-Bag.

episodes.name: End of the Tunnel
episodes.overview: With Lincoln's execution scheduled for the following day, Veronica comes out of hiding to contact him and gains an ally. Kellerman makes the ultimate sacrifice to preserve the conspiracy. Michael looks for a way to get Lincoln out of solitary confinement in time for the escape that evening. The inmates risk everything as they attempt their escape.

episodes.name: The Rat
episodes.overview: Veronica and Nick request a judge to postpone Lincoln's execution. A C.O. becomes suspicious about a broken door.

episodes.name: By the Skin and the Teeth
episodes.overview:
As Lincoln is about to be executed, he briefly sees his father in the viewing room. A phone call from judge Kessler delays the execution. After reviewing the newly surfaced evidence, the judge orders the exhumation of Steadman's body.

Michael creates a new, more dangerous, break-out plan, involving going through the prison yard. An accident puts Michael's new plan in danger.

episodes.name: Brother's Keeper
episodes.overview: Flashbacks shed light on the past actions that led to the incarceration of Lincoln, Sucre, T-Bag and C-Note. Basis of Michael's ingenious break-out plan are revealed. Dr. Tancredi memorizes how she ended up in Fox River State Penitentiary.

episodes.name: J-Cat
episodes.overview: Lincoln is worried about Michael's sanity while Michael has trouble remembering some parts of the prison schematics. Sucre has to conceal the hole in the guard's break room. Warden Pope transfers Michael to solitary after he declines his request.

episodes.name: Bluff
episodes.overview: In an effort to recreate the missing piece of the tattoo, Michael gets transferred to the psych ward, seeking the help of Haywire. T-Bag and C-Note have to join forces.

episodes.name: The Key
episodes.overview: Michael must get the key to the infirmary and enlist the help of an old face, while Lincoln learns the identity of his kidnapper and another inmate learns of the escape.

episodes.name: Tonight
episodes.overview: Westmoreland wants Michael to speed up the planned escape, and gets Bellick one step closer to unraveling it. Michael has to decide whether to involve Sara in the breakout plan. Tweener's devotion is put to a test. Veronica finds out that her ally unexpectedly has a connection to an inmate serving time at Fox River.

episodes.name: Go
episodes.overview: Everyone's ready to make their escapes across the high wire. Veronica and Nick realize they may be in over their heads. And Agent Kellerman helps Vice President Reynolds calm down before her debate.

episodes.name: Flight
episodes.overview: As the escape is in progress, Warden Pope and Captain Bellick begin a search to detain the escapees. Michael and co. have to reach the aircraft fast as the police is hot on their heels. Veronica discovers a major piece of evidence that could prove Lincoln's innocence. The Vice President is worried about losing her authority.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, Michael, Lincoln and six other inmates, including pickpocket Tweener and the mentally unstable Haywire, have ultimately escaped from Fox River. Once outside the prison walls, however, the escape truly begins as the convicts race for their lives while trying to avoid capture by the authorities. The pursuers are led by FBI agent Alexander Mahone, who is haunted by his own demons; vengeful prison guard Captain Brad Bellick, who, driven by his own personal vendetta, will also stop at nothing until the escapees are captured or killed; and Secret Service Agent Paul Kellerman, who, under President Reynolds' orders, will do anything to keep the truth about the conspiracy very much a secret.

episodes.name: Manhunt
episodes.overview: As eight hours has passed since the escape, Michael, Lincoln, Sucre, C-Note and Abruzzi attempt to evade their seekers. Bellick is forced to relinquish the command of the search party to FBI Special Agent Alexander Mahone whose ingenious approach makes Michael's life as a fugitive harder. As a result from her overdose, Dr. Tancredi is in critical condition. A short-handed T-Bag faces the ultimate challenge.

episodes.name: Otis
episodes.overview: Mahone tries to lure the escapees by targeting an imprisoned LJ. Michael and Lincoln come up with a plan to free LJ from jail. Sucre, Abruzzi and C-Note have a plan of their own, but only to break free of their pursuers.Meanwhile, Bellick and Warden Pope feel the heat following their unsuccessful attempts to capture the escapees.Tweener infiltrates a bunch of college students on their way to spring break.

episodes.name: Scan
episodes.overview: Michael and a wounded Lincoln try to outmaneuver Mahone, who is hot on their trail. Sara gets a surprise visit to her bedside.Following his suspension, Bellick recruits a resolute partner to aid in his quest to get the escapees behind the bars.Sucre and C-Note head out for their family reunions-regardless of being observed by the authorities.

episodes.name: First Down
episodes.overview: Bellick, now teamed up with Michael, Lincoln and Nika, sets out to find the money stolen by Westmoreland during the 1971 skyjacking. Kellerman targets Sara, who receives a long-awaited phone call. T-Bag gets a ride from an unsuspecting family. Abruzzi resumes the search for Fibonacci to settle the scores once and for all.

episodes.name: Map 1213
episodes.overview: Michael and Lincoln are eager to locate the Double K ranch where Westmoreland hid his millions. Sucre goes to Las Vegas to prevent Maricruz from marrying his cousin Hector. C-Note gets on a train. Mahone is given an important package.

episodes.name: Subdivision
episodes.overview: Mahone takes an interest in the story of DB Cooper.In their quest to find Westmoreland's treasure, Michael and Lincoln travel house-to-house in Utah. Haywire's journey outside the prison walls continues. Sucre bumps into an acquaintance.

episodes.name: Buried
episodes.overview: Michael, Sucre, T-Bag and C-Note claim the hidden treasure.An anxious Lincoln risks everything to get to LJ. LJ grows wary about the easy getaway. Kellerman rethinks where his loyalties lie after Sara gets to The Company's hit list. Mahone results to deadly force to get the truth out of Tweener.

episodes.name: Dead Fall
episodes.overview: In his efforts to try to get hold of all of the money Sucre runs into some unexpected difficulties. And Captain Bellick and his partner have not given up on finding their old inmates.

episodes.name: Unearthed
episodes.overview: In an effort to learn more about his pursuer Michael cozies up to Mahone's wife. L.J. and Lincoln have a bumpy road-trip. T-Bag receives a surprise, and C-Note's wife must choose between her daughter and husband.

episodes.name: Rendezvous
episodes.overview: As Michael reunites with Sara, Mahone and Kellerman strive to make sure they stay apart.On the road with LJ, Lincoln meets his father. Sucre tries to contact Maricruz. T-Bag has a reunion of his own.

episodes.name: Bolshoi Booze
episodes.overview: As Lincoln tries to reunite with Michael, he has to say goodbye to another loved one. Michael attempts to obtain a getaway plane. T-Bag gets revenge. Sara and Kellerman face-off.

episodes.name: Disconnect
episodes.overview: With Mahone on their trail, Michael, Lincoln, their father, and Sucre make a run for the getaway plane. Michael's reunion with his father sheds light on his difficult childhood.The women in Bellick and Kellerman's lives coerce their men to confess their sins.A medical emergency forces C-Note to risk it all.

episodes.name: The Killing Box
episodes.overview: Bellick is anything but happy about his sudden homecoming-to Fox River.Elsewhere, Michael and Lincoln might face a homecoming of their own. Mahone and Kellerman use everything they got to make certain that Michael and Lincoln do not get through their road trip alive.Sucre's getaway plane encounters some difficulties. T-Bag closes on Mrs. Hollander.

episodes.name: John Doe
episodes.overview: Bellick gets a taste of the medicine he gave out when he was the Captain and Agent Mahone's ex-wife makes another appearance.

episodes.name: The Message
episodes.overview: In Mexico, Sucre gets a car but gets in trouble by the police. Bellick has more trouble as the new inmate as prisoners who suffered with him want revenge.

episodes.name: Chicago
episodes.overview: C-Note gets into a tricky situation when a robber holds up the diner he is in and demands everyone go into the storage room until the police arrive. Michael, Lincoln and Kellerman get closer to revealing the conspiracy with the help of Sara. Mahone finds a new ally in Bellick.

episodes.name: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: Michael and Sara request Henry Pope's help to retrieve the information that will topple The Company.Mahone pins down an escapee. Sucre discovers a new threat while hitchhiking to reunite with Maricruz. T-Bag brings the Hollander family to his home.

episodes.name: Wash
episodes.overview: T-Bag digs deep and finds his 'nice-side' with the help of a psychiatrist. Michael, Lincoln, and Sara get their hands on evidence needed to bring down The Company, while Kellerman is close to finding the President.

episodes.name: Sweet Caroline
episodes.overview: An unlikely alliance forms between Bellick and Sucre while Michael is determined to face the president. T-Bag gets into some trouble when he loses his luggage and C-Note faces major consequences after some of his actions.

episodes.name: Panama
episodes.overview: Sara sacrifices herself for the safety of Michael so the brothers can get on with their final plan to attain freedom, but their plan gets 'shipwrecked'. Meanwhile, Bellick blackmails Sucre to partner up as T-Bag's streak of murder continues to the south of the border.

episodes.name: Fin Del Camino
episodes.overview: The day has finally come for Sara's trial while critical information that will exonerate her is being debunked. Meanwhile, Michael is determined to get his hands on the 5 million and to stop T-Bag's reign of terror. Bellick is also money hungry and will do whatever it takes to hunt down T-Bag. Kellerman decides his fate while Lincoln and Mahone square off.

episodes.name: Sona
episodes.overview: Michael tries to save his brother and himself from the unstoppable Mahone. Kellerman's testimony at Sara's trial proves different from what was expected, could this be the end for Sara? Sucre puts everything on the line to save his Maricruz. Just like old times, T-Bag and Bellick are at it again but this time there will be a winner.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Just when they thought they were out, they are pulled back in — for the most dangerous escape ever. Season three finds Michael Scofield wrongly incarcerated in Sona, a hellish Panamanian prison where there are no rules, no guards, and no escape.

episodes.name: Orientación
episodes.overview: Now locked up in a Panamanian prison known as Sona, Michael, T-Bag, Bellick, and Mahone try to find a way out. Much to their devastation, they soon find out that the prison has been abandoned by the authorities because of the immense threat from the vile inmates. Michael seeks for an inmate named Whistler in the prison sewers. As Lincoln is puzzled by Sara's sudden disappearance, he learns that LJ has gotten into some trouble. He also tries to recover the 5 million dollars.

episodes.name: Fire/Water
episodes.overview: Michael and Mahone try to lure Whistler out of his hiding place. T-Bag gains some upward momentum in the prison hierarchy as the water supply is running low. Lincoln meets familiar and not so familiar faces on his quest to free Michael.

episodes.name: Call Waiting
episodes.overview: Whistler tells the truth to Michael. Michael tries to get in touch with Sara but the only phone is in Lechero's quarters, so he has to rely on T-Bag's help. Mahone battles his addiction. Bellick steps on some toes.

episodes.name: Good Fences
episodes.overview: After taking delivery of a package from The Company, Lincoln realizes that they are deadly serious. Michael's new break out plan relies on electricity. Haywire is back from the dead, haunting disoriented Mahone. Bellick and T-Bag get special attention from Lechero.

episodes.name: Interference
episodes.overview: A new inmate named Tyge is brought to Sona. After he seemingly recognizes Whistler, Michael's doubts arise. T-Bag enters a new area of commerce.Lincoln goes to the seaside with Sofia. Sucre takes over the side-business of his predecessor.

episodes.name: Photo Finish
episodes.overview: Michael threatens to cancel the escape plan unless he sees a proof that Sara is still alive. Whistler is accused of murdering an inmate and it is up to Michael to prove his innocence and save his life. Lincoln and Sofia help in monitoring the morning guards. Mahone may have another way to get out of Sona.

episodes.name: Vamonos
episodes.overview:
Everything goes wrong for Michael as he tries to create a diversion.

Lincoln tries to outsmart Susan who has his son. Sucre offers his assistance to Lincoln.

episodes.name: Bang and Burn
episodes.overview: Susan jeopardizes Michael's life as she puts her own escape plan into motion. Whistler's past catches up to his girlfriend.The Company goes after Lincoln and Sucre. Justice prevails for Mahone. And Lechero sheds light into an empty tunnel.

episodes.name: Boxed In
episodes.overview: The Panamanian Army arranges Michael to get a taste of solitary. T-Bag reserves a spot in the escape. Bellick's life turns into an uphill battle. Susan traps Sucre.

episodes.name: Dirt Nap
episodes.overview: Lechero's demotion devastates Michael's breakout plan as Sammy takes reigns at Sona. T-Bag forces Bellick to fight in a fight where the odds are stacked heavily against him. Lincoln and Sucre have some surprise fireworks set for Susan.

episodes.name: Under and Out
episodes.overview: Michael's escape may be in jeopardy because of heavy rain. T-Bag and Lechero join forces, while Bellick hopes to do the same with Mahone.

episodes.name: Hell or High Water
episodes.overview: Michael, Whistler, and Mahone make their break from Sona. But Mahone seems like the odd man out along the way.

episodes.name: The Art of the Deal
episodes.overview: Michael and Lincoln are left with no choice but to hand Whistler over in exchange to save LJ and Sofia. A familiar face enters Sona while another inmate leaves.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: After engineering a daring escape from the hellish, Panamanian prison Sona, brothers Michael Scofield and Lincoln Burrows are determined to seek justice against The Company, the shadowy group responsible for destroying their lives and killing the woman Michael loves, Dr. Sara Tancredi. Michael’s quest for vengeance leads him to Los Angeles, where his world is turned upside down when Company operative Gretchen/Susan B. Anthony informs him that Sara is still alive. Realizing the only way they will truly be free, Michael and Lincoln avow to find Sara and take down The Company. With the help of Homeland Security agent Don Self, they assemble a group of allies and familiar faces to accomplish their task: Mahone, Sucre, Bellick and computer expert Roland Glenn. Unfortunately for the brothers, they must also evade company assassin Wyatt and find an on-the-loose T-Bag. Michael and Lincoln soon discover the only thing harder than breaking out will be breaking in.

episodes.name: Scylla
episodes.overview: Michael has trailed Gretchen/Susan, Whistler and Mahone to L.A. Chaos reigns in SONA while T-Bag, Bellick and Sucre go missing. Lincoln and L.J. continue to stay with Sofia.

episodes.name: Breaking & Entering
episodes.overview: The gang has to break into the well-guarded home of company man Stuart Tuxhorn. Elsewhere, T-Bag must go to extremes to survive.

episodes.name: Shut Down
episodes.overview: Michael attempts to track the cardholder and avoid going back to prison. Wyatt finds new information regarding Sara's whereabouts. Elsewhere, T-Bag uses a new identity to make a new life for himself.

episodes.name: Eagles and Angels
episodes.overview: Michael, Lincoln and Sucre must crash a police benefit to obtain the next card key. Reeling from another death, Sara falls back into an old habit. T-Bag arouses suspicion and runs into some old “friends” his first day on the job.

episodes.name: Safe and Sound
episodes.overview: Self locates another card hidden in a safe within a secure federal building, as Mahone continues his quest for revenge. Meanwhile, T-Bag's new life may be in jeopardy.

episodes.name: Blow Out
episodes.overview: The entire operation may be in jeopardy when Mahone gets into trouble with the law. Gretchen's sister receives a surprise visitor. The Company may be onto Self. T-Bag continues to raise suspicions at Gate.

episodes.name: Five the Hard Way
episodes.overview: Lincoln takes members of the team to Las Vegas where Sucre gets an indecent proposal. Sara learns about Michael’s condition, and Roland pushes his luck too far. Gretchen teams up with T-Bag who makes an offer to Michael he cannot refuse. Meanwhile, the secrets in Whistler’s bird book are finally revealed.

episodes.name: The Price
episodes.overview: Lincoln works to retrieve the final card, which is being held by the General. Michael and Self are forced to work with Gretchen. Meanwhile, Roland continues to be berated for losing the transcribing device in Las Vegas.

episodes.name: Greatness Achieved
episodes.overview: Wyatt gets a taste of his own medicine, and Mahone finds some resolution. T-Bag scrambles when the police investigate his missing co-worker while Gretchen gets cozy with a Company man. Meanwhile, Michael’s condition continues to worsen, and a team member makes the ultimate sacrifice while planning the underground break-in for Scylla.

episodes.name: The Legend
episodes.overview: Sara is left with no choice but to take Michael to the hospital as his condtion rapidly worsens. Sucre and Lincoln are faced with unknown territory as they are left in charge of the operation. Elsewhere, agent Self makes a surprising ally.

episodes.name: Quiet Riot
episodes.overview: Michael races against time and his ailing health to break into the Company headquarters to steal Scylla, but the break-in’s success lies with Sucre. Gretchen dresses up for a meeting with the General and one final attempt to get the last card key. T-Bag must make a decision to leave his criminal ways for good.

episodes.name: Selfless
episodes.overview: Sara takes a hostage in a bid to secure Scylla. In the meantime, Michael and Lincoln finally meet the General while one of their members switches allegiance.

episodes.name: Deal Or No Deal
episodes.overview: It's up to Michael to hold the gang together after they find out they were betrayed by one of their own. Meanwhile, Gretchen is blackmailed by T-Bag's new partner.

episodes.name: Just Business
episodes.overview: Michael, whose condition is deteriorating, winds up in the hands of The Company who promise Lincoln that they can save Michael's life in exchange for a favor. Elsewhere, Gretchen and Self wind up with Scylla and a buyer.

episodes.name: Going Under
episodes.overview: Michael gets medical attention from the most unlikely of places, and Charles Westmoreland returns to help uncover the true meaning of Scylla. Meanwhile, Lincoln and Sucre race to stop Gretchen before Scylla is lost forever.

episodes.name: The Sunshine State
episodes.overview: Lincoln and his new partners arrive in Miami to recover Scylla from its shocking new owner, and Sara searches for a missing Michael who learns some surprising information about his past. Meanwhile, a double-crossing leads to a death and an arrest in "The Sunshine State."

episodes.name: The Mother Lode
episodes.overview: Michael and Sara journey to Miami while Lincoln meets with his mother. T-Bag and Self's mission to locate Scylla takes a dramatic turn. The General comes under pressure.

episodes.name: VS.
episodes.overview: Michael and Lincoln come to blows over Scylla as Christina sets the wheels in motion for her plan. Meanwhile, Sara receives life-changing news. T-Bag arrives at the Indian Embassy. The General becomes increasingly paranoid.

episodes.name: S.O.B.
episodes.overview: Michael's reunion with Christina is soured when she drops a bombshell regarding Lincoln, and T-Bag grows determined to prove he is worthy of being a member of the Company.

episodes.name: Cowboys and Indians
episodes.overview: Pandemonium erupts at the hotel following the assassination, and Christina puts the final pieces of her plan together. Meanwhile, the General makes good on his threat, and Michael is forced to choose between saving either Lincoln or Sara.

episodes.name: Rate of Exchange
episodes.overview: Familiar faces return to help Michael end his quest to bring down The Company once and for all.

episodes.name: Killing Your Number
episodes.overview: Michael tries to bring down the Company once and for all.

seasons.name: Resurrection
seasons.overview: Seven years later, thanks to an information provided by T-Bag, Lincoln and Sara discover that Michael is still alive in a Yemen prison, so they develop a plan to get him out.

episodes.name: Ogygia
episodes.overview: It's been seven years since Michael was presumed dead, but when clues suggest that he might still be alive, Lincoln reunites with Sara to help track down the truth.

episodes.name: Kaniel Outis
episodes.overview: As Lincoln and C-Note search for the "Sheik of Light," Michael and his cellmate, Whip, attempt an escape from Ogygia. Meanwhile, Sara's investigation into Michael's reappearance leads her to the state department and an uneasy reunion with Paul Kellerman.

episodes.name: The Liar
episodes.overview: When T-Bag ambushes Sara, he warns her that two of Poseidon's henchmen, Van Gogh and A&W, may be following her. Meanwhile, Lincoln attempts to retrieve his confiscated passport to escape Yemen, and Michael plans his next move.

episodes.name: The Prisoner's Dilemma
episodes.overview: Michael, Whip and Ja make their last attempt to break from Ogygia, but must make a deal with the devil to do so. Lincoln races against the clock to help with the escape, as T-Bag meets with Kellerman to gather more info on Michael's resurrection.

episodes.name: Contingency
episodes.overview: Lincoln becomes frustrated as he tries to understand what really happened to Michael. C-Note has a new escape plan, but fears it will not be executed quickly enough, as Cyclops is trailing closely behind. Meanwhile, Sara struggles with the idea that Michael may be alive.

episodes.name: Phaecia
episodes.overview: As Michael, Lincoln and the remaining Ogygia gang try to escape Yemen, they find themselves racing though the desert from a vengeful Cyclops. Meanwhile, A&W and Van Gogh question their roles as their pursuit of the escapees leads them to...Graceland.

episodes.name: Wine Dark Sea
episodes.overview: Sara becomes fearful of her family's safety when she discovers the real reason that Michael faked his own death. In the meantime, Michael and Lincoln continue to try find a way home with the help of Sucre, and the real identity of Poseidon is revealed.

episodes.name: Progeny
episodes.overview: When Sara and her son's safety is threatened, Michael and Lincoln recruit the help of Sheba and C-Note to try and catch Poseidon. Meanwhile, Whip goes on a separate mission and T-Bag reveals a secret.

episodes.name: Behind the Eyes
episodes.overview: Dangerous threats keep Michael and Lincoln fighting to protect Sara and Mike. Meanwhile, Poseidon continues to try and outsmart Michael and the rest of the gang, which leads them to the ultimate showdown, and not everyone makes it out alive.

items.title: Stranger Things
items.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Strange things are afoot in Hawkins, Indiana, where a young boy's sudden disappearance unearths a young girl with otherworldly powers.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Body
episodes.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
episodes.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
episodes.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
episodes.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 2
seasons.overview: It's been nearly a year since Will's strange disappearance. But life's hardly back to normal in Hawkins. Not even close.

episodes.name: Chapter One: MADMAX
episodes.overview: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
episodes.overview: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
episodes.overview: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
episodes.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. “Bob the Brain” tackles a difficult problem.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Spy
episodes.overview: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
episodes.overview: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
episodes.overview: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Gate
episodes.overview: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 3
seasons.overview: Budding romance. A brand-new mall. And rabid rats running toward danger. It's the summer of 1985 in Hawkins ... and one summer can change everything.

episodes.name: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.overview: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
episodes.overview: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
episodes.overview: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flayed
episodes.overview: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
episodes.overview: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bite
episodes.overview: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
episodes.overview: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 4
seasons.overview: Darkness returns to Hawkins just in time for spring break, igniting fresh terror, disturbing memories — and an ominous new threat.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
episodes.overview: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
episodes.overview: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
episodes.overview: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Dear Billy
episodes.overview: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Nina Project
episodes.overview: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Dive
episodes.overview: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
episodes.overview: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: Papa
episodes.overview: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
episodes.overview: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 5
seasons.overview: The fall of 1987. Hawkins is scarred by rifts. Vecna has vanished and the government has placed the town under military quarantine, forcing Eleven back into hiding. To end this nightmare, they'll need everyone together, one last time.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Crawl
episodes.overview: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of...
episodes.overview: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
episodes.overview: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Sorcerer
episodes.overview: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Shock Jock
episodes.overview: The gang hatches an electrifying plan to reconnect Will to the hive mind. Tensions flare during a search of the Upside Down's Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz
episodes.overview: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bridge
episodes.overview: On the anniversary of Will's disappearance, the party reunites to prepare for a battle with world-altering implications.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
episodes.overview: As Vecna prepares to destroy the world as we know it, the party must put everything on the line to defeat him once and for all.

items.title: Avengers: Infinity War
items.overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.

items.title: Perfect Crown
items.overview: In a 21st-century constitutional monarchy, a woman who has everything but remains a commoner crosses paths with a prince who, despite his royal lineage, feels powerless—leading to a love that defies social status.
items.tagline: She wasn’t born to rule… she was built for it.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Seong Hee-joo is the competent CEO and second daughter of a chaebol family, yet she is constantly looked down upon simply for being a commoner. At the King’s birthday banquet, she has a chance encounter with Grand Prince Lee Wan. Just as her family begins pressuring her to marry, she finds herself in a bind with no suitable suitors in sight. At this rate, why not just marry into the royal family?

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Everyone is determined to play matchmaker. Queen Mother plots to secure Yi An a bride. He must decide whether to partake in Hui-ju’s scheme.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A secret rendezvous scandal rocks the royal family, and Grand Prince  I-an makes a public statement.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: When Huiju moves into Grand Prince I-an's residence and proves to be a handful, a conspiracy awaits…

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: As Huiju digs for the truth, Grand Prince I-AN distances himself thinking it is safer to stay away.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The celebrated pair makes a dazzling return at the banquet, waltzing and professing their fake love.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: With the wedding looming, everyone begins to realize a strange turn in the couple's relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The 21st-century Grand Prince's wife arrives. Amid cheers and wary eyes, two men make a bold choice.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Facing a political crisis, the couple choose to fight to protect one another, each in their own way.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Others step in for the couple who struggle to be honest, and a new era begins to stir at the court.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Like that day, fire engulfs Council Hall. Huiju protects Grand Prince I-AN while fighting an enemy.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: No barrier is unbreakable, only those who wish it so. Can they leap beyond and shape their destiny?

items.title: The Runner
items.overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.
items.tagline: One hour. One chance to save her son.

items.title: The Grand Tour
items.overview: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show returns with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.

episodes.name: The Next Generation
episodes.overview: Thomas, James and Francis receive an official blessing from Jeremy Clarkson, then head off on their first-ever adventure. During the road trip across southern California, they compare three of the greatest performance cars America has ever created: the Ford Mustang GTD, Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 and Hennessey Venom F5 Revolution Evolution. By racing against fighter jets, obviously.

episodes.name: Sweat, Sports Cars and Singapore
episodes.overview: Thomas, Francis and James journey from futuristic Singapore to the Malaysian highlands to investigate an important consumer question: for less than £5,000, is it possible to buy a sports car that's exciting to drive but also won't break down the whole time?

episodes.name: It's OK to Be Kei
episodes.overview: Following a pub chat with James May, the team head stateside to convince Americans of the brilliance of tiny Japanese Kei cars. And what better way for Thomas, James and Francis to win hearts and minds... than by sneaking off-road around Colorado before tackling the USA's most terrifying hillclimb: the 4,300-metre monster that is Pikes Peak?

episodes.name: Last Car Standing
episodes.overview: The hosts are on a mission to find out the strongest car ever made. After a series of very destructive tests they enlist the help of Richard Hammond to help them crown the winner. Elsewhere, Thomas and Francis test out a classic Alfa Romeo and Subaru that have been 'restomodded' at enormous expense.

episodes.name: A Relaxing Spa Weekend
episodes.overview: It's hypercar versus train as Thomas, James, and Francis race a Pagani Utopia against public transport from Britain to the Belgian Grand Prix, with an urgent delivery for Williams F1 driver Alex Albon. Elsewhere, James uncovers the incredible story of the BMW Isetta and its Cold War heroics.

episodes.name: Angola: Survive to Drive
episodes.overview: Thomas, James and Francis head to Angola in a trio of deeply inappropriate track cars, in a bid to discover whether this corner of southern Africa is truly a hidden hotbed of back-to-basics motorsport. Will they discover racing in the wild desert? Or just a whole lot of sand and getting stuck?

items.title: THE ONE SHOT
items.overview: Eight of Japan's top comedians selected by Daigo, including M-1 finalists and King of Conte champions, must each write and direct a short film with just one rule: include a single, hilarious gag. In this unprecedented competition, skilled comedians have just "one shot" to prove their true talent.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Jiro's medical drama vs. Akiyama's school drama. Two wildly unpredictable One Shots!

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Goto's bizarre medical drama vs. Yamauchi's ghastly school drama. Chaos takes over the studio!

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Horiuchi's cop drama vs. Tenjiku Kawahara's family drama. The first One Shot that leads to tears!

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Matayoshi's cop drama vs. Kunizaki's family drama. Their captivating films leave everyone in shock!

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Time to announce the Nomination Stage results! Comedians who failed to advance get a second chance.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The wild card round continues! Who will claim the last ticket to the finale?

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: On to the Final Stage! The tenacious wild card winner joins, and five films battle for the crown.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The comedians' war for laughs comes to an end! Who will be crowned the first-ever ONE SHOT Champion?

items.title: Murder Club: Liar's Table
items.overview: A competitive mystery-variety series fusing deduction, role-play, and entertainment. Each episode drops the cast into a murder case as characters who gather clues, hold secret talks, and complete the story themselves—from the opening crime through character intros, clue rounds, interviews, a final vote, and the ending.

episodes.name: The Saints Baseball Team Murder Case 1
episodes.overview: The cleanup hitter is found dead in the locker room. Find the real culprit among the five suspects.

episodes.name: The Saints Baseball Team Murder Case 2
episodes.overview: As evidence mounts and alibis crumble, the list of suspects narrows. Who's the real culprit?

episodes.name: Gwandong Byeolgok: The Exile Murder Case 1
episodes.overview: A blood-soaked corpose is found in a place of exile. Five suspects hide secrets behind closed walls.

episodes.name: Gwandong Byeolgok: The Exile Murder Case 2
episodes.overview: Conflicting testimonies reveal hidden ties and buried truths. Who is the real culprit?

episodes.name: The Labyrinth Prison Murder Case 1
episodes.overview: A body is found in the prison's control tower. Break alibis, find the culprit, and escape alive.

episodes.name: The Labyrinth Prison Murder Case 2
episodes.overview: Conflicting statements and paths deepen the mystery. Who is the true culprit?

items.title: Mayday
items.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.
items.tagline: A friendship with major red flags.

items.title: Dark Hollow
items.overview: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

items.title: The Girl in the River
items.overview: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.
items.tagline: Every lie floats to the surface.

items.title: Splash City
items.overview: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

items.title: Come with Me
items.overview: Working-class Simon Ward's life unravels after a traumatic home invasion, mounting problems at work and the loss of his best friend. Falling under the influence of rhetoric-spewing radio host Dalton Kirby, Simon spirals into a violent attempt to correct the injustice he believes surrounds him.

items.title: Gandhari
items.overview: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

items.title: The Brink of War
items.overview: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.
items.tagline: Not all battles are fought with bullets.

items.title: Lovesick
items.overview: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

episodes.name: Two Weddings
episodes.overview: Mexico, 1910. As the country edges toward rebellion, Emilia reconnects with her childhood friend Daniel and meets Dr. Zavalza, a new arrival in Puebla.

episodes.name: Farewells
episodes.overview: With political tensions rising, Daniel makes a fateful decision that tests Emilia's dreams of a future in medicine. What will loving him cost her?

episodes.name: The War
episodes.overview: While Mexico roils and pushes toward change, Emilia confronts the limits of first love and finds hope for a better future with Dr. Zavalza.

episodes.name: Honeymoon
episodes.overview: Emilia follows Daniel into the revolution and discovers the pleasures of a life filled with passion, purpose and sacrifice for the sake of others.

episodes.name: The Passing
episodes.overview: Emilia is building a new life in Chicago when a shocking revelation sends her searching for Daniel. But can they begin again in spite of everything?

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: After their paths converge again, Emilia and Daniel share a vision of the future. But both worry that instability may pull them apart once more.

episodes.name: Doctor Sauri
episodes.overview: Mexico embraces its new era while Emilia pursues her medical aspirations and faces difficult choices that will shape her future — and the country's.

items.title: GBRB: Farm Operation - Go Go Farm
items.overview: The GBRB crew returns for a new challenge as Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo swap city life for the ranch. Spending several days alongside experienced ranchers, the trio learns the essentials of raising dairy cows and horses while experiencing the hard work and philosophy behind livestock farming. From feeding animals to tackling demanding daily tasks, the three celebrities approach every mission with determination, humor, and plenty of mishaps. Their playful chemistry and growing bond with the animals create both hilarious and heartwarming moments. Blending comedy, friendship, and the charm of rural life, the show offers a refreshing look at ranch life and the unexpected rewards of working together in nature.

episodes.name: KKPP Food is Back
episodes.overview: After mastering crop farming, cafeteria management, and overseas expeditions, KKPP Food heads to a dairy ranch in Jeju for its first technical training. Welcomed by lush fields and newborn calves, the team quickly discovers ranch life is anything but easy. From overwhelming encounters with cow manure to unexpected accidents, Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo face a messy and hilarious initiation. Can they survive their toughest training yet?

episodes.name: The Visit Of New KKPP’s New Intern
episodes.overview: The second day in the Jeju farm begins, and they start to work from early in the morning. They still have a lot to learn, but they have somehow become skilled at farm work, so they even offer ideas for more efficient work to their seniors. Meanwhile, KKPP’s new intern, dispatched from the head office, comes to join as a new member and starts working with them. But this intern seems too shy to be close to.

episodes.name: The Winner Of Their Yutnori Bet
episodes.overview: Their yutnori with the ranch team for overtime exemption is not over, and they start the second round of it. Which team will win the bet? Meanwhile, their second day doesn’t seem to be over because they have to go on a night patrol of the ranch and play the game for their shower order. And the morning of the third day comes, and they do the same task as the second day, but they feel quite used to it, reducing their working time.

episodes.name: The Party Before Saying Goodbye
episodes.overview: As it’s the last day on the dairy farm, the KKPP trainees prepare the farewell party under the leadership of the intern, Sang Hoon. Sang Hoon introduces himself as a skillful chef, but he loses his confidence as he starts cooking because of his poor leadership and relies on Kyung Soo’s opinion. After resolving the obstacles, they succeed in preparing for the party and make the day memorable with their seniors. However, another mission is waiting for them.

episodes.name: Suspicious Visitor
episodes.overview: Love doesn't always go according to plan as Kyung Soo and Morris enjoy a calm bonding session, while Kwang Soo and John Snow charge headfirst into chaos during their horseback training. On the second day, a suspicious visitor sneaks into the ranch to pick bracken despite repeated warnings from the owner, leaving the trainees stunned.

items.title: Idiot Girls and School Ghost: School Anniversary
items.overview: The high school senior girls discovered a 'Ghost Hide and Seek' tape recorded by their seniors in the broadcasting club. Through the tape, the girls learned about a rumor that if they win in the ghost hide and seek game on the upcoming school anniversary, they can receive a perfect score on the college entrance exam. The girls decided to recruit Min-joo, a second year student from the religious club, as a mercenary and made a decision to participate together in the ghost hide and seek.

items.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
items.overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

items.title: Lola Dust
items.overview: After attending an audition, an aspiring actress finds herself the subject of a deep fake campaign targeting the British Immigration minister. In her quest to expose the truth and find the perpetrators, she becomes the victim of identity theft and digital harassment which leads her to a world hidden in plain sight.
items.tagline: Stealing her image was just the beginning

items.title: Sugarhouse
items.overview: A sweet-natured teenager and her headstrong little sister, abandoned by their outlaw father, reach out for help from their wayward brother, who remains haunted by the sins of his past.

items.title: The Room Below
items.overview: After losing her son to cancer, a grieving mother living with a mysterious creature in her home befriends another boy to replace her dead son. But when a retired detective begins investigating the child's disappearance, her carefully constructed world starts to unravel.

items.title: My Name Is Gutierrez
items.overview: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The Russian Ambassador's body is found shot dead in the suburbs of Buenos Aires. In charge of the investigation is Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez, a policeman who knows how to coexist with all sorts of crimes, but who is not trained for solving this type of case. With the eyes of the world on him, Gutierrez must reluctantly collaborate with the CIA and their point person, Mike Robinson — his soon-to-become nemesis — whom he sees as a conceited foreigner who wants to tell him what to do in his own territory. Together with Lieutenant Torcoletti, Commissioner Capote, and his team, Gutierrez will deploy all his methods and move on the edge of legality to find the murderer before the CIA does, even if that means dealing with con artists, kidnappers, strip clubs, and nursing homes.

episodes.name: Third World War is Coming
episodes.overview: Gutierrez investigates the murder of a Russian Ambassador, not knowing that danger is very close.

episodes.name: Where’s the Blonde?
episodes.overview: Gutierrez begins to suspect that someone is manipulating the investigation from the shadows.

episodes.name: Torcoletti Jr.
episodes.overview: An unexpected new lead takes Gutierrez to retrieve the ambassador’s cell phone and to a new suspect.

episodes.name: Bingo!
episodes.overview: A hostage situation and fake IDs reveal the size of the Russian network in Buenos Aires.

episodes.name: Partners in Crime
episodes.overview: The fake passports lead Gutierrez and the CIA after former Russian soldier Sergei Shalimov.

episodes.name: You've Got a Friend in Me
episodes.overview: Gutierrez swears revenge and suspicions of treason emerge within the investigation.

episodes.name: Nap Time
episodes.overview: With Robinson’s help, Gutierrez finds the Russian hideout and gets ready for the final showdown.

episodes.name: For Fig's Sake!
episodes.overview: Gutierrez discovers that the real murderer manipulated him from the beginning.

items.title: The Night I Got Pregnant By the CEO
items.overview:
Hanai Shiori, who works in the sales department of a fashion distribution website, is suddenly dumped by her boyfriend Keiichi on their third anniversary. While she is in tears at a bar, a kind man approaches and gently speaks to her. Leaning on his kindness, Shiori ends up spending the night with him.

As time passes, Shiori discovers that she is pregnant. To make matters more complicated, the new company president who appears at her workplace turns out to be the very man from that night.

items.title: The Yakuza Boss’s Beloved
items.overview: After discovering her live-in boyfriend's affair, an advertising employee moves in with her cold, feared boss — unaware he's secretly a young Yakuza leader.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Makoto (Konno Ayaka), 29, dreams of a happy family and works as a sales clerk at the advertising agency Adliza. She's dedicated to her work and admired by her colleagues, but in her private life, she's constantly at the mercy of her selfish and self-centered boyfriend, Hayato (Akazawa Ryotaro), and despite being pushed around by him, she remains devoted to him and has been living with him for three years. One day, at a department drinking party, she witnesses her boyfriend Hayato cheating on her with her junior colleague, Aina (Hoshino Yumena). Makoto instinctively flees the scene, but with nowhere to go and nowhere to turn, she finds herself at a loss. Just then, she is offered a helping hand by her boss, Odagiri (Totsuka Shota), feared and known as the "gang boss" within the company. Meanwhile, Tora Senzaki (Nakamura Rea), a detective investigating organized crime, sets his sights on a gang called the Fudo-kai... A dangerous cohabitation with a cold-hearted boss begins!

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Makoto (Konno Ayaka) ends up spending some time at Odagiri's (Totsuka Shota) house. Odagiri's behavior at work is completely different from how he behaves, and he's concerned about Makoto at home, which makes her feel uneasy... Makoto is bombarded with questions about the drinking party by her junior colleagues Aina (Hoshino Yumena), Yumi (Asahi Nanami), and her colleague Matsumoto (Horie Kazuki), while her ex-boyfriend Hayato (Akazawa Ryotaro) relentlessly pursues her in an attempt to get back together with her. Yuto grows impatient with Makoto's refusal to give in and calls her to a certain place, where he takes an unexpected action. However, when Makoto is cornered, the mysterious "Fudo-kai Wakagashira, Odagiri Ren" and his aide Kiba (Masaki Reiya) appear before him...!? "What did you do to my woman?" Meanwhile, Tora (Nakamura Rea) and Aoki (Yamazaki Hikaru), who are pursuing the Wakagashira, continue their investigation desperately, hoping to find some clues, but...

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Tora (Nakamura Reia) and Aoki (Yamazaki Hikaru) continue their investigation, pursuing the underboss, but have yet to discover his true identity. Meanwhile, Makoto (Konno Ayaka) has begun living with her boss, Odagiri (Totsuka Shota). The two gradually grow closer as they spend peaceful time together, eating breakfast together and shopping for daily necessities. However, at the shopping mall, she encounters her junior colleague, Aina (Hoshino Yumena). In the face of Aina's relentless harassment, Ren resolutely protects Makoto. Touched by Ren's great kindness, Makoto begins to realize that she has special feelings for him, but pretends not to notice these feelings and continues looking for a new home. Watching Makoto, Ren tells her that he is "special," and their relationship finally takes a new step. Meanwhile, Aina, suspicious of Ren's true identity, investigates his secret and eventually captures the evidence of that "secret" in photographs...

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Odagiri (Totsuka Shota) and Makoto (Konno Ayaka) have come to understand each other's feelings, and their relationship has gone from boss and subordinate to "lovers." Makoto is touched when he gently strokes her head and says "good night," but she's excited and hopes for a sweet development...!? At work, Aina (Hoshino Yumena) has obtained photographic evidence that Odagiri is a real gangster, and she presses him to resign. Odagiri is in a difficult position, but he tells Makoto that he'll "explain it to her someday" so as not to worry her, and leaves the house. Makoto waits, trusting Odagiri without asking for the reason... Meanwhile, Tora (Nakamura Rea) is pursuing the Fudo-kai with his subordinate Aoki (Yamazaki Hikaru) when he spots his childhood friend Makoto. "Makoto?" Tora's feelings intensify as he sees Makoto, whom he has had feelings for for a long time. Then, a phone call to Makoto casts a shadow over their happy life...

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Makoto (Konno Ayaka) is excited about her first date with Ren (Totsuka Shota). However, her happiness is shattered when her abusive mother, Hiroko (Yamada Kinuo), who she thought she had estranged from, reappears. "I'll never let you get away," she says. She is saved by her kind childhood friend, Tora (Nakamura Reia), who has become a detective. Makoto longs for her brief reunion with Tora, but Tora secretly harbors feelings for her. Then, on the night of her date with Ren, her mother, Hiroko, suddenly bursts into the restaurant. Her mother's whispered curses and the ruined date drag Makoto back to a nightmare from the past. However, she tearfully pleads with Ren for help, and Ren promises to support her. Meanwhile, Tora, worried about Makoto, discovers a shocking truth about the "young boss of a yakuza gang" he is pursuing as a detective... Should she choose her beloved boss or her childhood friend who will protect her? Makoto's destiny is about to change dramatically.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Makoto (Konno Ayaka), suffering from threats from her mother Hiroko (Yamada Kinuo), whom she thought she had estranged, tearfully asks Ren (Totsuka Shota) for help. Ren gently comforts her and tells her, "There's no need to force yourself to see her. It's okay to run away." However, in order to finally move forward, Makoto decides to break away from her mother. Once the issue with Makoto's mother is resolved, Ren plans to tell Makoto the "secret" he has been hiding. "There's something I've never been able to tell you," he says. Just as he is about to reveal this "secret," he receives news from Kiba Haruka (Masaki Reiya) that "my father (Tatekawa Shiraku) has collapsed." Makoto sends Ren and Kiba off, but he looks worried... Meanwhile, Tora (Nakamura Reia), who has discovered Ren's true identity, rushes to Makoto's side. Makoto says that Tora is kind and worried about her, but Tora finally confesses his long-held feelings to her, saying, "It's because I love you."

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Ren (Totsuka Shota) races through the city at night to save Makoto (Konno Ayaka), who has been kidnapped by someone. At the same time, his childhood friend Tora (Nakamura Reia) is also desperately searching for her whereabouts. With the same thought in mind, "to protect the one I love," the two head towards the culprit.
