episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Ren (Totsuka Shota) finally confesses to Makoto (Konno Ayaka) that he is a person living in the world of the yakuza. Faced with the heavy truth that Ren, who had spoken so many kind words to her and supported her so much, is now the underboss of the yakuza, Makoto decides to leave Ren for now. The two are torn apart beyond repair.

items.title: A Calm Sea and Beautiful Days with You
items.overview: During the Showa-era, newlyweds Natsumi Ebata and Takimasa Ebata enter an arranged marriage without a single day of courtship. Through tender yet exasperating moments, the two slowly bridge the gap between them, discovering love in the quiet routines of their shared days.

items.title: Then You Try Making It!
items.overview: A woman loses herself by playing the "perfect girlfriend," cooking elaborate meals for her partner, while her old-fashioned boyfriend assumes women should cook. After a smooth college romance and cohabitation, they break up right after his proposal. Through cooking, they rethink stereotypes and rebuild their love in this rom-com.

items.title: My Hot Sexless Lover
items.overview: A woman thinks her new boyfriend is “perfect,” but while he is handsome and fun, he says he’s not interested in intimacy. Can she convince him to change his mind?

items.title: My Little Lover - Minami Kun no Koibito
items.overview: Shun'ichi Minami possesses good looks and does well academically in high school. Chiyomi Horikiri is a bright girl who likes dancing. They were childhood friends and also their first loves, but after Shun'ichi Minami's father disappeared they hardly talk. On a storming night, Chiyomi Horikiri has an argument with her parents over her future course and leaves home. While trying to avoid the rain, Chiyomi Horikiri wishes that she go back to her childhood. Suddenly, Chiyomi becomes 15 cm tall. Shun'ichi Minami happens to see tiny Chiyomi Horikiri. She tells him that she doesn't want anyone else to see her, and Shun'ichi Minami takes her his home.

episodes.name: Long Forgotten First Love
episodes.overview: Once childhood sweethearts, high school seniors Chiyomi and Shunichi have drifted apart. One day, she realizes she still has feelings for him.

episodes.name: Under The Same Roof?!
episodes.overview: Wishing she were little again, Chiyomi is transformed into a miniature version of herself. When Shunichi finds her, she begs him to keep her hidden.

episodes.name: A Magical Love Mallet
episodes.overview: Shunichi takes Chiyomi shopping. They sneak into a local shrine where a legendary sacred mallet may be the key to solving her "tiny" problem.

episodes.name: Don't Give Up, Minami
episodes.overview: Shunichi's mother and Chiyomi talk him into rejoining the kendo team for an important match. Meanwhile, a suspicious man snoops around his household.

episodes.name: Chiyomi's Big Adventure
episodes.overview: Chiyomi sneaks out to get some doll dresses from her house. When she returns to Shunichi's home, she finds a mysterious couple who might be burglars.

episodes.name: I Know I'm Not Good Enough
episodes.overview: Chiyomi secretly attends school but is seen by Riku. Later, Sayori stays over at Shunichi's house and sneaks into his room that night for a kiss.

episodes.name: 18 Year Old Proposal
episodes.overview: Chiyomi is discovered by Shunichi's grandmother, who thinks she's a legendary princess. Later, she tries to fix a marital problem between her parents.

episodes.name: The Blue Fairy
episodes.overview: Tomiko is hospitalized after she suddenly faints. Shunichi is relieved to hear she's OK but soon has cause for worry when Chiyomi goes missing.

episodes.name: A Romantic Getaway for Two
episodes.overview: After questioning Shunichi, Riku finds out the truth about Chiyomi. Shunichi and Chiyomi leave on a trip to a hot springs to turn her back to normal.

episodes.name: Good-bye Chiyomi, Good-bye Minami
episodes.overview: Shunichi and Chiyomi eagerly await the legendary sunrise at Cape Akebono. Later, on the way home, Shunichi is hit by a car and hospitalized.

items.title: Just Play Dead
items.overview: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

items.title: Confinement
items.overview: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

items.title: The Wrong Girls
items.overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

items.title: The Weight
items.overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.
items.tagline: A tale of good and evil.

items.title: The Keeper of the Camphor Tree
items.overview: Reito Naoi, a young man fired unfairly from his day job, finds himself hitting rock bottom when he's arrested after a desperate attempt to get back on his feet. With nothing left to him, he surrendered himself to fate, giving up on any hopes for the future, and lost the will to make his own choices in life. But one day, a chance encounter threw him a lifeline that could change his fate forever.

items.title: The Last Scene
items.overview: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

items.title: Tangled: Before Ever After
items.overview: Rapunzel grapples with the responsibilities of being a princess and the overprotective ways of her father. While she wholeheartedly loves Eugene, Rapunzel does not share his immediate desire to get married and settle down within the castle walls. Determined to live life on her own terms, she and her tough-as-nails Lady-in-Waiting Cassandra embark on a secret adventure where they encounter mystical rocks that magically cause Rapunzel's long blonde hair to grow back. Impossible to break and difficult to hide, Rapunzel must learn to embrace her hair and all that it represents.
items.tagline: Life is about to get hairier.

items.title: Tangled Ever After
items.overview: The kingdom is in a festive mood as everyone gathers for the royal wedding of Rapunzel and Flynn. However, when Pascal and Maximus, as flower chameleon and ring bearer, respectively, lose the gold bands, a frenzied search and recovery mission gets underway. As the desperate duo tries to find the rings before anyone discovers that they’re missing, they leave behind a trail of comical chaos that includes flying lanterns, a flock of doves, a wine barrel barricade and a very sticky finale. Will Maximus and Pascal save the day and make it to the church in time? And will they ever get Flynn’s nose right?

items.title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
items.overview: Haunted by past trauma, Hathaway Noa is drawn to a mysterious girl named Gigi Andalucia, whose strange powers stir memories within him. While swayed by her cryptic words, he continues preparing for Mafty's mission -- the attack on the Adelaide Conference. Meanwhile, Kenneth Sleg of the Earth Federation Forces prepares a defense operation for the Adelaide Conference and a plan to eliminate Mafty and is approached by Handley Yoxon of the Criminal Police Organization with a secret proposal. As Hathaway and Kenneth pursue their respective goals, Gigi also sets off for Hong Kong to fulfill her own role.

items.title: The Mongoose
items.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

items.title: Intense Love
items.overview: A love story between a genius doctor and an actress, both determined to reject their parents' arranged marriages, only to discover that love is something destined for them.

items.title: Unchained Love
items.overview: During the reign of Long Hua, court power struggles intertwine with a forbidden romance. Xiao Duo, a formidable eunuch conspiring with Prince Fu to seize the throne, rescues Bu Yinlou, a tribute lady meant to die for the late emperor. Forced into each other’s lives, they slowly fall in love despite their unequal status. Their bond deepens on a journey to Jiangnan, but threats from rival factions, the palace, and Xiao Duo’s hidden identity place them in constant danger. Caught between love and ambition, they must navigate betrayal and sacrifice as fate pushes them toward a perilous future.

items.title: Mischievous Kiss: Love in Tokyo
items.overview: At a high school entrance ceremony, high school student Kotoko Aihara, who isn't that smart, notices pretty boy Naoki Irie. She falls in love with him immediately. Kotoko initially doesn't express her feelings to him, but finally has a chance to tell him how she feels. Unfortunately, Naoki turns Kotoko down, saying "I don't like dumb women." One day, Kotoko Aihara's house is severely damaged by an earthquake. Until the house is rebuilt, Kotoko Aihara and her father decide to live with her father's friend. When Kotoko Aihara moves to her new temporary house, she is surprised to learn that Naoki Irie lives there as well.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: At a high school entrance ceremony, high school student Kotoko Aihara (Honoka Miki), who isn't that smart, notices pretty boy Naoki Irie (Yuki Furukawa). She falls in love with him immediately. Kotoko initially doesn't express her feelings to him, but finally has a chance to tell him how she feels. Unfortunately, Naoki turns Kotoko down, saying "I don't like dumb women." One day, Kotoko Aihara's house is severely damaged by an earthquake. Until the house is rebuilt, Kotoko Aihara and her father decide to live with her father's friend. When Kotoko Aihara moves to her new temporary house, she is surprised to learn that Naoki Irie lives there as well.

episodes.name: Love Comes Riding a Shooting Star
Does Morning Coffee Smell of Love?
Is Chocolate a Charm for Love?
Who is Going to Get the First Kiss?
A Rival Enters the Scene?! A Love with Grim Prospects
Time to Give Up My Love
A Fork in the Path of Love
A Miracle from A Shooting Star

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Kotoko (Honoka Yahagi) loved Naoki (Yuki Furukawa) for 6 years and finally married him. Now, Kotoko transfers to the department of nursing in her studies and struggles …

episodes.name: A Turbulent Honeymoon
episodes.overview:
Things aren't smooth sailing during Kotoko and Naoki's honeymoon, as someone else has her eye on Naoki. But when they return from their trip, the two of them discover that it's just the beginning...

(Note: Repeat of the "Love in Okinawa" special episode, except for the last 3 minutes.)

episodes.name: My Marriage Still On Hold?!
episodes.overview: Kotoko gets nervous when Naoki refuses to sign the marriage registration forms and doesn't come home for a while.

episodes.name: Hello Baby?!
episodes.overview: A new girl has entered Kotoko and Naoki's lives, but for once it might not be Naoki that she's interested in. A mistaken diagnoses spirals out of control and Kotoko can't handle it.

episodes.name: Exciting! My First Date
episodes.overview: Chris is leaving Japan soon, but despite her hardest efforts, Kinnosuke adamantly refuses all of her advances. Naoki must make good on a promise, but things don't go exactly as Kotoko plans.

episodes.name: Extreme!? Mates in White Coat
episodes.overview: Kotoko begins nursing school, but faces new challenges with her group members. A new friend of Kotoko's isn't too fond of Naoki's treatment toward her.

episodes.name: A Genius and Jealousy
episodes.overview: As Keita pursues Kotoko, Naoki begins to act distant, making Kotoko worry that her marriage is over.

episodes.name: A Vow with a Nurse Cap
episodes.overview: Fed up with Naoki's cold behavior, Kotoko leaves home. Kotoko's official capping ceremony approaches, making her a full-fledged nurse.

episodes.name: Rivalry with Grandma Toyo
episodes.overview: It's Kotoko's first day as an intern, but things don't go as smoothly as she planned when her patient is out to make it a very difficult two weeks for her.

episodes.name: Here Comes A Cute Little Vixen!
episodes.overview: When Naoki's younger cousin Rika comes to stay with the family for a bit, she proves to be another obstacle for Kotoko.

episodes.name: Naoki's First Homecoming
episodes.overview: Kotoko meets a kindred spirit. Naoki gets more than he bargained for when he goes to visit Kotoko's relatives.

episodes.name: Kiss of Goodbye
episodes.overview: Yuki finds himself in a familiar situation, and must tutor a girl with a huge crush on him. Naoki passes the National Boards, but then is faced with a difficult decision.

episodes.name: ...and Love in KOBE
episodes.overview: Unable to focus in school, Kotoko travels 300 miles to see Naoki again after he gets an internship in Kobe.

episodes.name: Flowers and Storms
episodes.overview: Kotoko is finally a full-fledged nurse, but worries that due to her lack of experience, she'll be a burden on Naoki.

episodes.name: Stand Up For Love
episodes.overview: After Naoki's unassisted operation saves a life, he still must face the repercussions of the medical board for breaking the rules. Yuki and Kinnosuke both come to important realizations.

episodes.name: Tearful Proposal
episodes.overview: After taking a nasty fall, Naoki has the misfortune of becoming Kotoko's number one patient. Kinnosuke finally realizes his feelings for Chris, but he may be too late.

episodes.name: Best Birthday Gift Ever
episodes.overview: Kotoko tries to celebrate her ideal birthday with Naoki, but nothing goes as planned.

items.title: Hanyi Enters the Heart
items.overview: After surviving her family's massacre as a child, a young woman assumes a new identity and spends years preparing for revenge. With an alliance of women at her side, she hunts down those responsible while searching for the mysterious figure behind the killings.

items.title: Perfect Blue
items.overview: Rising pop star Mima Kirigoe quits singing to pursue a career as an actress. After she takes up a role on a popular detective show, her handlers and collaborators begin turning up murdered. Harboring feelings of guilt and haunted by visions of her former self, Mima's reality and fantasy meld into a frenzied paranoia.

items.title: Maquia: When the Promised Flower Blooms
items.overview: Fleeing the war, the immortal Maquia, graced with eternal youth, finds a baby abandoned in the forest and decides to raise it as her own child, sparking a moving story between a mortal and a being who does not age.
items.tagline: I weave my life with yours.

items.title: Horrible Bosses 2
items.overview: Dale, Kurt and Nick decide to start their own business but things don't go as planned because of a slick investor, prompting the trio to pull off a harebrained and misguided kidnapping scheme.

items.title: Horrible Bosses
items.overview: For Nick, Kurt and Dale, the only thing that would make the daily grind more tolerable would be to grind their intolerable bosses into dust. Quitting is not an option, so, with the benefit of a few-too-many drinks and some dubious advice from a hustling ex-con, the three friends devise a convoluted and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their respective employers... permanently.
items.tagline: Ever wish your boss was dead?

items.title: Bride Beyond
items.overview: It follows a forensic doctor and a security commander investigating a ghost story linked to an old debt and a mysterious wedding.

items.title: Gaskins: The Hitchhiker Killer
items.overview: South Carolina serial killer Donald “Pee-Wee” Gaskins carried out a reign of terror marked by extreme brutality. He stabbed, shot, drowned, and poisoned victims from his own community as well as hitchhikers, often targeting the vulnerable. Beneath the rural land near his home, bodies lay hidden in shallow graves, concealing years of violence. His history of crime masked the depth of his cruelty—until authorities uncovered the truth, exposing the full horror of his murders.

items.title: Much About Love
items.overview: A TV director returns to her theater roots for a Shakespeare festival and runs into an old flame, rekindling a merry war of wits in this modern retelling of "Much Ado About Nothing."

items.title: Barreda
items.overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.
items.tagline: El Asesino Que Dividió A Un País
